prs.title: fix(cli): correct member-message timeout guidance
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give a hosted member message whose reply times out message-specific guidance: recipients may already have it or receive it later, so do not send it again. Live, resumed and interrupted waits use the command kind committed in the journal. This preserves @gtdd123's original implementation and commit authorship.

## Why it's needed

The current timeout answer tells a sender to read the task board before repeating a write. The board cannot establish message delivery, and repeating the send can create another message. The focused change leaves delivery and journal settlement behavior alone.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Let a member's send reach the accepting or unknown outcome without a reply. The model-facing result should say some recipients may already have the message or receive it later, explicitly prohibit resending, and omit board advice. Live, resumed and interrupted settlement should agree. Board-command and plan-submission wording, plus known non-delivery outcomes, should retain their existing answers.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: independently executing the current production text boundary for accepting/unknown returns board/repeat-write advice without a no-resend warning. The reporter's Spring/MySQL P3/P7 evidence shows why an uncertain send can still arrive after recovery; that stack has not been independently rerun here. After: 383 tests across the five related suites pass. Restoring the old text boundary makes eight regression checks fail; the candidate was restored afterward. A separate observation run captured all six live/resumed/interrupted cases with identical per-state model-facing results and the expected settled/unknown journal state. Eighteen board/plan and unchanged-state controls match the old text. This is limited integration evidence with the existing mocked Broker and fake live-timeout clock, not Spring/MySQL or model-HTTP E2E.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 383 related tests; build/bundle, typecheck, formatting and lint |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ contributor reported tests; not independently run here |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2; isolated worktree. The dependency prepare script completed the full repository build and bundle. The five related suites passed locally (383 tests), and the candidate passed formatting and lint. Full repository typecheck also passed. The full preflight was not run locally. CI review gate is unverified: the local engine twice timed out on the preceding CI fix without a final verdict.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: uncertain delivery is deliberately not presented as safe to repeat.
- Not validated / out of scope: independent Spring/MySQL fault recovery or duplicate-delivery E2E. Existing board and `plan_submit` wording remains a separate product decision.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no delivery, settlement or protocol changes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ba32d0eadb43c295437fc21008a47a0246e1c2fa/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-agent-team-member-commands.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ba32d0eadb43c295437fc21008a47a0246e1c2fa/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-agent-team-member-commands.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14063

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的修改

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

让成员发送消息后，未等到回复即进入 accepting 或 unknown 结局。模型收到的结果应说明部分收件人可能已收到或稍后收到，明确禁止重发，并且没有任务板建议。实时、续跑、中断三条结算路径应一致。任务板命令、计划提交以及已知未投递结局应保留既有答复。

### 测试平台

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): Report merges deleting uncommitted parent content as conflicts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Closes items 1 and 21 of #13905, the child Workspace follow-up list, in the order that issue suggests.

Item 21, verified and fixed here: a clean merge can delete content that the parent's working tree alone holds. For example, the child's commit untracks a file the parent never committed, with the path ignored on the child's side. The child's starting snapshot carried that file as committed content, so the merge judged the parent's copy clean to delete, although it was the only copy anywhere. A clean merge now reports a deletion as a conflict when the content the parent's tree holds at that path survives nowhere else. That means neither the parent's index nor its `HEAD` holds that same content at the path, and the merge does not write it at another path. In that case the row ends `conflicted`, the child's work stays pinned, and nothing is written. Deletions whose content survives land exactly as before:

- a committed file, whether or not the parent took it out of its index;
- a file the parent staged but never committed;
- a file the child moved.

A resumed write judges each deletion it still owes the same way. If a tool turn between two attempts took the content out of both the index and `HEAD`, the row ends `blocked` instead of deleting it.

Item 1 syncs the worktree-admission design's decisions 5 and 8, in both languages, with an exception that the review-fix commit `97f0c33847` (#13872) added. A give-up on a row whose child was never bound (a lost creation answer) discards instead of merging, because the hold a merge would owe would leave the relay row unfinishable.

## Why it's needed

Item 21 is the only data-loss candidate on the follow-up list: the parent's own untracked files, or its uncommitted edits, could be removed with no recoverable copy. Item 1 is the item the issue asks to close first. The design text still claimed behavior the code no longer has, and operators enabling child Workspaces read decisions 5 and 8 as their contract.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The Git step tests pin each side of the rule against real repositories:

- A child untracking a file the parent never committed, and a child deleting a committed file the parent has edited without committing, each end as a conflict naming the path, with the parent's content intact.
- A deletion lands when the parent's index stages the content, when only `HEAD` commits it, or when the merge writes it at another path. Each of these was shown load-bearing by removing that arm and watching the test go red.
- A clean deletion of a committed, unmodified file still lands.
- A resumed write refuses a deletion when, between attempts, the parent untracked and committed the file, and the file survives.

A reviewer should confirm the conflicts have the same shape as the existing unwritable kinds: the row ends `conflicted`, nothing is written, and the child's result stays pinned.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A, no UI change. Before: on the previous head, the uncommitted-edit test merged clean and deleted the edit, and the staged and moved deletions ended `conflicted`. The resumed write deleted the file. After: the Git step class passes 57/0, and the whole `service` package passes 752 tests with 0 failures (2 skipped). Checkstyle and SpotBugs are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ earlier head only (not re-run on this head) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested (the class is skipped there) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, Maven 3.9.9, Git 2.47.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a merge that would delete content that only the parent's working tree holds now ends `conflicted` instead of landing. That is the intended behavior change. A resumed write in the same situation ends `blocked`. Every other merge outcome is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the remaining items of #13905 (settlement waits, rolling upgrade, deferred tests and renames), which the issue schedules as later slices. No hosted-pipeline integration run. A child that untracks a file the parent commits still lands as a deletion the parent can restore from `HEAD`. Changing that would be a design change to the content-based merge.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents updated in both languages: [child Workspace capability](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-09-managed-child-workspace.md) / [中文版](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-09-managed-child-workspace.zh-CN.md); [worktree admission](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-child-worktree-admission.md) / [中文版](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-child-worktree-admission.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13905. This closes items 1 and 21; the issue stays open for the remaining items.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

关闭 #13905（child Workspace 遗留清单）的第 1 项与第 21 项，顺序遵循该 issue 的建议。

第 21 项已复现并在本 PR 修复：干净合并可能删除仅由父工作树持有的内容。例如 child 的提交把一个父从未提交过的文件解除跟踪，且该路径只在 child 一侧被忽略。child 的起始快照把该文件当作已提交内容带入，于是合并判定父的那份可以干净删除，而它是任何地方仅存的一份。现在，若父的树在该路径上的内容在别处都不再保有，干净合并会把这次删除报为冲突。所谓不再保有，是指父的 index 与 `HEAD` 都没有在该路径持有同一份内容，合并也没有把它写到其他路径。这种情况下行以 `conflicted` 结束，child 的工作保持 pin，不写入任何内容。内容仍有保存的删除照旧落地：

- 已提交的文件，无论父是否已把它移出 index；
- 父已暂存但从未提交的文件；
- child 移动了的文件。

续做的写入对每个尚未写入的删除做同样的判断。若两次尝试之间有 tool turn 把该内容同时移出了 index 与 `HEAD`，行会以 `blocked` 结束，而不是删除它。

第 1 项把 worktree 准入设计的决策 5 与决策 8（中英文）同步到评审修复提交 `97f0c33847`（#13872）引入的例外：child 从未绑定（创建应答丢失）的行上的放弃改为丢弃，而不是请求合并，因为合并需要扣住 settle，relay 行将永远无法结束。

## 为什么需要

第 21 项是清单中唯一的数据丢失候选：父自己的未跟踪文件或未提交编辑，可能在没有任何可恢复副本的情况下被删除。第 1 项是 issue 要求先关闭的项。设计文本仍声称着代码已不再具有的行为，而启用 child Workspace 的运维把决策 5 与决策 8 当作契约来读。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

Git 步骤测试针对真实仓库钉住规则的每一侧：

- child 解除跟踪父从未提交的文件，以及 child 删除父已提交、但有未提交编辑的文件，都以命名该路径的冲突结束，父的内容保持完好。
- 父的 index 暂存了该内容、只有 `HEAD` 提交了它、或合并把它写到其他路径时，删除都能落地。逐一移除对应分支后测试变红，证明每个分支都是承重的。
- 对已提交且未修改文件的干净删除仍然落地。
- 两次尝试之间父解除跟踪并提交了该文件时，续做的写入拒绝这次删除，文件得以保留。

评审者应确认这些冲突与现有「无法写入」类形态一致：行以 `conflicted` 结束，不写入任何内容，child 的结果保持 pin。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A，无 UI 变更。修复前：在上一个 head 上，未提交编辑用例合并干净并删除了编辑，暂存与移动的删除以 `conflicted` 结束，续做的写入删除了文件。修复后：Git 步骤测试类 57/0 通过，整个 `service` 包 752 个测试 0 失败（2 个跳过），Checkstyle 与 SpotBugs 均为零告警。

### 已测试环境

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |

prs.title: fix(sdk-java): Close Hosted Harness review criticals from #12654
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR lands the fixes for the 11 Critical and 2 Minor findings from the post-merge review of #12654 (the Hosted Harness private Java client), **plus the closures for the second review round filed against this PR itself**. #12654 merged before its review round was processed (all 62 threads were still open); every finding in scope was re-verified against current `main` before fixing. The remaining 49 Suggestion-level findings from the #12654 round are dispositioned in their threads and tracked as a backlog in #13313; #13313 also tracks the deferred remainder of this PR's own review round.

### Second round (addressing the CHANGES_REQUESTED review of this PR)

The second round execution-proved one real regression in the first commit — CI's fault-gates lane agreed — and five more critical defects around it:

- **Wire/digest mismatch (CI-confirmed)**: the digest was canonicalized but the wire `prompt` member was not, and the hosted route re-derives the digest from the received bytes — every `addText` submission drew `400 invalid_hosted_prompt`. `toJson()` now emits the canonical form, the digest reuses the `JsonSupport.encode` facade over that same value (one serialization entry point), and the pinning test asserts the wire bytes and the digest are literally the same value (byte-literal expectation plus the canonical digest constant).
- **Idle watchdog vs. silent hosted route**: the 45s bound was inherited from the stdio transport, whose server writes heartbeat comments; the hosted events route wrote nothing while no event was committed, so healthy silent streams — long tool calls, slow model phases, the ten-minute approval wait — were aborted and re-dispatched forever. The hosted route now mirrors the primary route's keepalive comment every 15s, and `Builder.sseIdleTimeout` accepts `Duration.ZERO` for callers that own the deadline. A new test keeps a consumer parked in `next()` for three idle budgets while the peer stays alive on keepalive comments alone; the pre-existing idle-timeout test still goes red when the watchdog is removed.
- **Idle abort surfaced outside the `DaemonException` family**: when the watchdog fired while the consumer was between `next()` calls, the closed guard threw `IllegalStateException`, contradicting the new javadoc and invisible to consumers classifying by `DaemonException`. The guard now distinguishes who closed the stream: idle abort → `DaemonTransportException('Hosted Harness SSE idle timeout')`, caller close → `IllegalStateException`.
- **Executor-rejection overreach**: the cause-chain scan certified any rejection-shaped `IOException` as "never dispatched", but response delivery also runs on the caller-supplied executor — a rejection surfacing after the server accepted a turn dropped the active-prompt marker for an admitted turn and reported it definitively not submitted. Now only a bare `RejectedExecutionException` (submit time) or a rejection with the executor already shut down classifies as saturated/known; mid-flight shapes stay outcome-unknown and keep the marker. This is pinned deterministically by staging a parked worker + a full queue + a delayed 202 answer through a package-private executor seam.
- **Boot-headerless 4xx misclassified as outcome-unknown**: the missing-header wrap treated the server's own pre-middleware refusals (413 body-too-large, 429) the same as a gateway's error page. All four mutation sites now re-derive: ambiguous (408/5xx) keeps outcome-unknown; a definitive unfenced refusal surfaces as `DaemonHttpException` with its status preserved.
- **Folded-in adjacent closures**: `detachSession` retires the local attachment on every definitive answer (not just 204/404), so a 403 after an auth revocation no longer leaks a heartbeat timer; a caller queued on `cursorLock` when the stream closes re-checks inside the lock and gets the closed-stream signal instead of a transport error; the `session_snapshot` comment now names the actual producer (the bridge's `withSnapshot` on the **primary** events route — the hosted route ignores the query parameter and stamps every frame with an id); the builder javadoc records the cursor-fallback precedence and that `snapshot(true)` is a primary-transport option; the README retry section and both design-doc languages now state the canonical digest as a cross-language wire contract and record that changing the digest algorithm requires quiescing (or rewriting) in-flight turn rows before upgrading; and two previously unpinned arms (an explicit cursor beating the ref watermark, and a definitive boot-headerless DELETE) got their own discriminating tests.

### First round (post-merge review of #12654)

- Stream lifecycle: `HarnessEventStream` no longer parks `close()` behind a consumer blocked in `next()` — the closed flag is atomic and the raw input is closed without any stream monitor, so `HostedHarnessClient.close()` always completes and a blocked `next()` fails with `DaemonTransportException` (the idle watchdog above completes this picture).
- Turn ledger correctness: a 409 rejection no longer retains an uncloseable marker keyed by the rejected promptId (it releases the slot and throws `PromptAlreadyActiveException`); a definitive non-409 failure on a same-identity retry releases the slot it retained for that retry; and `getStatus()` snapshots the active-prompt entry before the remote read and only ever removes that exact registration, so a stale `hasActivePrompt:false` can no longer delete a different prompt admitted while the read was in flight.
- Outcome classification (first-cut form, narrowed in the second round — see above): a response missing the `X-Qwen-Harness-Boot-Id` fence header on a mutation path is classified as outcome-unknown instead of a bare `DaemonProtocolException`, because a response that never passed the fencing middleware cannot prove the mutation did not execute; and a purely local executor rejection surfaces as `DaemonTransportException` instead of claiming the request may have reached the server.
- Lifecycle cleanup: `closeSession(HarnessSessionRef)` treats a definitive 404 as already-done and tears down the attachment and the active-prompt ledger, and `detachSession` tolerates 404 the same way for the attachment (it does not clear the active-prompt ledger — that asymmetry stays, tracked in #13313), so the heartbeat timer no longer keeps posting to a session the server has already reclaimed.
- Protocol interop: `streamEvents` falls back to the session ref's validated watermark when the builder omits the resume pair, so the epoch fence the README promises is actually enforced (and `Last-Event-ID` resumes from the ref's cursor), while a ref carrying no watermark keeps today's unfenced fresh-stream shape; and the shared SSE parser accepts the id-less synthetic `session_snapshot` frame produced by the primary transport's snapshot subscription.
- Digest and model invariants: `computePayloadDigest` hashes a canonical form (object keys sorted recursively, array order preserved) instead of process-random `Map` iteration order, so the dedup key is reproducible across JVMs and across map implementations (fastjson2's `MapSortField` was ruled out by probe: it does not sort maps nested inside a collection); and `HarnessRuntimeExecutionRecovery` enforces at construction that a `known` outcome carries its status map, instead of NPE-ing later inside `isContinuationReady()`.

Every finding is pinned by new tests whose mutation witnesses were run: reverting that finding's fix turns its test red (witness tables under "How to verify").

## Why it's needed

The Hosted Harness client is the Java control-plane transport for the private hosted profile, and its public contract promises fail-closed behaviour (bounded resources, outcome-unknown classification, single active prompt per session, epoch-fenced resume). The first review demonstrated each of these promises had a concrete violation; the second review then execution-proved that the first round's own fixes carried one cross-language regression (CI agreed) and four more fail-closed violations of the same class, in exactly the surfaces the stubs cannot see (the server re-deriving the digest, the hosted route's silence, the executor's dual dispatch/delivery role, and the closed guard's type). Working through both rounds before merge is cheaper than shipping the client with a broken prompt path and correcting it afterwards.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The behaviors are pinned by 23 new cases in `HostedHarnessClientTest`. Run:

```
cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode
mvn -o test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest     # 42 tests (19 pre-existing + 23 new)
mvn -o test                                    # full module: 189 tests, 9 env-gated skips
cd ../cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts   # 181 tests
```

All green locally on JDK 17; `clean test` green on JDK 11 (module targets release 11; two executor-rejection cases skip themselves on JDK 11, whose `HttpClient` parks a send to a struggling executor instead of surfacing the rejection — probed on 11/17/21).

Mutation witnesses, first round (revert the fix → the pinning test goes red):

| Fix | Reverted shape | Mutant result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 (null guard) | drop `requireNonNull(status)` for `known` outcomes | RED |
| R1-6 (digest order) | hash raw `promptContent` again | RED |
| R1-4 (stale getStatus) | unconditional `activePrompts.remove(key)` | RED |
| R1-2 + F2 (409 / retry slot) | restore retain-on-409 / retry-keeps-slot | RED (both tests) |
| R1-5 ×3 sites | bare `validateGeneration` | RED ×3 |
| R1-3 (close 404) | tolerance limited to `clientId == null` | RED |
| R1-46 (detach 404) | detach requires 204 unconditionally | RED |
| R1-47 (snapshot frame) | `session_snapshot` out of the id-less set | RED |
| R1-44 (ref watermark) | fence/cursor from the request only | RED |
| R1-1 (shared monitor) | `next()`/`close()` on one monitor again | RED (timeout arms the hang) |
| R1-43 (watchdog) | watchdog disabled | RED (timeout arms the hang) |
| R1-45 (rejection type) | wrap as `IOException` again | RED |

Mutation witnesses, second round:

| Fix | Reverted shape | Mutant result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wire = digest | `toJson()` emits the raw list again | RED (byte-literal asserts the type-first wire) |
| Idle-abort type | closed guard always `IllegalStateException` | RED |
| In-lock re-check | queued caller never re-checks | RED |
| Rejection gate | unbounded cause walk again | RED (mid-flight rejection certified as saturated) |
| Boot-header narrow ×2 | blanket outcome-unknown at the prompt and DELETE sites | RED ×2 |
| Detach finally | cleanup after `requireMutationStatus` only | RED (heartbeats keep beating) |
| Watchdog/keepalive pair | watchdog removed | RED on the idle case, GREEN on the keepalive case |
| Explicit cursor wins | ref-only resume fallback | RED |

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI protocol/transport fix; the mutation tables above are the before/after. CI's `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` lane was green at the merge base and red at the first commit — it is the integration-level evidence for the wire/digest regression and should return to green on this head.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A (CI) |

### Environment (optional)

Local: `JAVA_HOME=jdk17` (full suite) and `jdk11` (`mvn clean test`), Maven 3.9.11, in `packages/sdk-java/qwencode`; `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts` in `packages/cli`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the payload digest is now a canonical cross-language contract — digests computed by the previous release differ for the same content, which is the point of the fix (old values were JVM-random and could never be reproduced across processes). The design doc (both languages) now records that an upgrade altering the digest must quiesce or rewrite in-flight turn rows first; the coordinator-side one-time recompute fallback is deliberately not in this slice (it lives in the managed-agent-server module and is tracked in #13313). Consumers blocked in `next()` now also see `DaemonTransportException` on an idle abort — including the between-calls arm, which previously surfaced as `IllegalStateException`.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 49 Suggestion-level findings from the #12654 round (tracked in #13313). From this PR's own round: the code-carrying `Prompt*` exception redesign for per-`code` marker rules (needs route-semantics-level API work, tracked with the verified gate-order table), the coordinator's missing terminal escape for post-admission outcome-unknown (managed-agent-server slice, tracked), the remaining witness-table coverage items (three of six addressed here), and pinning the JDK-11 executor behavior rather than skipping it (the 11/17/21 difference is now disclosed in the tests, the builder javadoc, and the design doc). `closeSession(String)` still lacks its `ensureOpen()` guard (#13313's R1-50): the post-close executor-rejection test deliberately routes through that path on JDK 17+ and documents the coupling.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: digest change as above; `submitTurn` on a 409 now throws `PromptAlreadyActiveException` instead of `DaemonHttpException`; definitive unfenced 4xx on mutation paths now throw `DaemonHttpException` carrying the status instead of outcome-unknown types; `submitTurn`'s `toJson()` now emits key-sorted content blocks (the server accepts them — it validates shape and re-derives the digest).

## Linked Issues

Refs #12654 (post-merge review findings fixed here) and #13313 (backlog of the deferred remainder from both rounds).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 落地了 #12654(Hosted Harness 私有 Java 客户端)合入后评审的 11 条 Critical 与 2 条 Minor 修复,**以及针对本 PR 自身第二轮评审的闭环**。#12654 在评审处理前已合入(62 条 thread 全部开放);范围内每条发现都在当前 `main` 上重新核实后才修复。其余 49 条 Suggestion 级发现在各自 thread 中给出处置并汇总进 #13313;#13313 同时跟踪本 PR 评审轮次中推迟的剩余项。

### 第二轮(针对本 PR 的 CHANGES_REQUESTED 评审)

第二轮用执行证明了首个提交中的一处真回归——CI 的 fault-gates 车道结论一致——以及围绕它的另外 5 个关键缺陷:

- **线上字节与 digest 不一致(CI 实测确认)**:digest 被规范化而线上 `prompt` 字段没有,hosted 路由又按收到的字节重算 digest——每个 `addText` 提交都拿到 `400 invalid_hosted_prompt`。`toJson()` 现在输出规范形式,digest 经 `JsonSupport.encode` 门面处理同一个值(唯一序列化入口),钉住测试断言线上字节与 digest 是字面相等的同一个值(字节字面量断言 + 规范 digest 常量)。
- **空闲看门狗与静默 hosted 路由**:45s 上界继承自 stdio 传输,那一侧服务端每 15s 写心跳注释;hosted 事件路由在无新事件提交时一个字节都不写,于是健康的静默流——长工具调用、慢模型阶段、十分钟审批等待——被中止并无限重派。hosted 路由现在以与主路由相同的方式每 15s 写一次 keepalive 注释,且 `Builder.sseIdleTimeout` 接受 `Duration.ZERO` 供自管期限的调用方关闭。新测试让消费者停在 `next()` 里跨三个空闲预算、对端仅靠 keepalive 存活;既有空闲超时用例在移除看门狗后仍变红。
- **空闲中止的异常类型不属于 `DaemonException` 家族**:看门狗在消费者处于两次 `next()` 之间触发时, closed 守卫抛 `IllegalStateException`,与新增 javadoc 矛盾、且按 `DaemonException` 分类的消费者捕不到。守卫现在区分关闭由谁发起:空闲中止 → `DaemonTransportException('Hosted Harness SSE idle timeout')`,调用方主动 close → `IllegalStateException`。
- **执行器拒绝分类越界**:cause 链扫描把任何"拒绝形状"的 `IOException` 都认证为"从未派发",但响应投递也运行在调用方提供的执行器上——在服务端已受理之后才出现的拒绝,会把一个已被 admit 的轮次的活跃标记丢掉并报告为"确定未提交"。现在只有原始 `RejectedExecutionException`(提交时)或执行器已终止两种情形归为饱和/已知;中途形状一律保持 outcome-unknown 并保留标记。通过包级执行器测试缝以"停住 worker + 填满队列 + 延迟应答 202"的方式确定性钉住。
- **缺 boot 头的 4xx 被误分类为 outcome-unknown**:缺头 wrap 把服务端自身在中间件之前发出的确定性拒绝(413 body 过大、429)与网关错误页一视同仁。四个变更路径现在重新推导:歧义(408/5xx)保持 outcome-unknown;确定性无 fence 拒绝以携带状态码的 `DaemonHttpException` 呈现。
- **顺带闭环的同簇项**:`detachSession` 对任何确定性应答都拆除本地 attachment(不再只有 204/404),认证吊销后的 403 不再泄漏心跳定时器;流关闭时排在 `cursorLock` 上的调用方在锁内重检并得到"流已关闭"信号而非传输错误;`session_snapshot` 注释现在写明真实生产者(主事件路由上 bridge 的 `withSnapshot`——hosted 路由从不读取该查询参数且每一帧都带 id);builder javadoc 记录游标兜底优先级与 `snapshot(true)` 是主传输选项;README 重试段落与两份设计文档现在把规范 digest 写成跨语言线上契约,并记录"改变 digest 算法的升级必须先排空(或重写)在途 turn 行";另有两个此前未钉住的分支(显式游标压过 ref 水印、确定性缺头 DELETE)获得了有判别力的用例。

### 第一轮(#12654 合入后评审)

- 流生命周期:`HarnessEventStream` 的 `close()` 不再停放在阻塞于 `next()` 的消费者之后——关闭标志为原子量,原始输入在不取任何流监视器的情况下关闭,`HostedHarnessClient.close()` 总能完成,被阻塞的 `next()` 以 `DaemonTransportException` 失败(上面的空闲看门狗补全了这一图景)。
- 轮次台账正确性:409 拒绝不再保留以被拒绝 promptId 为键、永远无法清除的标记(释放槽位并抛 `PromptAlreadyActiveException`);同身份重试收到确定性非 409 失败时释放该重试保留的槽位;`getStatus()` 在远端读取前快照活跃 prompt 条目且只删除那一次注册,陈旧的 `hasActivePrompt:false` 不再能删掉读取在途期间准入的另一个 prompt 的登记。
- 结果分类(第一版形态,第二轮已收窄——见上):变更路径上缺少 `X-Qwen-Harness-Boot-Id` fence 头的响应被分类为结果未知而非裸 `DaemonProtocolException`,因为未经 fence 中间件的响应无法证明变更未执行;纯本地执行器拒绝以 `DaemonTransportException` 呈现,而不是谎称请求可能已到达服务端。
- 生命周期清理:`closeSession(HarnessSessionRef)` 把确定性 404 视为已完成并拆除 attachment 与活跃 prompt 台账,`detachSession` 对 attachment 同样容忍 404(它不清活跃 prompt 台账——该不对称保留,记入 #13313),心跳定时器不再向已被服务端回收的会话持续投递。
- 协议互操作:`streamEvents` 在 builder 省略续传对时回退到 session ref 上已校验的水印,README 承诺的 epoch fence 真正生效(`Last-Event-ID` 也从 ref 游标续传);不携带水印的 ref 保持无 fence 的全新流形态。共享 SSE 解析器现在接受主传输 snapshot 订阅产生的无 id 合成 `session_snapshot` 帧。
- digest 与模型不变量:`computePayloadDigest` 对规范形式(对象键递归排序、数组顺序保持)做哈希,而不是对进程随机的 `Map` 迭代序做哈希,去重键可跨 JVM、跨 map 实现复现(实测否决了 fastjson2 的 `MapSortField`:它不对集合内嵌套的 map 排序);`HarnessRuntimeExecutionRecovery` 在构造时强制 `known` outcome 必带 status map,而不是之后在 `isContinuationReady()` 里 NPE。

每条发现由新测试钉住,并已运行变异见证:单独还原该发现的修复,钉住它的测试即变红(见证表见“如何验证”)。

## 为什么需要

Hosted Harness 客户端是私有 hosted profile 的 Java 控制面传输,其公开契约承诺 fail-closed 行为(有界资源、结果未知分类、每会话单活跃 prompt、epoch-fenced 续传)。第一轮评审证明了每一项承诺都存在具体违例;第二轮又用执行证明第一轮自己的修复在 stub 看不到的那些面上带着一处跨语言回归(CI 结论一致)以及另外四处同类违例(服务端重算 digest、hosted 路由的静默、执行器的派发/投递双重角色、closed 守卫的异常类型)。在合入前处理完两轮评审,比带着断掉的 prompt 路径上线再返工便宜。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

这些行为由 `HostedHarnessClientTest` 的 23 个新用例钉住。运行:

```
cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode
mvn -o test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest     # 42 个测试(19 既有 + 23 新增)
mvn -o test                                    # 全模块:189 个测试,9 个环境门控跳过
cd ../cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts   # 181 个测试
```

本机 JDK 17 全绿;JDK 11 上 `clean test` 绿(模块目标 release 11;两个执行器拒绝用例在 JDK 11 上自行跳过——JDK 11 的 `HttpClient` 对挣扎中的执行器表现为停放 send 而不是抛出拒绝,已在 11/17/21 上实测)。

变异见证:第一轮表格 13 行、第二轮表格 9 行(见英文部分),每行为"还原形态 → 变异结果(全部 RED)";第二轮"看门狗/keepalive 对"一行同时记录空闲用例 RED 与 keepalive 用例 GREEN 的双向判别。

### 证据(Before & After)

N/A —— 非 UI 的协议/传输修复;上方变异表即为前后对照。CI 的 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` 车道在合并基为绿、在首个提交为红——它是线上字节/digest 回归的集成级证据,本 head 上应恢复为绿。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A (CI) |

### 环境(可选)

本机:`JAVA_HOME=jdk17`(全套件)与 `jdk11`(`mvn clean test`)、Maven 3.9.11,在 `packages/sdk-java/qwencode`;`packages/cli` 内 `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡:payload digest 现在是跨语言规范契约——旧版本对同一内容算出的 digest 会不同,这正是修复的目的(旧值是 JVM 随机值,跨进程本就复现不出)。设计文档(中英)现在记录了改变 digest 的升级必须先排空或重写在途 turn 行;协调器侧的一次性重算兜底刻意不在本切片(在 managed-agent-server 模块,记入 #13313)。阻塞在 `next()` 的消费者现在也会在空闲中止时看到 `DaemonTransportException`——包括"两次调用之间"这一臂,此前表现为 `IllegalStateException`。
- 未验证/范围外:#12654 轮的 49 条 Suggestion(记入 #13313)。本 PR 自身轮次中推迟的:按 `code` 决定标记规则的 `Prompt*` 异常重新设计(需要路由语义级的 API 工作,连同已核实的路由门顺序表一并记账)、协调器在 outcome-unknown 之后缺少终态出口(managed-agent-server 切片,记账)、见证表剩余覆盖项(六项中本 PR 处理了另外三项)、以及把 JDK 11 的执行器行为钉住而不只是跳过(11/17/21 的差异现在同时披露在测试、builder javadoc 与设计文档中)。`closeSession(String)` 仍缺 `ensureOpen()` 守卫(#13313 的 R1-50):JDK 17+ 的执行器拒绝测试刻意流经该路径并在注释中写明耦合。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:digest 变更见上;`submitTurn` 收到 409 时现在抛 `PromptAlreadyActiveException` 而不是 `DaemonHttpException`;变更路径上的确定性无 fence 4xx 现在抛携带状态码的 `DaemonHttpException` 而不是 outcome-unknown 类型;`submitTurn` 的 `toJson()` 现在输出按键排序的 content block(服务端接受——它只校验形状并重算 digest)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #12654(本 PR 修复其合入后评审发现)与 #13313(两轮评审推迟剩余项的 backlog)。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): delete attachments from an empty composer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allows Backspace and Delete to remove the final file attachment or pasted image when the desktop Web Shell composer has an empty text body and no removable context tag. Existing context-tag order, caret and selection guards are retained. Includes regression coverage and documents the keyboard behavior.

## Why it's needed

An image-only draft currently ignores both keys, forcing the user to click its remove button. This implements the attachment fallback described in the maintainer's root-cause comment on #10794.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Paste an image into an empty desktop Web Shell composer, focus the editor and press Backspace or Delete. Before the fix the image remains; after the fix it is removed. With multiple attachments, each keypress removes only the last file, then images once files are exhausted. With body text, file/image attachments remain. The eight new DOM cases exercise both keys, sequential deletion, body text and mixed file/image attachments.

- On the latest source baseline: 108 DOM tests passed across the new attachment suite and existing composer suite. Actual Edge before/after scenarios also passed for both keys against the mocked daemon (four cases), not a real provider.
- On the combined verification checkout at `23add5e`, frozen dependency installation, formatting, lint, build and typecheck completed successfully. These were not three independent full-preflight runs.
- **Full preflight did not pass on Windows.** The ACP suite reported 2,624 passed, 14 failed and eight skipped; its 14 failures occurred creating symlink fixtures (`EPERM`). CLI tests also reported failures, including relaunch expectations and file-lock cleanup; the recorded workspace run did not finish all suites. Separate script tests reported 1,805 passed, 26 failed and 202 skipped, including symlink restrictions, missing Git metadata/skill assets in the temporary validation copy, and shell fixture failures. Not all failures have been reproduced on clean upstream or classified; no all-tests-pass claim is made.
- The publication base is `e17ad4c`. Its three intervening commits do not overlap any files in these PRs. Candidate file contents were checked against the verification copy, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent source review found no remaining issue after corrections. The Qwen-specific CLI `/review` orchestration was not run.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Key | Before | After |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Backspace | ![Image remains](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zhangchenhao-111/qwen-code/d01a566bcd829163be983ef27e2a64b132e74760/contribution-evidence/10794/before-Backspace-pressed.png) | ![Image removed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zhangchenhao-111/qwen-code/d01a566bcd829163be983ef27e2a64b132e74760/contribution-evidence/10794/after-Backspace-pressed.png) |
| Delete | ![Image remains](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zhangchenhao-111/qwen-code/d01a566bcd829163be983ef27e2a64b132e74760/contribution-evidence/10794/before-Delete-pressed.png) | ![Image removed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zhangchenhao-111/qwen-code/d01a566bcd829163be983ef27e2a64b132e74760/contribution-evidence/10794/after-Delete-pressed.png) |

These are real Edge screenshots of the actual Web Shell running against the existing mocked-daemon fixture. Both keys left one image on the baseline and zero on the patched checkout. This does not establish connectivity to a real daemon or model provider.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Tested: Node 22.23.2, Edge headless, DOM regression tests |
| Linux | Not tested |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: keyboard priority; existing tag handling and selection/caret conditions are unchanged, and the new fallback requires an empty body.
- Not validated: mobile keyboard behavior and real-provider connectivity. The global `qwen` command is unavailable locally; browser verification uses the actual Web Shell instead.
- Breaking changes: none.
- AI disclosure: Codex assisted with analysis, implementation, tests, review and this description. This is not a claim that the account holder personally read and approved the code.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #10794

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

桌面 Web Shell 输入框的正文为空且没有可删除的上下文标签时，允许 Backspace 和 Delete 删除最后一个文件附件，或在没有文件时删除最后一张粘贴图片。保留已有上下文标签删除顺序、光标和选区条件，并加入回归测试及键盘操作文档。

## 修改原因

目前只有图片的草稿会忽略这两个按键，用户只能点击删除按钮。本修复落实了维护者在 #10794 根因评论中提出的附件回退方案。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方法

将图片粘贴到正文为空的桌面 Web Shell 输入框，聚焦编辑器并按 Backspace 或 Delete。修复前图片仍在，修复后图片被删除。多个附件时，每次只删除最后一个文件，文件删完再删除图片。有正文时保留文件和图片附件。新增的八个 DOM 案例覆盖两种按键、连续删除、正文及混合附件。

- 最新源代码基线上的新增附件套件及既有输入框套件共 108 项 DOM 测试通过。真实 Edge 浏览器在模拟 daemon 下的两种按键修复前后共四个场景通过，未验证真实模型服务。
- 在 `23add5e` 的合并验证副本中，冻结依赖安装、格式、lint、构建和类型检查已完成并通过；并非三个独立分支各跑了一次完整 preflight。
- **全量 preflight 未通过。** Windows 的 ACP 测试为 2,624 通过、14 失败、8 跳过；这 14 项均在创建符号链接夹具时遇到 `EPERM`。CLI 测试也报告了重启预期和文件锁清理等失败，记录的工作区测试未完成全部套件。独立脚本测试为 1,805 通过、26 失败、202 跳过，包含符号链接权限、临时验证副本缺少 Git 元数据/skill 文件及 shell 夹具失败。尚未在干净上游复现并归类全部失败，不声称所有测试通过。
- 发布基线为 `e17ad4c`；中间新增的三次提交没有修改本轮 PR 涉及的文件。候选文件内容与验证副本一致，`git diff --check` 通过。
- 修正发现的问题后，独立源代码审阅未发现剩余问题；未执行 Qwen 专用 CLI 的 `/review` 编排。

### 修复前后证据

截图见上方表格。它们来自实际 Web Shell 在既有模拟 daemon 场景下运行的真实 Edge 浏览器。基线中两种按键都留下一个图片，修复后都变为零个。这不能证明真实 daemon 或模型服务的连接情况。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 未测试 |
| Windows | 已测试：Node 22.23.2、无界面 Edge、DOM 回归测试 |
| Linux | 未测试 |

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：键盘操作优先级；保留已有标签处理和选区、光标条件，新增回退要求正文为空。
- 未验证：移动端键盘和真实服务连接。本地没有全局 `qwen` 命令，浏览器验证使用实际 Web Shell。
- 破坏性变更：无。
- AI 使用披露：Codex 协助分析、实现、测试、审阅和撰写说明。这不表示账号本人已亲自阅读并批准代码。

## 关联问题

修复 #10794。

</details>


## Follow-up verification — 2026-10-13

Addressed R1-1 and R1-2: attachment deletion now pauses while an image batch is being ingested. Regression coverage exercises both keys during a paused real FileReader read, removable-tag precedence, and the non-removable-tag fallback. Before the guard, the two ingestion cases failed and the other twelve passed; after the fix, the focused fourteen and the existing one hundred composer DOM cases passed (114 total). Web Shell TypeScript checking, changed-file ESLint, Prettier, and diff whitespace checks passed. An independent test engineer reran the fourteen focused cases, and an independent local source review found no further finding. These follow-up checks use the actual hook in jsdom; no new release-bundle, real-daemon, real-model, mobile or full-workspace verification was performed. Earlier full-preflight limitations remain applicable. Codex assisted with this follow-up; this does not certify personal human code review.

### 中文：本轮修订

处理两条反馈：图片批次读取期间暂停附件删除；补齐两键的异步读取、可删除标签优先级和固定标签回退测试。新增测试在原代码上有 2 项失败，修复后相关 DOM 测试共 114 项通过；类型检查、修改文件 lint、格式和空白检查通过。独立验证重跑 14 项聚焦测试。未重新验证发布 bundle、真实 daemon/模型或全工作区；原先披露的限制仍适用。

## Review follow-up — 2026-10-14

Addressed the round-2 auto-repeat finding: holding Backspace/Delete can clear text but no longer walks through staged images, files, or folded pasted-text cards. A highest-precedence, non-consuming keydown recorder runs before the keymap; only the attachment fallback rejects repeat events, and a fresh deliberate press still deletes one attachment. The pre-existing tag path is unchanged. Removed the unnecessary Promise wrapper around the synchronous ingestion call in the regression fixture.

Verification: the eight added repeat cases failed at the previous head (14 passed, 8 failed); all 122 related DOM cases now pass (22 attachment, 100 existing composer). An independent engineer reran the 22 focused cases. Temporarily removing the repeat guard using a test-only transform yields the same eight failures. The actual attachment test file was explicitly included in a separate TypeScript check and passed; changed-file ESLint, Prettier and whitespace checks passed. No new full-workspace build/preflight, release-bundle, real daemon/model or mobile verification is claimed. Earlier build/preflight limitations remain disclosed. Codex assisted with implementation and independent verification; no personal human-read certification is asserted.

### 中文：本轮修订

处理长按删除键连续清空附件的问题，记录按键自动连发状态并仅阻止附件回退删除；主动再次按键仍可删除一项，原标签行为保持。删除测试中同步 ingestFiles 的错误 Promise 包装。修改前新增 8 项失败；修复后相关 DOM 测试 122 项通过，独立重跑 22 项通过；移除 guard 后同样 8 项失败。新增测试文件单独类型检查、lint、格式检查通过。本轮未声称完成完整 preflight 或真实服务验证。

CI baseline follow-up: merged upstream main at 1f39a80bf01f7064e23acda7146cabf398070f85 using a normal two-parent merge after the lint-gate freshness check required it. The earlier lint job stopped at that freshness gate, before application lint/tests. The refreshed CI is pending; no green claim is made. The actual merged composer content was rechecked: all 122 related DOM tests passed, and its local formatting/lint checks passed. Remote contents match the verified files; local line-ending normalization required no further remote code change.

## Review follow-up — 2026-10-15

Addressed R3-1 and R3-2. Repeat suppression now applies before both tag and attachment deletion. An admitted empty-text prompt is cleared when its only intervening change was removal of submitted images/files; newly added attachments or edited text still preserve the new draft. The separate isCurrentDraft identity semantics are unchanged.

Before the fix, the two tag-repeat and two image-commit cases failed (26 passed, 4 failed). Two test-only mutations failed exactly the targeted cases: the old repeat placement fails two tag cases; restoring attachment-reference equality fails four image/file commit cases. prs.title: fix(managed-agent): bound retry loops with terminal states
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Across the managed-agent stack, asynchronous retry loops had no terminal state, and in one case a permanently wedged projection. This change gives every loop a budget and a terminal state: the message projection heals past a provably permanent sequence gap instead of throwing on every scan — settling as failed any items whose turn's terminal event was in the skipped range — and the scanner itself backs off per session (exponential to a 60s cap, surfaced loudly once) so a deterministic failure can no longer flood the log at 10Hz; admitted turns converge to a bounded terminal failure once their retry budget is spent; lifecycle operations whose settle can never succeed terminate `failed` with the settle's failure code kept (the Session keeps its pending status — nothing certifies a completion that never happened) — except while a live journal writer means the close can still succeed, which keeps waiting; a blocked workspace close keeps its failure code through every attempt and through the terminal record; a failed action response whose Action is still waiting is re-admitted by the caller's retry under the same idempotency key instead of returning a stale failure receipt forever; a memory-blocked embedded scheduler arms its own recheck wake so a missed capacity notification can no longer starve queued work; transient store IO failures are retried within the lease window (renewals) or retried bounded before abandoning (releases), a consecutive-failure streak halts the worker loudly when a "transient" outage is really persistent, and a per-activation budget records a terminal outcome instead of re-running forever; session close seals the writer in a finally; and a failed HTTP seal throws loudly out of that finally while the grant lapses with the lease, so a takeover can proceed. There is deliberately no seal retry (issue #13182 item 6b): keeping the grant renewed was found in review to let a stale client seal the journal out from under a freshly re-attached session, so the bounded-retry cut was withdrawn and 6b is answered by the loud throw plus the grant lapse.

## Why it's needed

Audit of the retry loops (issue #13182) found: a single event-sequence gap wedged a session's projection forever while the scanner logged the same stack at 10Hz; an admitted turn failing transiently was rescheduled without bound; a close/delete whose settle can never succeed retried forever; a missed capacity notification starved queued activations silently; one transient renewal error bricked the embedded scheduler; and a failed close could leave a writer unsealed, blocking both clean resume and takeover. The fail-closed posture of the session authority is correct — the layers around it treated transient IO failures as indistinguishable from consistency damage. Review of the first cut found the remaining gaps this wave closes: the exhaustion arm used the success-path completion write (erasing the blocked failure code and certifying an unsettled close), the gap heal left orphaned items streaming forever, the materializer's other permanent failure modes still spun at 10Hz, the scheduler's transient retry had no escalation bound, the first cut's renewal-keeping seal retry let a stale client seal the journal under a re-attached session (withdrawn in favor of the loud throw), and a budget-terminated action answer could never be re-delivered.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The affected paths are not reachable from the CLI binary (the Java control plane needs a deployed broker; the embedded scheduler is hardened ahead of its first production wiring), so the evidence is the new regression suites, each verified to fail on the pre-fix code and pass after:

- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server`: `mvn test` — 2096 tests; the full suite is green except two pre-existing `ToolPublicationStoreTest` timing errors that reproduce identically on base, and one `ChildWorktreeGitTest` non-UTF8-name case that fails only on macOS's sh (identical on main). Key suites: `MessageProjectionGapHealTest` (real H2 + real transaction boundary: a gapped projection heals, the gap is logged once naming only the truly missing sequences, a lost `turn.completed` settles its orphaned items as failed, and a second-connection `FOR UPDATE` witness pins that the scan holds the session row lock the permanence premise rests on), `MessageMaterializerTest` (backoff + surface-once + reset on success), `AdmittedTurnRetryTerminalStateTest` (budget boundary 9 retries / 10 terminates, configured budgets honored, both the daemon-503 and broker arms), `OperationRetryTerminalStateTest` (budget boundary, configured budgets, the committed-decision arm, the live-writer gate, the blocked-code-preserving terminal, the bound-session workspace-close routing, the terminal-record-failure fallback), `ManagedActionStoreTest` (stage invariants + re-admission of a FAILED response while the Action is still requested), `SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest` (a blocked close stays blocked below the budget).
- `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime` — 3281 tests (one known under-load-only flake that passes in isolation). Coverage includes journal tail repair fault injection (torn write repaired, unrepairable write halts, first-write ENOENT is transient, vanished journal is fatal), the scheduler's claim/renewal/release retry policies, the transient-streak halt, per-activation budget convergence, dispose-race wake guards, the memory-blocked poll's decelerating cadence (one store scan per tick, doubling from 1s to a 30s cap, with a cancelled-queue tick clearing the block), and the seal failure path's loud throw with the grant left to lapse.
- `npm run build && npm run bundle` and `npm run typecheck` pass; `packages/web-shell` OpenAPI contract sync test passes (the generated client was regenerated after the contract description update).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit/integration-level verification only (H2 in-memory for the Java broker, fault-injection fs mocks for the TS store); the hosted paths are covered by the suites above rather than a live broker.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a turn/operation/action that keeps failing transiently now reaches a terminal failure instead of retrying forever — that is the intended change; budgets are configurable (`dispatch.max-post-admission-retries`, `dispatch.max-operation-retries`, both default 10) and validated at startup. A lifecycle operation that hits the budget now reads `failed` with a failure code instead of `completed` — the more honest answer, and the one the contract text now describes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the embedded scheduler has no production caller yet (hardened ahead of wiring, disclosed in test comments); the MySQL-backed `*IT` integration tests run in CI's Hosted process fault gates lane (locally they need Docker/MySQL); the materializer backoff is in-memory (a persisted terminal consumer-progress state is a possible follow-up if operators need it to survive restarts).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the startup validation now rejects `max-pre-admission-retries` greater than `max-post-admission-retries` — a combination that was accepted before (and silently stripped late-admitted turns of retries). Deployments with that combination in external config must align the two keys before upgrading; the error message names both values. Otherwise: two new optional config keys with safe defaults; one new turn failure code; new lifecycle/action failure codes (free-form string fields, no enum change).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13182

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

managed-agent 栈中的异步重试环路此前没有终态，其中一处会让投影永久卡死。本次改为给每个环路预算与终态：消息投影在遇到可证永久的事件序号缺口时自愈越过——并把终结事件落在缺口区间的 turn 的在途 item 置为 failed——不再每次扫描都抛错，扫描器自身也按 session 退避（指数退避封顶 60 秒，超预算后响亮上报一次），确定性失败不再以 10Hz 刷日志；已受理的 turn 在重试预算耗尽后收敛到有界终态；settle 永远无法成功的生命周期操作以 `failed` 终结并保留 settle 的失败码（Session 保持待定状态——不再为从未发生的完成出具凭证）——除非 journal writer 仍存活，此时 close 仍可能成功，operation 继续等待；被阻塞的 workspace close 在每次尝试与终态记录中都保留其失败码；Action 仍在等待应答的失败 action response 可被调用方按同一幂等键重试重新受理，而不是永远返回陈旧的失败回执；内存不足的嵌入式调度器会自行武装复检唤醒，错过容量通知不再让排队激活永久饥饿；瞬时存储 IO 失败在租约窗口内重试（续约）或有界重试后再放弃（释放），连续失败计数会在"瞬时"故障实为持续故障时响亮地 halt worker，按激活的预算则记录终态而不是无限重跑；会话关闭在 finally 中保证封存 writer；HTTP 封存失败会从该 finally 中响亮抛出，并让授权随租约失效，使接管得以进行。此处刻意不做封存重试（issue #13182 第 6b 项）：评审发现保持续约会让陈旧客户端在新会话重新挂载后从其手中封存 journal，因此有界重试方案被撤回，6b 由响亮抛错加授权失效来回答。

## 为什么需要

对重试环路的审计（issue #13182）发现：一个事件序号缺口会让该会话的投影永久停摆，扫描器以 10Hz 重复打印同一堆栈；瞬时失败的已受理 turn 被无上限重排；永远无法 settle 的 close/delete 无限重试；一次遗漏的容量通知会让排队激活静默饥饿；一次瞬时续约错误就让嵌入式调度器报废到进程重启；失败的 close 可能留下未封存的 writer，既不能干净恢复也不能被接管。会话 authority 的 fail-closed 姿态本身是对的——问题是外围各层把瞬时传输/IO 失败与一致性损坏混为一谈。对第一版实现的评审发现了本轮修复的剩余缺口：预算耗尽分支此前复用成功路径的完成写入（抹掉被阻塞的失败码，并为从未 settle 的关闭出具凭证）；gap 自愈让失去 turn 终结事件的 item 永远停在"流式"状态；materializer 的其他永久失败模式仍以 10Hz 空转；调度器的瞬态重试没有升级上限；第一版保持续约的封存重试会让陈旧客户端在新会话重新挂载后被其封存 journal（已撤回，改为响亮抛错）；预算耗尽的 action 应答永远无法再投递。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

受影响路径无法从 CLI 二进制触达（Java 控制面需要部署的 broker；嵌入式调度器在首次生产接线前完成加固），因此证据是新增的回归套件，每个都已在修复前代码上验证为红、修复后转绿：

- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server`：`mvn test` —— 2096 个测试；除两个在基线上同样复现的既有 `ToolPublicationStoreTest` 时序错误，以及一个仅在 macOS sh 上失败的 `ChildWorktreeGitTest` 非 UTF8 命名用例（在 main 上同样失败）外全绿。关键套件：`MessageProjectionGapHealTest`（真实 H2 + 真实事务边界：缺口投影自愈、缺口只记录一次且只命名真正缺失的序号、丢失 `turn.completed` 时其孤立 item 被置为 failed、第二连接 `FOR UPDATE` 见证钉住"扫描持有 Session 行锁"这一自愈前提）、`MessageMaterializerTest`（退避 + 一次性上报 + 成功后重置）、`AdmittedTurnRetryTerminalStateTest`（预算边界 9 重试 / 10 终结、配置预算生效、daemon-503 与 broker 两臂）、`OperationRetryTerminalStateTest`（预算边界、配置预算、已提交决定分支、存活 writer 闸门、保留失败码的终态、绑定 Session 的 workspace 关闭路由、终态写入失败的回退）、`ManagedActionStoreTest`（stage 不变式 + Action 仍在等待时 FAILED 行的重新受理）、`SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest`（预算内被阻塞的 close 保持阻塞）。
- `packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/managed-runtime` —— 3281 个测试（一个仅在负载下出现、单独运行通过的既有 flake）。覆盖含 journal 尾部修复故障注入（撕裂写入可修复、不可修复则熔断、首写 ENOENT 为瞬时、日志消失为致命）、调度器 claim/续约/释放重试策略、瞬态连续失败熔断、按激活预算收敛、dispose 竞态唤醒保护、内存阻塞轮询的减速节拍（每 tick 一次存储扫描，从 1 秒翻倍至 30 秒封顶，队列被清空的那一拍解除阻塞），以及封存失败路径的响亮抛错与授权失效。
- `npm run build && npm run bundle` 与 `npm run typecheck` 通过；`packages/web-shell` 的 OpenAPI 契约同步测试通过（契约描述更新后已重新生成客户端）。

### 前后对比证据

N/A —— 无用户可见的 UI 变更。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元/集成级验证（Java broker 用 H2 内存库，TS store 用故障注入 fs mock）；hosted 路径由上述套件覆盖，未跑真实 broker。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：持续瞬时失败的 turn/operation/action 现在会到达终态而不是无限重试——这正是预期变更；预算可配置（`dispatch.max-post-admission-retries`、`dispatch.max-operation-retries`，默认均为 10）并在启动时校验。命中预算的生命周期操作现在读作 `failed` 并带失败码，而不是 `completed`——这是更诚实的回答，也是契约文本现在描述的回答。
- 未验证/超出范围：嵌入式调度器尚无生产调用方（在接线前完成加固，已在测试注释中声明）；MySQL 版 `*IT` 集成测试由 CI 的 Hosted process fault gates 通道运行（本地需要 Docker/MySQL）；materializer 的退避在内存中（若运维需要跨重启的终态 consumer-progress，可作为后续工作）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：启动校验现在会拒绝 `max-pre-admission-retries` 大于 `max-post-admission-retries` 的配置——该组合在以前是合法的（并且会静默地剥夺迟受理 turn 的重试）。外部配置中存在该组合的部署需要在升级前对齐两个键；报错信息会指明两个值。除此之外：新增两个带安全默认值的可选配置键；turn 侧新增一个失败码；lifecycle/action 侧新增失败码（自由字符串字段，无枚举变更）。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13182

</details>

prs.title: fix(rewind): resolve legacy turns by source identity
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Conversation rewind links visible messages, model entries and recorded boundaries through source identity, or refuses before mutation. A recovered legacy conversation key cannot authorize file restore.

Retry, resume and JSON history rollback preserve that identity. Daemon-backed interfaces additionally associate checkpoints with the existing admitted prompt identity: `turnIndex` remains the raw snapshot position, not a visible-turn ordinal. WebShell and VS Code select uniquely associated messages; rewind notifications remove that message and its suffix. Optimistic messages bind to their exact admitted block.

## Why it's needed

Legacy placeholder-shaped prompts could disappear visibly while remaining in model context. Retry snapshots and invisible ordinary turns could also shift a recorded cut. The identity filter introduced a further regression: snapshots can be at raw positions 0/2 while the UI shows only A/B. Neither raw position nor eligible-list rank safely identifies the displayed message after retry or compression.

This is #9437's source-identity follow-up. #13729 separately handled #11408 and is merged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Resume legacy `hello`, `[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`, `world` and their replies. Rewind the second prompt: visible, next-request and cold-restored histories should retain only `hello` and its reply. Recovered keys must not restore files.
- Fail A, retry it successfully, then submit B. Edit B and resend: A remains, old B/reply disappear and edited B appears once. Check raw 0/2 checkpoints still refer to their original positions while B's admitted identity matches its checkpoint and notification. Repeat with recording disabled.
- Check a retained target after a compressed prefix, an invisible ordinary image turn, and JSON history echo. Unique source associations must still resolve; missing or duplicated associations must refuse without selecting a different turn. Rewind metadata must not reach the model.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The [current real-producer report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6139059338) compares `4c0d03fcde` with `f71ff86f4febeb0b353a005da6b6b826a8cd485b`: browser composer admission → actual source daemon/ACP → recorder or recording-disabled association → checkpoint catalog → rewind notification → next model request. It reproduces the post-retry edit failure before and successful identity-backed edit after. Read-only SDK state logging observes optimistic block binding; the harness does not supply association fields.

Earlier [Ink/tmux and ACP evidence](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6077085058) remains revision-pinned historical evidence, not a fresh final-head execution. The [eligible-rank experiment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6137596597) was withdrawn and is not used as fix evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ current real WebShell/daemon/ACP chain; historical Ink/tmux |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2, Chromium/Playwright, isolated profiles and loopback controlled OpenAI endpoint. Root build and workspace/integration typecheck pass; changed-file lint/format and focused regression tests pass. No full test suite or CI wait. See the report for exact source pins and counts.

## Risk & Scope

- Compatibility is deliberately fail-closed. Old unassociated ACP histories and persisted custom slash/skill invocation rows may refuse conversation rewind. Updated daemon interfaces require a unique association; older producers lacking it cannot authorize an edit by ordinal. Legacy numeric notifications retain their old interpretation for older senders.
- The catalog/notification additions reuse an already persisted daemon identity. No new identity counter, transcript schema, dependency, route or setting. Raw numeric ACP targets and snapshot creation are unchanged. The prior unconditional pre-send identity mark is preserved.
- `44 files, +1934/-1044: implementation26 +446/-207; regression16 +1357/-814; existing bilingual designs2 +131/-23`. The larger file surface is the necessary producer-to-consumer repair of R3-1, not a new feature/refactor. Remaining Suggestions stay in #13869; #13794 remains separate maintenance. The real collector fixture incidentally strengthens item12's coverage, without adding its proposed predicate refactor.
- Not validated: native model-driven compression, actual VS Code webview UI, Windows/Linux, unwired OpenTUI, every slash-entry timing, changed-file byte restoration or full native CI-review engine. Compression and VS Code mapping have focused source regression checks. No approval, merge, release or issue closure is claimed.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #9437; separate from merged #9466 and #13729. No issue is auto-closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

对话回退通过来源身份关联可见消息、模型条目和录制边界，无法关联则在变更前拒绝。恢复出的旧对话 key 不能授权文件恢复。

重试、恢复和 JSON 历史回滚保留该身份。Daemon 界面另用既有准入 prompt 身份关联检查点：`turnIndex` 仍是原始快照位置，不是可见轮次编号。WebShell 和 VS Code 选择唯一关联的消息；回退通知移除该消息及后缀。乐观消息绑定到确切的准入 block。

## 为什么需要

旧占位符形状 prompt 可能从可见历史消失，却仍在模型上下文。重试快照和不可见普通轮次也可能使录制截断错位。身份过滤另引入回归：原始快照位于 0/2，但界面只显示 A/B。重试或压缩后，原始位置和可选列表序号都不能安全识别可见消息。

这是 #9437 的来源身份后续。#13729 独立处理 #11408，已合并。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 恢复 `hello`、`[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`、`world` 及各自回答，回退第二轮：可见、下一请求和冷恢复历史应只保留 `hello` 及回答。恢复 key 不得恢复文件。
- 让 A 失败、重试成功，再提交 B。编辑 B 重发：A 保留，旧 B/回答消失，编辑后的 B 只出现一次。原始 0/2 检查点位置保持不变，B 的准入身份与检查点、通知一致。关闭录制后重复检查。
- 检查压缩前缀之后的保留目标、不可见普通图片轮次和 JSON 历史回传。唯一来源关联仍可解析；缺失或重复关联不得选中另一轮。回退元数据不得进入模型请求。

### 证据（Before & After）

[本次真实链路报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6139059338) 对比 `4c0d03fcde` 与 `f71ff86f4febeb0b353a005da6b6b826a8cd485b`：浏览器输入准入 → 实际源码 daemon/ACP → 记录器或关闭录制时的关联 → 检查点列表 → 回退通知 → 下一模型请求。修复前复现重试后的编辑失败，修复后按身份编辑成功。只读 SDK 状态日志观察乐观 block 绑定；验证脚本不提供关联字段。

较早的 [Ink/tmux 与 ACP 证据](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6077085058) 保持原版本绑定，不冒充最终 head 的新执行。[列表序号实验](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6137596597) 已撤回，不作为修复证据。

### 测试环境

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本次真实 WebShell/daemon/ACP 链路；历史 Ink/tmux |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.2、Chromium/Playwright、隔离配置和本地受控 OpenAI 接口。根目录构建、工作空间/集成 typecheck、改动文件 lint/format 和定向回归测试通过。未跑全量测试，未等待 CI。准确源码版本和数量见报告。

## 风险与范围

- 明确采用失败关闭兼容边界。无关联的旧 ACP 历史及持久化自定义 slash/skill 调用行可能拒绝对话回退。更新后的 daemon 界面要求唯一关联；缺少该字段的旧发送方不能凭轮次授权编辑。旧数字通知仍按原语义兼容旧发送方。
- 检查点/通知新增字段复用已持久化的 daemon 身份。不新增身份计数器、transcript schema、依赖、路由或配置。原始数字 ACP 目标、快照创建和此前无条件的发送前身份标记保持不变。
- `44 files, +1934/-1044: implementation26 +446/-207; regression16 +1357/-814; existing bilingual designs2 +131/-23`。文件面增加来自 R3-1 必要的生产端至消费端修复，不是新功能或重构。其余 Suggestions 保留在 #13869；#13794 仍是独立维护事项。真实 collector fixture 顺带增强 item12 的覆盖，没有加入其建议的谓词重构。
- 未验证：自然模型压缩、实际 VS Code webview 界面、Windows/Linux、未接线 OpenTUI、所有 slash 时序、变更文件字节恢复和完整原生 CI-review 引擎。压缩和 VS Code 映射有定向源码回归检查。不声明已批准、合并、发布或关闭 issue。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issues

Refs #9437；与已合并的 #9466、#13729 分开。不自动关闭 issue。

prs.title: fix(cli): Make interactive questions answerable from standard ACP hosts
prs.body:
## What this PR does The interactive question tool (`ask_user_question`) is projected onto the Agent Client Protocol as a permission request, but the real per-question choices only ever travelled in a Qwen-specific metadata field that the protocol tells conforming clients to ignore. A standard ACP host therefore rendered a raw JSON payload, and the user could not actually answer: the single visible button submitted an empty answer. This PR makes the question answerable everywhere by projecting the question text and every choice into the standard tool-call content, and — for clients that do not opt in to the Qwen question payload — by offering real per-choice options in the permission request, exactly like an ordinary approval prompt, with the answer recovered from the option the user picks. Clients that do understand the Qwen payload keep their existing rich flow unchanged. ## Why it's needed Today the question tool is unusable through any ACP host that does not implement Qwen's private contract: the user sees "Raw Input", and even pressing the one available button returns nothing, because the answer was read from a response field the protocol does not define. This is the bug reported in the linked issue. The fix also has to avoid regressing the Qwen-owned surfaces — the VS Code companion, the web shell, channel cards, the daemon bridge, and the voice client — all of which consume the rich payload today. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify A reviewer can confirm the behavior with the focused test suites; no IDE is required: ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` Expected outcomes to check in the tests: - With the capability absent, a single question produces one option per choice, followed by `Other…` and `Cancel`; picking one returns the matching label. - With the capability advertised (as the in-repo Qwen clients do), the generic `Submit`/`Cancel` pair is preserved. - A multi-question request is not flattened — the questions and choices still appear as readable content. - The question text and every choice are present in the standard tool-call content regardless of capability. ### Evidence (Before & After) Zed end-to-end, same prompt (one question, two options: `Day.js` / `date-fns`). **Before** — the question arrives as a raw JSON payload and the only actions are `Submit` and `Cancel`; submitting returns nothing, so the tool reports "No valid answers were provided.". **After** — the question is readable and every choice is a real selectable option, alongside `Other…` and `Cancel`. **After, round-trip** — picking `Day.js` is delivered to the model as the answer, and the agent continues with it. Focused suites and checks: ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment (optional) Unit tests and type checks, plus a Zed end-to-end run against a local build of this branch (Zed custom agent launching `--acp`). No sandbox was used. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the new flat option list only applies when a client does not advertise the Qwen question capability, so the blast radius is limited to non-Qwen ACP hosts. The content projection is additive and ignored by clients that render their own question card. - Not validated / out of scope: a multi-question request (2–4 questions) is intentionally not flattened, because the protocol has no multi-form primitive and interleaving choices from different questions would be ambiguous; those questions are shown as text and remain fully answerable only from the Qwen-compatible surfaces. `multiSelect` questions degrade to a single choice. Sequential per-question permission requests are not implemented. The Zed run above covers a single, single-select question; the multi-question and `multiSelect` cases were not exercised in Zed. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none for the Qwen-owned clients, which keep the same option set. One behaviour change for third-party ACP hosts and external harnesses that auto-approve by selecting the first `allow_once` option: on a flattened question that is now the first choice, where it previously hit `proceed_once` and produced a visible "No valid answers were provided." — worth a release note. ## Linked Issues Fixes #11361 Design document (both language versions): - [English](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.md) - [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.zh-CN.md)
中文说明 ## What this PR does（本 PR 做了什么） 交互式提问工具（`ask_user_question`）目前被投影为 Agent Client Protocol 的一次权限请求，但真正的逐题选项只通过 Qwen 专有的元数据字段传递，而协议要求符合规范的客户端忽略该字段。因此标准 ACP 宿主只能渲染原始 JSON，用户实际上无法作答：唯一可见的按钮提交的是空答案。本 PR 让问题在所有宿主上都能作答：始终把问题文本与每个选项投影进标准工具调用内容；对于未声明支持 Qwen 问题载荷的客户端，直接在权限请求中给出真实的逐选项选项（与普通审批提示完全一致），并从用户所选的选项恢复答案。理解 Qwen 载荷的客户端保持原有丰富流程不变。 ## Why it's needed（为什么需要） 目前，任何未实现 Qwen 私有契约的 ACP 宿主都无法使用该提问工具：用户看到的是 "Raw Input"，而且即使按下唯一可用的按钮也不会返回任何内容，因为答案是从协议未定义的响应字段读取的。这正是所链接 issue 报告的问题。该修复还必须避免回退 Qwen 自有界面——VS Code 伴侣、Web Shell、渠道卡片、daemon bridge 以及语音客户端——它们目前消费的是丰富载荷。 ## Reviewer Test Plan（评审测试计划） ### How to verify（如何验证） 评审者可用聚焦测试套件确认行为，无需 IDE： ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` 测试中应确认的结果： - 未声明能力时，单个问题为每个选项给出一个选项，其后是 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`；选择其一即返回对应标签。 - 声明能力时（仓库内 Qwen 客户端即如此），保留通用的 `Submit`/`Cancel` 按钮对。 - 多问题请求不会被扁平化——问题与选项仍以可读内容呈现。 - 无论能力如何，问题文本与每个选项都出现在标准工具调用内容中。 ### Evidence (Before & After)（证据） Zed 端到端，同一提示词（一个问题，两个选项：`Day.js` / `date-fns`）。 **Before**——问题以原始 JSON 形式到达，仅有的操作是 `Submit` 与 `Cancel`；提交后不会返回任何内容，因此工具报告 "No valid answers were provided."。 **After**——问题可读，每个选项都是真正可选的选项，另有 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`。 **After，往返**——选择 `Day.js` 会作为答案传回模型，agent 随之继续。 聚焦测试套件与检查： ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on（测试平台） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment（环境） 单元测试与类型检查，外加使用本分支本地构建的 Zed 端到端运行（Zed 自定义 agent 启动 `--acp`）。未使用 sandbox。 ## Risk & Scope（风险与范围） - 主要风险或取舍：新的扁平选项列表仅在客户端未声明 Qwen 问题能力时生效，影响范围限于非 Qwen 的 ACP 宿主。内容投影为增量改动，会渲染自有问题卡片的客户端会忽略它。 - 未验证 / 范围之外：多问题请求（2–4 个问题）有意不扁平化，因为协议没有多表单原语，把不同问题的选项交错会产生歧义；这些问题以文本呈现，且仅在 Qwen 兼容界面中可完整作答。`multiSelect` 问题降级为单选。未实现逐题顺序权限请求。上文的 Zed 运行仅覆盖单个单选问题；多问题与 `multiSelect` 情形未在 Zed 中验证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对 Qwen 自有客户端无破坏性，选项集合保持不变。对通过「选择第一个 `allow_once` 选项」自动批准的第三方 ACP 宿主与外部测试框架：扁平化问题现在会把该第一个选项记录为答案，而此前会命中 `proceed_once` 并产生可见的 "No valid answers were provided."——建议在 release notes 中说明。 ## Linked Issues（关联 Issue） Fixes #11361 设计文档（中英双版本）： - prs.title: feat(core): account tool result sizes from producer to injection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Tool results carry raw, processed and final submitted size estimates across existing output-reduction boundaries. Injection is recorded once per newly executed call after final budgeting and media handling; retries, inherited fork history and replay do not recount it. Restored raw sizes remain unknown. New size records exclude output bodies, arguments, local paths and digests, and internal provenance never enters provider JSON.

Oversized results retain complete recoverable originals. Bounded JSON samples preserve original keys and disclose omissions; metadata stays outside the payload namespace. Web extraction retains its existing processing input while the complete outward envelope follows ordinary limits. Configured media estimates and actual reduction budgets are carried through persistence, batch and injection. Cancellation or hook replacements cannot claim producer savings.

## Why it's needed

A late preview length cannot explain original result size, where it was reduced or what was submitted. The same pipeline must also preserve recovery pointers and prevent sample corruption, repeated accounting and misleading budget attribution.

Design: [English](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Produce oversized text or valid JSON; confirm complete originals remain recoverable, the preview fits its budget and original sample keys/values survive.
- Continue with inherited history or retry; confirm prior calls are not counted again, and an unchanged tiny sibling has no aggregate truncation claim.
- Return an image with a configured estimate, or reject webpage extraction; confirm actual submitted size reflects retained media and the final outward limit, while extraction still receives a distant needle.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Local macOS native CLI, stdio MCP, production file logs/metrics and matched120x40 tmux runs are recorded in the [closeout report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13652#issuecomment-6080274673). Baseline sample corruption, media-config mismatch, repeated inherited injection and102699-character web envelope were reproduced. Controlled candidate runs preserve originals and correct accounting; the long web result is2621 characters. Exact source hashes, final getter-order delta reuse, all26 attempts and screenshot boundaries are stated in the report.

Core/CLI build and typecheck, changed-file lint/format pass. Core1888 related tests are covered by passing results and595 affected reruns;98 logger and1188 ACP tests pass. Two independent source/ponytail passes found no remaining confirmed owned Critical.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ controlled native CLI/tmux plus unit checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

## Risk & Scope

- Main tradeoff: additional per-call numeric telemetry and in-memory provenance; this measures internal submitted estimates, not provider billing or delivery acknowledgement.
- Outside scope: representative real-model quality, complete cost/P95, telemetry-backend deployment and optional histogram/registry/no-op-layer tuning. Ordinary25k/1000, independent200k aggregate and MCP500k policies remain unchanged; MCP default convergence requires a separate product decision. Pressure-aware budgeting stays in #13599.
- Migration: no new setting, dependency or persisted transcript format.

## Linked Issues

Addresses #11536 size accounting and oversized-output recovery. The separate MCP default-policy decision is not closed by this PR. Split from #13599.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

工具结果在现有缩减边界上携带原始、处理后和最终提交的大小估算。注入事件在最终预算和媒体处理之后，按新执行调用记一次；重试、fork继承历史和重放不会重复计数。恢复结果的原始大小保持未知。新的大小记录不含结果正文、参数、本地路径或摘要；内部来源信息不会进入provider JSON。

超大结果保留可恢复的完整原文。受限JSON样本保留原始键并说明省略，元数据不覆盖载荷键。网页提取保留原有处理输入，完整外层返回遵守普通额度。配置化媒体估算及实际缩减预算贯穿落盘、批量和注入；取消或hook替换不会冒报生产者节省。

## 为什么需要

只有最终预览长度，无法说明原文多大、哪里缩减、最终提交多少。同一流程还要保留恢复指针，避免样本损坏、重复计数及错误预算归属。设计文档：[English](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.zh-CN.md)。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 产生超大文本或合法JSON，确认原文完整可恢复，预览符合预算，样本的原始键和值没有被改写。
- 继承历史继续调用或重试，确认旧调用不重复计数，未改变的小结果不会冒报批量裁剪。
- 返回配置化估算的图片，或让网页提取失败，确认实际提交计量包含保留的媒体并遵守最终外层上限，内部处理仍能读到较远的针值。

### 前后证据

本地macOS原生CLI、stdio MCP、生产文件日志/指标和120x40配对tmux记录见[收尾报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13652#issuecomment-6080274673)。已复现旧样本损坏、媒体配置不生效、继承注入重复统计及102699字符网页外层越界；受控候选保留原文并修正计量，长网页最终为2621字符。报告明确列出源码指纹、最终getter顺序修复的增量复用、全部26次尝试及截图能证明的范围。

core/CLI构建、类型检查和定向lint/格式检查通过。相关core1888项由通过结果及595项受影响复测覆盖，98项日志及1188项ACP测试通过。两份独立源码/ponytail审查未发现剩余已确认的自有Critical。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 受控原生CLI/tmux及单测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：增加逐调用数值遥测和内存来源信息；这些是内部提交估算，不是provider账单或送达确认。
- 不在范围内：代表性真实模型质量、完整成本/P95、遥测后端部署及可选直方图/词汇表/无变化层调优。普通25k/1000、独立200k聚合和MCP500k策略保留；MCP默认值统一另需产品决定。随上下文压力调整的预算仍在#13599。
- 迁移：没有新增设置、依赖或持久化记录格式。

## 关联 Issue

处理#11536的大小计量和超大输出恢复；独立MCP默认策略决定不由本PR关闭。从#13599拆出。

</details>
