prs.title: feat(memory): add scoped external import jobs for CLI and HTTP
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Qwen-owned external memory import service for CLI and cloud integrations, starting with Codex. Clients submit relative Markdown paths and contents, inspect a deterministic preview, explicitly select sections and destination scope, then start durable background consolidation using the selected workspace's configured model. Results enter native memory search, fetch, recall and forget. Main checkouts and registered linked worktrees share the imported project layer while ordinary memory isolation remains unchanged.

The service exposes `memory_import_v1`, workspace-qualified HTTP preview/submit/status/source/cancel/retry endpoints, and offline `memory import codex --dry-run --json`. Unknown source scope stays unassigned. The server owns destination paths and validates active workspace trust; it never falls back to the primary runtime. Only selected source snapshots are retained. Journaled publication, idempotency, cancellation and retry protect existing, edited and forgotten memories.

Consolidation uses bounded batches per source project and confirmed scope, a compact same-scope metadata index with relevant evidence, and durable aggregate call/token reservations. Preview exposes usage estimates without reading native memories or invoking a model. Failure, cancellation and retry do not replenish the budget. Saved batch proposals preserve per-source recovery and edit/forget protection; imported repository identity lookups are cached and skipped entirely when no imported layer exists.

## Why it's needed

A cloud runtime cannot read a user's laptop filesystem. Direct per-bullet conversion also loses historical context and does not reconcile old knowledge with existing native memory. This replaces #14149 with shared backend capabilities and model-backed consolidation. No external product UI, independent collector, dependency installation requirement or unrelated CI repair is included.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Submit a synthetic Codex source set containing two projects and a referenced distilled Markdown resource. Preview should return grouped sections, references and assignment reasons without model calls or memory/task writes. An ambiguous section should stay unassigned.
- Select only one project and submit to a trusted non-primary workspace. Observe queued/running/completed results, then fetch its retained source and search the native result. The other project's text must never reach the model or retained snapshot; unknown/untrusted/draining destinations must not fall back to primary.
- Repeat the same request/key and then try another key with the same selected content. Native documents should not multiply. Edit or forget an imported document; another import must return conflict rather than restore it.
- Cancel during consolidation, retry a failed item, and restart after a forced process kill before/after publication. Recovery should wait out a dead worker's lease, preserve accurate counts/refs and publish each document only once.
- Verify the imported project result through a linked worktree, and verify an independent clone remains isolated. Ordinary per-worktree memory must retain its existing behavior.

- Verify a 12-section selected project is processed in two bounded calls, while excluded groups never reach the model. Preview should show group and aggregate usage estimates; retrying a budget-exhausted task must not reset the allowance. Interrupt between publications and verify saved proposals resume without another paid call or restoring edited/forgotten knowledge.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed baseline CLI rejected `memory import codex`, and the base daemon did not advertise the capability. After: synthetic shipped-CLI dry-runs (bare, leading debug and safe mode) returned versioned pure JSON with zero network attempts and zero filesystem changes. Confirmed CLI import and the real bundled daemon → real ACP child → loopback OpenAI-compatible model produced native searchable memory without unselected input. Bare/safe confirmed import rejected before source access or authentication.

Initial implementation tests passed: 559 CLI cases, 31 core cases, and the focused cold-workspace ACP bridge case. Full workspace build and typecheck passed; affected packages were rebuilt after final edits, with a final bundle and CLI typecheck. ESLint and formatting passed. Real SIGKILL probes left stale lock directories and recovered automatically after approximately 120 seconds, without manual lock deletion; both interruption points produced one document and correct original-batch counts. Two self-audit passes and a local medium review found no remaining issue; these are not formal approval.

Latest cost update after merging main: 55 focused CLI and 126 core tests passed, along with full build, bundle, typecheck, lint and format. Real bundled CLI/HTTP each processed 12 selected sources as [8, 4], with two requests and no extra request on repetition. Synthetic existing-context payload fell from 199,080 to 2,170 bytes. Interrupted-batch, budget-recovery and cross-group ordering probes passed. Production billing savings are not asserted.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Synthetic CLI, real daemon/ACP/model transport, native memory and process recovery |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated synthetic HOME, runtime, source and repository directories; deterministic loopback provider only. The full build used an 8 GiB Node heap. No actual user memory or production provider was accessed.

## Risk & Scope

- Budget limits: 32 logical invocations and 512,000 conservative reserved token units per task, with 8,192 output tokens per request. These are not guaranteed provider-billed-token or currency caps; oversized metadata/relevant evidence fails closed.
- Main risk or tradeoff: this is a cross-package feature with native memory reader and ACP integration; maintainer architectural review is requested. Model output is schema/native-format checked and cannot overwrite existing documents, but production-model semantic quality still requires evaluation.
- Not validated / out of scope: external product UI, standalone collectors, continuous sync, cross-instance sync and production deployment. SSH workspaces and legacy memory base/local path overrides are rejected in v1. Resource/context limits are documented; oversized context fails instead of silently truncating.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive capability and endpoints; ordinary writable memory roots remain unchanged. This does not migrate experimental state from #14149.

Design and API contracts are complete and synchronized in both languages: [Design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import.md), [设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import.zh-CN.md), [API (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import-api.md), [接口（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import-api.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Supersedes #14149 following the requested backend redesign.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的变更

提供由 Qwen 自身负责的外部记忆导入服务，供 CLI 和云端系统接入，首版支持 Codex。客户端提交相对 Markdown 路径和内容，查看确定性预览，明确选择章节和目标范围后，启动使用目标工作区模型的持久化后台整理任务。结果进入原生记忆搜索、全文、召回和遗忘流程。主检出与已注册 linked worktree 共享导入项目层，普通记忆的既有隔离语义保持不变。

提供 `memory_import_v1`、限定工作区的 HTTP 预览/提交/状态/来源/取消/重试接口，以及离线 `memory import codex --dry-run --json`。未知归属保持待分配。目标路径由服务端管理，检查活动工作区信任状态，不回退主运行时。只保留选中来源快照，通过提交日志、幂等、取消和重试保护已有、已编辑和已遗忘的记忆。

整理按来源项目和确认范围分成有界批次，发送紧凑的同范围元数据索引及相关证据，并持久化总调用/token预留预算。预览展示估算，不读取原生记忆、不调用模型；失败、取消、重试不会重置预算。整批提案持久化后支持逐来源恢复，继续保护编辑和遗忘。仓库身份采用有界缓存，没有导入层时跳过遍历。

### 为什么需要

云端运行时无法直接读取用户电脑的文件系统；逐条转换 Markdown 列表还会丢失历史上下文，无法协调历史知识和已有原生记忆。本 PR 以共享底层能力和模型整理替代 #14149。不包含外部产品界面、独立收集器、额外安装要求或无关 CI 修补。

### 评审测试计划

使用含两个项目和一个引用 Markdown 资源的合成来源，验证预览返回分组、引用和归属原因，不调用模型，不写记忆或任务；歧义章节保持待分配。只选择一个项目并提交到可信次工作区，观察任务状态、查看保留来源并搜索原生结果；未选内容不得进入模型或快照，未知、不可信和退出中的目标不得回退主工作区。

重复同一请求/幂等键，再用新键提交相同内容，文档数量不应增加。编辑或遗忘导入文档后再次导入应返回冲突，不恢复内容。验证取消、失败重试，以及发布前后强制结束进程后的重启恢复：等待旧锁租约后自动继续，计数和引用正确且只发布一次。验证 linked worktree 共享结果、独立 clone 隔离及普通记忆原有行为。

### 前后证据

基线已安装 CLI 不支持该命令，基线 daemon 无此能力标识。实现后，成品 CLI 的普通、前置 debug 和 safe 模式预览均输出版本化纯 JSON，零网络尝试和零文件变化。确认后的 CLI 导入，以及真实 daemon → 真实 ACP 子进程 → 本地 OpenAI 兼容模拟模型的链路，均生成可搜索原生记忆且不包含未选来源。bare/safe 模式确认导入在读取来源或认证前被拒绝。

本地通过 559 项 CLI、31 项 core 测试及冷启动工作区 ACP 专项测试。全工作区构建和类型检查通过；最后修改后重新构建受影响包，完成最终 bundle 和 CLI 类型检查。ESLint、格式检查通过。真实 SIGKILL 遗留锁目录，约 120 秒后自动恢复，无需手工删锁；两个中断点均只生成一个文档，原批次计数正确。两轮自审和本地 medium 审查无剩余问题，不等同正式批准。

最新成本更新同步主线后，55 项 CLI、126 项 core 定向测试及全构建、bundle、typecheck、lint/format 通过。真实 CLI/HTTP 均将 12 条选中来源分成 8＋4，只调用两次，重复提交不增加调用；预览展示每组和总用量估算。合成已有上下文从 199,080 降至 2,170 字节，中断恢复、预算不重置与交错项目顺序验证通过。这不是生产账单节省率。

### 平台与环境

macOS 已完成合成 CLI、真实 daemon/ACP/模型传输、原生记忆和进程恢复验证；Windows、Linux 等待 CI。使用隔离的合成 HOME、运行目录、来源和仓库，以及确定性本地模拟模型；全量构建使用 8 GiB Node 堆。未访问真实用户记忆或生产模型。

每任务上限为 32 次逻辑调用及 512,000 个保守预留 token 单位，每次输出最多 8,192 token；不保证供应商实际计费 token 或金额硬上限。元数据或相关证据超限时明确失败。

### 风险、范围与迁移

本功能跨包并接入原生记忆读取和 ACP，需要维护者架构评审。模型输出经过结构化和原生格式校验且不能覆盖现有文档，但生产模型语义质量仍需评估。不包含外部产品界面、独立收集器、持续同步、跨实例同步或生产部署。v1 拒绝 SSH 工作区及旧式记忆 base/local 路径覆盖；资源和上下文限制已说明，超限失败而不静默截断。

新增能力和接口，普通记忆写入根目录不变。不迁移 #14149 的实验状态。双语设计与接口文档内容完整同步，链接见上方。本 PR 按重新设计要求替代 #14149。

</details>

prs.title: feat(qqbot): accept inbound files and voice messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

It lets the QQ bot accept two more kinds of inbound attachment — ordinary files and voice messages — in addition to images and videos. A message with only a file or only a voice clip no longer has to carry text to be handled. Each kind gets its own size budget, a file keeps the sender's own extension when it is a safe one (the read tool classifies by extension and the platform reports no MIME type for files), and a voice clip prefers the platform's converted WAV over the original SILK so the agent can read it without a conversion step. When a message mixes kinds and has no text, the placeholder names the kind that will be shown, in the order image, video, file, voice.

## Why it's needed

QQ already delivers these attachments; the bot silently ignored them because only images and videos were classified, so a user sending a document or a voice note got no response at all. The design document for this feature is updated alongside the implementation in both languages.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send the bot a document with no accompanying text and confirm the agent receives it as a file attachment whose name keeps a safe sender extension (and falls back to a binary extension when the sender supplies none or an unsafe one). Send a voice message and confirm the agent receives the converted audio rather than the raw SILK, and that a voice clip larger than its budget is refused like an oversized image or video. Send a message carrying several kinds with no text and confirm the placeholder names the kind the agent will actually see. Confirm images and videos behave exactly as before, including the per-message attachment cap and the existing size budgets.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — server-side inbound handling, no TUI. 分支自测：`npx tsc --build packages/channels/qqbot/tsconfig.json` exit 0；`media.test.ts` + `events.test.ts` **144 passed**。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a file's on-disk extension comes from the sender when it is a safe one, which is the only classifier the platform leaves available for that kind; it is restricted to a short alphanumeric alphabet with a binary fallback, and the stem is still sanitized.
- Not validated / out of scope: no transcription of voice content — the audio is passed to the agent as an attachment, and a text-only model still receives the unsupported-attachment note.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## 范围

`media.ts`（新增 `file`/`voice` 两种 kind、各自字节上限、分类分支）、`QQChannel.ts`（附件选择、按 kind 的字节预算、voice 优先 WAV、按 kind 的规范扩展名、无文本时的占位文案）、`types.ts`（`voice_wav_url`）、`media.test.ts` 与 `events.test.ts` 的媒体用例、设计文档中英双份与两处用户文档的媒体段。

## 依赖父分支

base `main`，无父分支、无链内依赖。与 #13882 的 20 文件**文本 hunk 零交叠**（已核对：F1 只动 `qqbot.md` L119–152 与 `overview.md` L465–471，r2 只动 `qqbot.md` L63–112 与 `overview.md` L52–76），可独立并行落地，建议作为"先发"小 PR。

## 生产行数

生产 +85/−17；测试 +321/−7；文档 +241/−96；合计 +647/−120。远低于 500 行升级线。

## 验收证据

`npx tsc --build packages/channels/qqbot/tsconfig.json` exit 0；`npx vitest run packages/channels/qqbot/src/media.test.ts packages/channels/qqbot/src/events.test.ts` → 2 files，**144 passed**（media 26 + events 118）。越界检查：`git diff --name-only 859a337500 HEAD` 恰为 9 个声明文件；越界 grep（`requestQQApi|recentInbound|registerModerationTools|supportsProactiveSend|pushProactive`）无命中；与 #13882 的零交叠 grep（`canonicalExtension|attachmentFileName|mediaPlaceholder|QQInboundMedia|cappedMedia`）为空，`types.ts` 两边 hunk 不相交（本切片 @@-26 vs 对方 @@-98+）。

## 局限性

- 拆小 diff 不会缩短 fork PR 的 ubuntu lane 60 分钟上限（`ci.yml` 无 paths 过滤，拆小只减单 lane 耗时、不减 lane 数）；fork 的 Test lane 跑 ubuntu-latest、上限 60 分钟，先前 59m37s 撞顶是环境侧问题。
- 本 PR 不做语音转写，也不改变图片/视频的既有上限与每消息附件数上限；`file` 类型依赖发送者扩展名做分类，是平台侧不提供 MIME 的客观限制。
- **测试强度缺口（审查 finding，非阻塞）**：按 kind 选字节上限的三元组未被可判别断言钉住——`QQ_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES`=8MB 而 video/file/voice 都是 20MB，超限用例都取各自常量 +1，所以把 file/voice 误写成 image 上限后测试仍全绿。该缺口随本 PR 的后续 commit 补一条可判别断言（feature-slicer 在 F2 落盘后推到此 PR）。

## Adversarial review

独立 subagent 对抗性审查**通过**：`tsc --build` exit 0；`media.test.ts` + `events.test.ts` **144 passed**；9 文件 `+647/−120` 与声称逐字一致；越界 grep 无命中；与 #13882 的零交叠检查全过（`types.ts` 两边 hunk 不相交）；媒体符号全部成对、无悬空引用。唯一 finding 是上述测试强度缺口（非阻塞），已安排随后补一条可判别断言到本 PR。




## Linked Issues

References #13882（同一 fork 上的独立切片，不参与 #13882 的 union 验收）。

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 让 QQ bot 在图片与视频之外，再接受普通文件与语音消息两类入站附件。只有文件或只有语音、不带任何文本的消息不再被忽略。每类有自己的字节预算；文件在扩展名安全时保留发送者自己的扩展名（读工具按扩展名分类，而平台对文件不报 MIME 类型）；语音优先使用平台转换后的 WAV 而不是原始 SILK，使 agent 无需转换即可读取。一条消息混有多种类型且没有文本时，占位文案按 图片、视频、文件、语音 的顺序指出将被展示的类型。

QQ 本来就会投递这些附件，但 bot 只分类图片与视频，于是静默忽略，用户发文档或语音时完全收不到回复。设计文档的中英双份随实现一起更新。

验收方式：给 bot 发一个不带文本的文档，确认 agent 收到文件附件、文件名在扩展名安全时保留发送者的扩展名（发送者没给或不安全时回退到二进制扩展名）；发一条语音，确认 agent 收到转换后的音频而不是原始 SILK，且超过预算的语音与超限图片/视频一样被拒绝；发一条混有多种类型且无文本的消息，确认占位文案指出 agent 实际会看到的类型；确认图片与视频行为与之前完全一致，包括每消息附件数上限与既有字节预算。

范围：`media.ts`、`QQChannel.ts`、`types.ts`、两个测试文件、设计文档与两处用户文档。依赖：base `main`（非堆叠），无父单元；与 #13882 的 20 文件文本 hunk 零交叠（`types.ts` 两边 hunk 不相交），可独立并行落地。

证据：`npx tsc --build packages/channels/qqbot/tsconfig.json` exit 0；`media.test.ts`（26）+ `events.test.ts`（118）= 144 passed；9 文件 +647/−120（生产 +85/−17、测试 +321/−7、文档 +241/−96）；越界 grep 无命中、零交叠检查全过。

局限性：拆小 diff 不会缩短 fork PR 的 ubuntu lane 60 分钟上限（环境侧限制）；本 PR 不做语音转写，也不改变图片/视频上限与附件数上限；`file` 依赖发送者扩展名分类，是平台不提供 MIME 的客观限制；独立审查发现一条非阻塞的测试强度缺口（按 kind 选字节上限的三元组未被可判别断言钉住），随本 PR 的后续 commit 补一条可判别断言。

对抗性审查：独立 subagent 审查通过；唯一 finding 为上述测试强度缺口（非阻塞）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): shrink tool results to the headroom left before auto-compaction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is close to auto-compaction, shrink the next request's tool results to its remaining headroom. Use only the same chat's last successful usage report for the current provider route and unchanged history prefix. System instructions, session context and tool declarations must match that report; equivalent refreshes preserve it, while changed inputs and obsolete in-flight responses invalidate it without clearing usage counters. Explicit truncation settings take priority.

Measure headroom against auto-compaction and share the selected budget across the batch, charging protected text, media and framing first. Keep the tighter aggregate budget and avoid cutting results twice. If an allocation cannot fit a complete truncation notice, preserve the batch for normal compaction and hard-limit admission. When an artifact path cannot fit, use a complete pointerless notice. Save full originals through the existing best-effort persistence path whenever results are shortened. Before persistence, resolve any read that the selected preview would shorten. If a regular-chat read cannot be traced to a path in model history, preserve the entire batch for normal compaction and overflow handling so worker cache residency still matches the full content the model receives.

Defaults stay at 25,000 characters / 1,000 lines. Result-size accounting moved to #13652. Design: [English](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.zh-CN.md).

## Why it is needed

#2566: static tool budgets can push a long session over the compaction trigger prematurely. A hard-ceiling anchor cuts too late; an obsolete usage anchor cuts against the wrong context. At the other extreme, sub-notice allocations erased failure diagnostics and could advertise a nonexistent partial artifact path. A supported PreToolUse repair can supply a read path while recorded model arguments remain `{}`; shortening that result without notifying the worker could then make a later read incorrectly omit the full body.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Near the auto trigger, return a large result: it should shrink to available headroom. Far from or past auto, or after restore/route change/explicit settings, it should keep the static behavior.
- Change fixed inputs, including during a held response: stale usage should not reanchor. Equivalent refreshes should retain the headroom anchor and usage counters.
- Leave only enough headroom for an empty or incomplete notice: original output and error should reach normal compaction admission. A larger but path-insufficient preview should contain a complete notice, a nonempty error indication and no partial recovery path.
- Check the complete persisted original after a meaningful cut and verify user/protected text and previous file-read rights survive.
- Repair an empty-argument read through PreToolUse: the full result should remain in request/history before persistence, and a later unchanged-file placeholder should be valid. With a resolvable original path, normal shortening should notify the worker, preserve prior-read rights and allow a subsequent full reread.

### Evidence (Before & After)

[Current before/after report and actual tmux excerpts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599#issuecomment-6080873864). The current repair passed 35 focused pressure cases, affected Core build/typecheck and static checks. The first full-file run passed 589/590; a media fixture lacking its recorded read call was corrected, and its original media headroom assertions plus inode invalidation passed in the final pressure group. No fresh all-590 pass is claimed.

Actual compiled-Core API/tmux controls exercise the hook and separate worker cache: repaired original `{}` preserves 20,033 characters, while resolvable original path still shortens to 2,576 characters, notifies the worker and rereads the full body. Each makes two controlled generation calls; all 11 watched compiled modules loaded with matching hashes. The generator and compaction boundary are controlled (NOOP), with observer loader/assertion failures retained. The resolved-control mutable cache receipt reflects a later reread, not a frozen after-cut snapshot. Earlier tiny-budget and CLI/TUI evidence stays tied to its tested commit.

### Tested on

macOS, Node 22.22.0, current commit `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859`. Current necessary CI is tracked separately.

## Risk & Scope

The tiny-budget fallback and unresolved-read whole-batch preservation can require normal compaction instead of suppressing text. The latter deliberately may exceed the selected finite character budget; existing compaction, hard admission and overflow handling apply, potentially adding text or compaction. It does not guarantee exact token admission. A pointerless preview omits detailed content when it cannot fit; persistence remains best effort under existing disk limits. Shortened file reads disarm quote-back residency while retaining prior-read rights; uniquely correlated shell shortening leaves file-read residency intact. Existing fork ownership remains unchanged. Unresolved would-cut reads in regular chat now preserve the full batch before persistence; there is no worker API change or blanket cache clear that revokes prior-read rights. The current controlled-Core fixture does not establish a new CLI, browser, real-model or cross-platform result. Line caps and defaults do not adapt.

## Linked Issues

Closes #2566
Result-size accounting split to #13652 (#11536).

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

接近自动压缩时，根据同一聊天、同一路由且固定输入和历史仍有效的成功用量报告缩小下一请求的工具结果；等价刷新保留依据，内容变化或在途旧响应不重建过期依据，也不清空用量计数。保护文本、媒体和结构先计入余量，与聚合预算取较紧值且不重复裁剪。放不下完整提示时保留原文交给压缩/硬上限准入；完整路径放不下时只发送完整无指针提示，正常裁剪仍尽力保存完整原文。默认25k字符/1000行保持不变，结果统计另在#13652。

本次修复 PreToolUse 补齐实际读取路径、历史原始参数仍为 `{}` 的缓存缺口。落盘前先检查最终预览将裁剪的读取，普通聊天无法定位路径时保留整个批次，确保 worker 驻留状态与模型实际收到的内容一致；可定位读取仍正常裁剪、通知 worker 并保留先读权限，没有新增 worker API。例外批次可能超过有限字符预算，交由正常压缩、硬准入或溢出处理，可能增加文本和压缩，不能声称精确 token 准入。双语设计同步记录。

当前提交 `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859` 的35项压力测试及Core构建/类型/静态检查通过。首次全文件589/590通过，媒体fixture未记录读取调用；补齐路径关联后，原媒体预算断言和inode解除断言在最终压力组通过，未冒称全590重新通过。实际编译Core API/tmux中，修正读取保留20,033字符；可定位读取仍裁到2,576字符、通知worker，随后完整重读。每种两次受控生成调用、11个加载模块散列匹配；generator/NOOP压缩是控制边界。保留loader和观察断言失败及修正后的结果。控制中二次读取会更新缓存对象，不能将序列化结果视为裁剪后的冻结快照。历史极小预算及CLI/TUI证据保留原提交，本轮不冒称新CLI、Docker、浏览器、真实模型或真实压缩验收。CI、人工批准、合并和发布独立判断。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): delete selected message groups from session history
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds grouped message deletion to Web Shell. The message action row keeps Copy and an overflow menu; Delete selects the current prompt and its complete reply group, with linked checkboxes and optional non-contiguous earlier groups. Reply selection stays beside the Processed header when present, including after expanding thoughts or tools.

Deletion removes the selected original records from JSONL and retained raw compression context, refreshes live model context and connected clients, and preserves every existing summary unchanged. Slash-command display groups can be removed without undoing command effects or files; frontend-only commands retain their position and identity across reloads and recovery.

## Why it's needed

Web Shell cannot currently remove arbitrary conversation groups. Rewind removes a suffix and retains abandoned history, so it does not satisfy physical deletion of selected turns. Users also need consistent behavior when deleting the only group, working around compression checkpoints, or recovering from stale snapshots and partially completed requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In an idle local daemon session, open a user message's overflow menu and choose Delete messages. The current prompt/reply group should be selected; toggling either checkbox must toggle the group. Select an earlier group while leaving a middle group unselected, confirm, and verify only the chosen groups disappear after reload and in other connected clients.
2. Expand thoughts/tools and verify a reply group still has one checkbox beside Processed, or beside its first reply when no status header exists. Run a local display command between turns; deleting another group must preserve the command's order and identity. Repeat at narrow viewport width and with keyboard/touch menu interaction.
3. Delete the only/all groups and continue the same session. Inspect persisted history and reopen the session: selected originals and paired tool records must remain absent, while files and command effects remain unchanged.
4. Compress a conversation, then delete groups before and after compression. Existing summaries must remain identical; only selected retained raw context should change later model input. A full compression followed by fast compression must retain the summary boundary and allow safe deletion.
5. Change history from another client while a selection is open. A conflict must clear stale selection and explain re-selection without automatically resubmitting deletion. A busy session must refuse deletion. If persistence succeeds but context installation fails, deleted identities must still reach the originator, its UI must reconcile, and further prompts must explicitly require reopening. Failed reloads must retain unselected local commands.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: there is no grouped physical-deletion action. After: the captured states below show the overflow action, linked non-contiguous selection, and the retained middle group after deletion.

**All screenshots use a simulated daemon HTTP/SSE backend and were visually inspected. They demonstrate UI behavior; actual JSONL/model-context verification was performed separately against a real daemon and ACP process with a deterministic local model.** Images are stored only in an independent fork asset branch and pinned to commit `c229de8b2c425943deda67691c88ab27e620ee4c`.

UI screenshots refreshed after merging main `17d5f774`; these captures still use simulated daemon responses.

Overflow menu:

![Web Shell message action menu (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c229de8b2c425943deda67691c88ab27e620ee4c/menu.png)

Linked non-contiguous group selection:

![Linked group selection (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c229de8b2c425943deda67691c88ab27e620ee4c/selection.png)

After deleting the first and third groups, the middle group remains:

![Unselected middle group retained (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c229de8b2c425943deda67691c88ab27e620ee4c/after-deletion.png)

[Narrow viewport selection screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c229de8b2c425943deda67691c88ab27e620ee4c/mobile-selection.png) · [Bilingual evidence notes](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/c229de8b2c425943deda67691c88ab27e620ee4c/README.md)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node.js 22; build, bundle, typecheck, focused unit tests and browser/backend E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local worktree development and bundled runtime; Chromium Playwright with simulated daemon responses for UI/error recovery, and isolated real daemon/ACP/JSONL with a deterministic local OpenAI-compatible model for persistence and model-context checks. The final deletion/edit browser suite passed 17/17 cases. A separate E2E report comment records the validation layers and results.

## Risk & Scope

- Physical deletion is irreversible. Existing summaries may still contain information from deleted originals by design; summary text is never regenerated or edited.
- Scope is ordinary local daemon sessions. Managed authoritative storage, SSH workspaces and the hosted harness profile do not support this operation. Ambiguous legacy compression identities fail closed.
- Busy sessions are rejected. A failure after persistence keeps prompt admission closed until the session is reopened; it cannot continue with stale model context.
- This feature touches transcript persistence and cross-package session contracts; maintainer review is requested. It introduces no dependency or history migration and preserves normal append/resume behavior.
- Local verification did not cover Windows, Linux or live external model providers.

Both versions include matching decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

prs.title: fix(ci): make finalize-release second-bot approve non-blocking (#14341)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the "Approve release PR (second bot)" step in `finalize-release.yml` non-blocking (`continue-on-error: true`) and adds a warning step that surfaces the root cause when it fails.

## Why it is needed

The second-bot approve step has failed on every stable release since v0.25.1 because `CI_BOT_PAT` resolves to the same GitHub user as `CI_REVIEW_BOT_PAT` (the PR author). GitHub rejects self-approval at the API level with `"Can not approve your own pull request"`. This blocks the subsequent auto-merge step and forces a human to manually approve and merge every release PR.

Making the step non-blocking lets auto-merge proceed when branch protection only requires one approval or a human has already approved. The real fix is rotating `CI_BOT_PAT` to a distinct GitHub account — the warning step and linked issue (#14341) document this.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm three things: (1) the second-bot approve step now has `continue-on-error: true` and an `id`; (2) the new warning step fires only when `steps.second_approve.outcome == 'failure'` and emits a `::warning::` annotation linking to #14341; (3) the auto-merge step's `if` condition is unchanged and no longer gated on the second approve succeeding.

Expected: when CI_BOT_PAT is the same user as the PR author, the workflow completes with a warning instead of failing. When CI_BOT_PAT is a distinct user, behavior is unchanged.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

YAML validation only; no runtime involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: if branch protection strictly requires two approvals and no human intervenes, the release PR will stay open until someone approves. This is still better than the current behavior where the entire workflow fails and auto-merge never runs.
- Not validated / out of scope: rotating CI_BOT_PAT itself (requires ops action, tracked in #14341).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): keep dialogs opened over the mobile drawer touch-scrollable
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stops the phone-width sidebar drawer from swallowing touch scrolling inside dialogs that are opened on top of it. Dialogs render outside the drawer's own subtree, so they now get their own exemption from the drawer's background-scroll lock instead of being caught by it.

## Why it's needed

On a phone, the sidebar renders as a drawer, and opening that drawer installs a document-level lock that prevents the page behind it from scrolling. The lock only exempted the drawer's own subtree. Because dialogs portal out of that subtree, every dialog opened from the drawer had all touch scrolling prevented — not merely "the buttons are below the fold", but genuinely unscrollable, with no way to reach the confirm action.

This is what makes the Add Workspace dialog impossible to complete from a phone: the folder browser needs scrolling to be usable at all.

The symptom was also confusing in a specific way worth recording. Rotating the phone to landscape and back made scrolling start working. That is not a rendering quirk: going landscape widens the viewport past the drawer's breakpoint, which closes the drawer and unregisters the scroll lock, and rotating back to portrait does not reopen it. So the round-trip rotation was incidentally removing the blocker. This also explains why the defect never shows up on desktop, where the drawer is never open.

The scope is broader than one dialog: any dialog opened while the drawer is open was affected.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression test opens the drawer, opens a dialog on top of it, and dispatches `touchmove` events, asserting that the dialog and the drawer both scroll freely while the page behind the drawer stays locked. That third assertion is the guard against over-fixing: the lock must still do its original job.

To confirm by hand on a phone browser against a desktop daemon: open the session drawer, open Add Workspace, and drag inside the dialog. Before this change nothing moves; after it the dialog scrolls and the confirm buttons become reachable.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Unit-level, via the added regression test:

- Before: `touchmove` dispatched inside the dialog reports `defaultPrevented === true` — the gesture is cancelled, so the dialog cannot scroll.
- After: `defaultPrevented === false` inside the dialog and inside the drawer, while a `touchmove` outside both is still prevented.

```
✓ App.test.tsx (1086 tests | 1085 skipped) 77ms
  ✓ keeps a dialog opened over the drawer touch-scrollable

 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  1089 passed (1089)
```

No on-device Before/After capture: the original report is from iPhone Safari, and this was verified in jsdom rather than on a real phone. A device confirmation from the reporter would still be worth having.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests, typecheck, lint and format check only. No daemon or browser session involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the scroll lock's allowlist grows by one selector, so a touch that starts inside a dialog no longer blocks background scrolling. That is the intent, and the dialog's own modal layer still keeps the page behind it from scrolling, so the lock's original purpose is preserved. The added assertion covers exactly this.
- Not validated / out of scope: not verified on a physical phone. The remaining layout defects reported in the linked issue — the folder browser collapsing to a single line, the action buttons living inside the scrolling region rather than pinned, the narrow path input, and the always-expanded help text — are all still present. This PR removes the blocker that made the dialog unusable; it does not redesign the layout.
- Known boundary: the exemption keys off the shared dialog shell's marker, so it covers dialogs rendered through that shell — Add Workspace included. A number of dialogs render the underlying dialog primitives directly instead, and those are not covered. Widening the marker to the base primitives was considered and rejected: existing end-to-end specs locate dialogs by that attribute and assert on the match, so making it match additional elements would break strict-mode locators. In practice the direct-primitive dialogs are reached either through panels whose handlers already close the drawer, or from surfaces sitting behind the drawer's backdrop, so they are not exposed to this lock. Covering them properly needs its own change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The dialog marker this keys off is an existing public attribute, and no new attribute or CSS variable is introduced.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14184 — fixes the touch-scroll blocker that made the dialog unreachable. Intentionally not a closing keyword: the layout defects listed in that issue remain open and are better handled separately.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

阻止手机宽度下的侧边栏抽屉吞掉「盖在它上面的对话框」的触摸滚动。对话框渲染在抽屉自身子树之外，因此现在单独获得背景滚动锁的豁免，而不再被这把锁一并拦掉。

## 为什么需要

手机上侧边栏以抽屉形式渲染，打开抽屉时会装一个 document 级别的锁，防止背后的页面被滚动。这把锁原先只豁免抽屉自己的子树。由于对话框 portal 到了该子树之外，所有从抽屉里打开的对话框的触摸滚动都被 preventDefault 掉了 —— 不是「按钮在折叠线以下」，而是根本滚不动，完全没有办法点到确认按钮。

这正是 Add Workspace 对话框在手机上无法完成的原因：目录浏览器要有滚动才谈得上可用。

这个症状还有一处很值得记录的迷惑之处。把手机横屏再转回竖屏，滚动就恢复了。这不是渲染层的怪现象：横屏让视口宽度越过抽屉的断点，从而关闭抽屉并卸载了滚动锁，而转回竖屏并不会重新打开抽屉。所以这一趟转屏其实是顺手把拦截器移除了。这也解释了为什么该缺陷在桌面端从不出现 —— 桌面端抽屉根本不会打开。

影响范围不止一个对话框：抽屉打开期间弹出的任何对话框都受影响。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

回归测试会打开抽屉、在其上打开一个对话框，然后派发 `touchmove` 事件，断言对话框与抽屉都能自由滚动，同时抽屉背后的页面仍被锁住。第三条断言是防止修过头的护栏：这把锁必须继续完成它原本的职责。

在手机上手动验证（浏览器指向桌面守护进程）：打开会话抽屉，打开 Add Workspace，在对话框内拖动。改动前完全不动；改动后对话框可以滚动，确认按钮变得可点。

### 证据（改动前后）

单元层面，由新增的回归测试给出：

- 改动前：在对话框内派发的 `touchmove` 报告 `defaultPrevented === true` —— 手势被取消，对话框无法滚动。
- 改动后：对话框内与抽屉内均为 `defaultPrevented === false`，而在两者之外派发的 `touchmove` 仍被阻止。

（测试输出见英文部分。）

未提供真机前后对比：原始报告来自 iPhone Safari，而本次是在 jsdom 中验证的，并非真机。仍值得请报告者在设备上确认一次。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

仅单元测试、typecheck、lint 与格式检查，未涉及守护进程或浏览器会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：滚动锁的白名单多了一个选择器，因此起始于对话框内部的触摸不再阻止背景滚动。这正是意图所在，且对话框自身的模态层仍会阻止背后页面滚动，锁的原有目的得以保留。新增断言恰好覆盖了这一点。
- 未验证/超出范围：未在真机上验证。所链接 issue 中其余布局缺陷 —— 目录浏览器塌成一行、操作按钮位于滚动区内部而非固定、路径输入框过窄、帮助文本始终展开 —— 全部仍然存在。本 PR 移除的是让对话框不可用的那个阻塞点，并未重做布局。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。所依赖的对话框标记是既有的公开属性，未引入新属性或新的 CSS 变量。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14184 —— 修复了导致对话框无法触达的触摸滚动阻塞。刻意不使用关闭关键字：该 issue 中列出的布局缺陷仍未解决，更适合单独处理。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show live trajectory executions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a collapsible Recent executions section to the opt-in trajectory panel. Requests and tools update by execution identity, with estimated elapsed time only for trusted live executions and recorded duration once finished. Details show lifecycle metadata, distinguish tool execution status from final outcome, and can locate an associated request in the currently loaded history.

## Why it's needed

The historical trajectory is useful after records arrive, but it does not show an in-flight request or tool reliably. This adds immediate execution visibility while preserving the reader's historical window, filters, selection and existing timeline semantics. Retention is bounded to 256 requests and 256 tools, with a virtualized list and explicit incomplete/omitted notices.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable the existing trajectory entry, open it during a request and tool execution, and inspect a row. Running elapsed time is marked approximate; terminal duration uses recorded data. A tool rejected before execution says “Not executed” without a fabricated 0ms duration.
2. Interrupt the actual SSE connection while a request is running. Its state becomes unknown and elapsed growth stops; after reconnect, the recorded terminal state appears without adding a duplicate execution.
3. Navigate to an older historical window, search and select a request, then reconnect after an event gap. The historical window, query and selection remain, with a refresh notice. Live updates do not refresh history automatically.
4. Switch sessions and verify execution details do not leak across owners. Use keyboard navigation and a short viewport; the recent section can be collapsed and reopened, and details remain accessible.

Local validation: root build/typecheck/bundle passed. The broader App/trajectory run passed 1,582 tests; final focused verification plus artifact gates passed 140 tests (overlapping counts). Changed-file lint/format passed. Transcript remainder is 1,330,134 against the unchanged 1,331,500 limit. Independent review findings were fixed and rechecked. A separate comment records the real App/daemon E2E results and limitations.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real standalone App and daemon with a controlled loopback model; prompts and responses are fixtures. Both comparison images are 1440×1000; they show different recorded windows. Before is the existing PR6C worktree build (source HEAD `456d098`); its exact bundle/source identity was not independently attested, so it is not presented as an exact current-main build. After is the final implementation build, reloaded during validation; its source hashes match this PR's committed source.

| Before: historical trajectory | After: recent executions above retained historical window |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before PR6C](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/99773ee1b82ee78a555715d638b495aa33cf0a38/before-pr6c.png) | ![After PR7A, history retained after gap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/99773ee1b82ee78a555715d638b495aa33cf0a38/history-after-gap.png) |

<details>
<summary>900×500: keyboard-opened execution details</summary>

![Compact execution inspector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/99773ee1b82ee78a555715d638b495aa33cf0a38/compact-inspector.png)

</details>

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ local build, tests and real browser/daemon E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 24.14.1; frozen pnpm dependencies; actual standalone App → Provider → SDK/daemon/SSE, isolated runtime and controlled loopback provider. Transport failures used a local proxy that destroyed event sockets; no browser-store injection or external model calls.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: distinguishing trusted running state from replay/disconnection, and retaining history while lifecycle state changes. Tests cover these boundaries; the recent clock stays separate from historical metrics.
- Not validated / out of scope: full native subagent/PostToolUse cancellation runtime matrix; auto-follow, pause/return-to-latest behavior and a unified time viewport remain PR7B. Clock skew, conflicts, capacity and hidden timer behavior have deterministic tests, not an exhaustive real-runtime matrix.
- Breaking changes / migration: none. Existing opt-in remains; no daemon wire, core, or persistent schema changes. Historical tools are not heuristically joined to lifecycle records.

## Linked Issues

Follows #13952 (PR6C). PR7A of the staged trajectory work.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在已有 opt-in 轨迹面板中增加可折叠的“近期执行”区域。请求和工具按执行身份更新；只有可信实时执行显示估算耗时，完成后采用记录耗时。详情展示生命周期元数据，分别展示工具执行结果和最终处理结果，并可定位当前已加载历史中关联的请求。

## 为什么需要

历史轨迹适合查看已落盘记录，但不能可靠呈现正在执行的请求或工具。本次补上即时执行可见性，同时保留历史窗口、筛选、选择和既有时间轴含义。请求和工具各保留最多256条，使用虚拟列表，并明确提示不完整或展示上限省略的记录。

## 审核者验证计划

1. 打开已有轨迹入口，观察请求和工具执行并查看详情。运行耗时明确标注“约”，终态采用记录值；执行前被拒绝的工具显示“未执行”，不伪造0ms。
2. 运行中真正断开SSE连接，确认状态变为未知且停止增长；重连后收到记录终态，同一执行不会重复成多行。
3. 进入旧历史窗口，搜索并选择请求，再经历事件gap恢复。窗口、查询与选择保持，并出现刷新提示；实时更新不会自动刷新历史。
4. 切换会话，确认旧owner详情不泄漏；使用键盘和低高度视口，确认近期区可折叠和重新展开，详情可访问。

本地验证：根目录build/typecheck/bundle通过。较广的App/轨迹回归1582项通过；最终重点验证及构建产物门禁140项通过，两组数量有重叠。修改文件lint/format通过；transcript余量长度1,330,134，低于未修改的1,331,500上限。独立审查发现的问题已修复并复核；另有评论记录真实App/daemon端到端结果与边界。

## 前后证据

上方对比图均为1440×1000，真实standalone App和daemon，模型使用受控loopback，提示与回复为fixture；两张图展示不同历史窗口。Before来自PR6C工作树已有构建，源码HEAD为456d098，未独立证明旧bundle精确对应源码，因此不冒充当前main构建。After来自最终实现构建，验证时已重新加载；其源码哈希与本PR提交一致。另附900×500键盘打开执行详情的截图。

## 测试平台与环境

macOS完成本地构建、测试和真实浏览器/daemon端到端验证；Windows、Linux未在本地测试。Node 24.14.1，pnpm冻结锁文件，实际standalone App → Provider → SDK/daemon/SSE，隔离runtime及loopback模型。通过本地代理销毁事件socket模拟真实断线，没有浏览器store注入或外部模型调用。

## 风险与范围

主要风险是区分可信进行中状态与回放/断线，以及生命周期更新时保留历史状态；已有对应测试，近期区时钟不参与历史指标。未完整覆盖native子代理/PostToolUse取消真实矩阵；自动跟随、暂停/回到最新与统一时间视口留给PR7B。时钟偏差、冲突、容量与隐藏时钟有确定性测试，不能替代完整真实运行矩阵。无破坏性变更或迁移；保留已有opt-in，不修改daemon wire、core或持久化schema，也不通过猜测关联旧工具历史行。

## 关联

接续#13952（PR6C），属于轨迹分阶段工作的PR7A。

prs.title: feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one read-only request for complete live-session snapshots from 1–20 explicitly selected registered workspaces. Each workspace keeps its own canonical identity, catalog version, and independent success or error result. The new request shares the existing single-workspace snapshot and catalog-cache reconciliation logic. A distinct capability and TypeScript SDK method let clients opt in with cancellation and timeout support.

## Why it's needed

Clients showing several workspaces currently make one live-state HTTP request per workspace on every refresh. The recently added batch session catalog can read persisted history, so it is not a suitable high-frequency execution-state endpoint. This API lets clients fetch the same authoritative in-memory state in one request, while preserving the existing single-workspace route and per-session SSE.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a local daemon with a primary workspace, register a trusted secondary workspace, then send one batch request containing both IDs and an unknown selector. Expect two full snapshots and one explicit `workspace_not_found` member in input order, with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Confirm malformed bodies fail with HTTP 400, an untrusted or transitioning workspace fails only its own member, and the capability is advertised. Change a live session between running, waiting, and idle without advancing its catalog version; every batch snapshot should still reflect the current state. Confirm the SDK makes one authenticated native REST request and preserves abort and timeout behavior. Older daemons should continue to use the single-workspace route after callers preflight capabilities.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (HTTP and SDK change; no TUI change). The local daemon returned two workspace snapshots and one explicit unknown-workspace error in a single POST.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests, and local HTTP E2E passed; the large server test file showed unrelated intermittent failures |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64: frozen install/build/bundle, typecheck, focused tests, and daemon HTTP E2E passed |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1 on macOS arm64 and `dev` Linux x86_64, each with an isolated daemon on a dynamically assigned loopback port. The global `qwen` binary was unavailable for the pre-change CLI dry-run; the absence of this route was confirmed in the current base source.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A batch is not atomic across workspaces. Each successful member is capped at 512 KiB and an oversized member gets an explicit error.
- Not validated / out of scope: Web Shell still polls workspaces separately until a client migration adopts the new capability; no model-driven live session was created in the HTTP E2E. Windows was not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Clients preflight `workspace_session_live_state_batch` and retain the existing single-workspace path for older daemons.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #12511

### 如何验证

### 前后证据

不适用（HTTP 与 SDK 改动，无 TUI 变化）。本地 daemon 实测一次 POST 返回两个 workspace 快照及一个未知 workspace 的明确错误。

### 测试平台

| 🪟 Windows | 本地未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64：锁文件安装/构建/打包、类型检查、聚焦测试与 daemon HTTP E2E 均通过 |

### 环境

在 macOS arm64 和 `dev` Linux x86_64 上使用 Node 22.23.1，各自启动使用动态 loopback 端口的隔离 daemon。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，无法进行改动前 CLI dry-run；已从当前基线源码确认该路由不存在。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：批量结果不保证跨 workspace 原子性；每个成功成员上限为 512 KiB，超限会返回明确错误。
- 未验证或范围外：Web Shell 在后续客户端迁移前仍逐 workspace 轮询；HTTP E2E 未创建由模型驱动的运行会话；未在本地运行 Windows 测试。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。客户端预检 `workspace_session_live_state_batch`，旧 daemon 保留现有单 workspace 路径。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #12511

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): hold behind an older message whose body cannot be read
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Before handing a message over, the session message relay reads the bodies of the sender's older messages that are still owed, to find out which run each one goes to. When one of those bodies cannot be read (not readable yet, or not JSON), the relay now treats that message as one to the same run. The younger message then waits on the heartbeat, which costs no attempt. Before this change, the read threw into `work()`'s catch and charged the younger message an attempt. The H4d-b design doc states this in decision 5's Handover rule and in the Validation section, in both languages.

## Why it's needed

This follows up on a non-blocking review comment on #14235 (r4281018058). The send-order hold is documented as costing no attempt, but a fault in a different message's resource read charged one to a younger message that could otherwise be delivered. That contradicts the comment above the hold. The same file already treats a null resource as a retryable "not readable yet" state.

Holding is the safe answer: an unreadable body cannot prove its run, and the older message's own step reads the same resource, so it fails the same way. Its give-up then ends the hold. If that give-up's own sender step cannot land, the row passes the attempt bound and `LEDGER_OWES_WORK` stops counting it. As the comment noted, no message was lost before this change; this is a consistency and robustness fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server
mvn -B test -Dtest='SessionMessageRelayTest,SessionMessageRelayStoreTest,ChildResultRelayTest,ChildResultRelayStoreTest'
```

`holdsBehindAnOlderMessageWhoseBodyCannotBeRead` makes the older body first unreadable (`null`), then malformed. In both cases it asserts that the younger message is held: no harness calls, two no-cost `scheduleRetry` holds, no `defer`, and zero attempts.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible surface). Mutation check: removing the catch, which puts the read back on the attempt-charging path, turns the new test red. So does releasing on an unreadable body (`return false`).

The full `managed-agent-server` unit suite (`mvn verify -DskipITs`): 2862 run, 0 failures, 6 skipped; Checkstyle 0 violations; SpotBugs 0 bugs.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, Maven 3.9.9.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an unreadable older body bound for another run now holds the younger message too, until the older one's own step reads its body or its give-up lands. That is conservative, and both of those outcomes end it.
- Not validated / out of scope: the MySQL and MariaDB lanes. A store fault in `readResource` itself still counts as an attempt, as it does for every other step.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #14235 (review comment r4281018058). Part of #13744.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

交接一条消息之前,session message relay 会读取同一发送方仍欠着的更早消息的正文,以确定每条发往哪个 run。当其中某条正文读不到时(尚读不到,或不是 JSON),relay 现在把那条消息视为发往同一 run。较新的消息随之在心跳上等待,不消耗尝试次数。在此之前,这次读取会抛进 `work()` 的 catch,给较新的消息记一次尝试。H4d-b 设计文档在决策 5 的"交接"规则和"验证"一节写明了这一点,两种语言同步。

## 为什么需要

这是 #14235 上一条非阻塞评审意见(r4281018058)的后续。文档写明发送顺序持有不消耗尝试次数,可别的消息在读取资源时出了故障,却会给一条本可投递的较新消息记一次尝试。这与持有处上方的注释矛盾。同一文件里,别处已经把读到 null 的资源当作可重试的"尚读不到"状态。

持有是稳妥的做法:读不到的正文无法证明自己发往哪个 run,而较早消息自己的步骤读的是同一份资源,会以同样方式失败,它随后的放弃会结束这一持有。如果那次放弃本身的发送方步骤无法落地,该行会超过尝试上限,`LEDGER_OWES_WORK` 也不再计入它。正如评论所说,修复之前也没有消息因此丢失;这是一个一致性与健壮性修复。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server
mvn -B test -Dtest='SessionMessageRelayTest,SessionMessageRelayStoreTest,ChildResultRelayTest,ChildResultRelayStoreTest'
```

`holdsBehindAnOlderMessageWhoseBodyCannotBeRead` 先让较早消息的正文读不到(`null`),再让它格式错误。两种情况都断言较新的消息被持有:没有 harness 调用,两次不消耗尝试的 `scheduleRetry` 持有,没有 `defer`,尝试次数为零。

### 证据(前后对比)

N/A(没有用户可见的界面)。变异检查:去掉 catch,让读取回到计入尝试的路径,会让新测试变红;读不到时改为放行(`return false`)同样会变红。

完整的 `managed-agent-server` 单元套件(`mvn verify -DskipITs`):运行 2862 个,0 失败(跳过 6 个);Checkstyle 0 违规;SpotBugs 0 个 bug。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境(可选)

JDK 21,Maven 3.9.9。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:一条正文读不到、其实发往另一个 run 的更早消息,现在也会持有较新的消息,直到较早消息自己的步骤读到了正文,或它的放弃落地为止。这是保守的做法,两种结果都会结束持有。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内:MySQL 与 MariaDB 车道。`readResource` 本身的 store 故障仍计一次尝试,与其他所有步骤一致。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

#14235 的后续(评审意见 r4281018058)。属于 #13744。

</details>

prs.title: fix(providers): validate daemon credentials and close QwenCloud follow-ups
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR closes a focused batch of QwenCloud follow-ups from #14257 on top of #14073. The main behavior change makes the daemon validate a provider API key before persisting it, so a key from the wrong billing family is rejected immediately with `invalid_api_key` instead of being stored and failing on the first authenticated request.

The same batch completes the related provider presentation and contract gaps already identified in #14257: QwenCloud setup documentation, endpoint recognition, localized validation messages, picker coverage, provider ownership checks, the `qwen3.7-plus` video capability, and render-time translation of provider menu titles. The remaining product and API-design items from #14257 stay deferred.

## Why it's needed

The CLI, ACP, and VS Code entry points already applied the provider's key-format rule before persistence, but the daemon route could not delegate that check to its caller because validator functions are not serialized over the wire. A Token Plan key entered through the Standard API Key route could therefore be accepted and stored even though the provider would reject it later.

The follow-up coverage also exposed a real localization defect: provider menu titles were translated when the module loaded, so changing the language before opening an already-imported dialog left those titles in English while the rest of the dialog rendered in the selected language. Resolving titles while rendering keeps both dialog implementations consistent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Submit a Token Plan-style key to the Standard API Key daemon route. Expect HTTP 400 with `code: invalid_api_key`, no credential persistence, and no runtime synchronization attempt.
2. Submit a valid Standard key with surrounding whitespace. Expect HTTP 200; validation should use the trimmed value, matching the value persisted by the installer.
3. Select Chinese, open either authentication dialog, and enter the QwenCloud access-method menu. Expect `千问AI平台 · 接入方式`; the subsequent provider setup title should also use `千问AI平台`.
4. Inspect the QwenCloud Standard catalog. Expect `qwen3.7-plus` to advertise both image and video input.
5. Confirm the QwenCloud picker contains Token Plan and Standard API Key, excludes Coding Plan, and remains the first provider group in the VS Code picker.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Daemon validation: the automated A/B harness drove a real daemon with isolated settings. Before this guard, four wrong-family cases returned 200 and persisted the credential; after it, the same cases return 400 and persist nothing. Seven valid, opt-in, and protocol-error controls remain unchanged. The full report is in [this verification comment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14302#issuecomment-6194786710).
- Localized titles: before this follow-up, a dialog imported under the default locale kept its QwenCloud submenu title in English after Chinese was selected. At the current head, both dialog implementations resolve that title while rendering; the OpenTUI suite passes 58/58 and the focused Ink assertion passes 1/1.
- Current-head focused checks: daemon provider-route selection 25/25, QwenCloud Standard preset 12/12, localized Ink title 1/1, OpenTUI dialog 58/58, and the previously competing navigation case 1/1 when run independently.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS covers the current-head focused Vitest checks listed above. The earlier Linux sandbox run supplied the real-daemon A/B evidence, but current-head Linux and Windows coverage is left to CI.

### Environment (optional)

Direct package-level Vitest runs from the existing worktree. No local build was run for the current follow-up.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: provider key validation is opt-in, so providers without a validator retain their current behavior. The existing validators are pure prefix checks, and the accepted value is trimmed consistently before validation and persistence.
- Not validated / out of scope: real production credentials, live QwenCloud traffic, macOS or Windows end-to-end startup, removing unused public fields or exports, provider-card wording and naming decisions, and broader authentication-dialog test-harness changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Invalid provider-family keys now fail earlier at input time; valid configurations and persisted formats are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14257. This deliberately does not close the issue because the PR addresses only the bounded D1/D2, T1/T3-T9, I1, P5, S3, S6, and S7 items. It is stacked on #14073, whose QwenCloud provider entries are required by these changes.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这个 PR 叠在 #14073 之上，集中处理 #14257 中一批边界清晰的 QwenCloud 后续项。核心行为变化是在 daemon 落盘 provider API key 之前执行格式校验：如果用户把错误计费类型的 key 填进当前入口，会立即收到 `invalid_api_key`，而不是先把凭据写入、到第一次鉴权请求时才失败。

同一批改动也完成了 #14257 已列出的 provider 展示与契约缺口：QwenCloud 配置文档、endpoint 识别、本地化校验消息、选择器覆盖、provider ownership 检查、`qwen3.7-plus` 的视频能力，以及 provider 菜单标题在渲染时翻译。#14257 中其余需要产品或 API 设计决策的项目继续保留。

## 为什么需要

CLI、ACP 和 VS Code 入口都会在凭据落盘前应用 provider 自己的 key 格式规则；daemon 路由此前没有，因为 validator 是函数，无法通过 wire 序列化给调用方。结果是 Token Plan key 可能通过 Standard API Key 路由被接受并写入，直到后续真实请求才暴露不匹配。

补充覆盖时还发现了一个真实的本地化问题：provider 菜单标题在模块加载时就完成翻译。因此，即使用户切换到中文后再打开已加载过的对话框，这些标题仍保持英文，而对话框其他内容已经是中文。改为渲染时解析标题后，两套对话框行为保持一致。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 向 Standard API Key 的 daemon 路由提交 Token Plan 类型的 key。预期 HTTP 400、错误码为 `invalid_api_key`，不会落盘凭据，也不会触发运行时同步。
2. 提交一个首尾带空白的合法 Standard key。预期 HTTP 200；校验使用 trim 后的值，与 installer 最终落盘的值一致。
3. 切换到中文，打开任一鉴权对话框并进入 QwenCloud 接入方式菜单。预期显示 `千问AI平台 · 接入方式`，后续 provider setup 标题也应显示 `千问AI平台`。
4. 检查 QwenCloud Standard 模型目录。预期 `qwen3.7-plus` 同时声明图片和视频输入能力。
5. 确认 QwenCloud 菜单包含 Token Plan 与 Standard API Key、不包含 Coding Plan，并且在 VS Code provider picker 中仍排在第一组。

### 证据（Before & After）

- daemon 校验：自动化 A/B harness 在隔离 settings 的真实 daemon 上执行。加入 guard 前，4 个错误 key 家族场景返回 200 并落盘；加入后，同样场景返回 400 且不写入。其余 7 个合法、opt-in 和 protocol-error 对照场景保持不变。完整报告见[这条验证评论](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14302#issuecomment-6194786710)。
- 本地化标题：修复前，对话框在默认语言下被 import 后，即使随后选择中文，QwenCloud 子菜单标题仍为英文。当前 head 中，两套对话框都在渲染时解析标题；OpenTUI 套件 58/58 通过，Ink 定向断言 1/1 通过。
- 当前 head 定向检查：daemon provider route 选择集 25/25、QwenCloud Standard preset 12/12、Ink 中文标题 1/1、OpenTUI dialog 58/58；此前发生输入竞争的导航用例单独运行 1/1 通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS 覆盖上面列出的当前 head 定向 Vitest。此前 Linux sandbox 提供了真实 daemon A/B 证据，但当前 head 的 Linux 与 Windows 覆盖交给 CI。

### 环境（可选）

在现有 worktree 中直接运行 package 级 Vitest。当前 follow-up 没有执行本地 build。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：provider key 校验是 opt-in 的，因此没有 validator 的 provider 行为不变。现有 validator 都是无副作用的前缀检查，接受值在校验和落盘前都会一致地 trim。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实生产凭据、QwenCloud 联网调用、macOS 或 Windows 端到端启动、移除未使用的公共字段或导出、provider 卡片文案与命名决策，以及更大范围的鉴权对话框测试框架调整。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。无效的 provider-family key 会更早在输入时失败；合法配置和持久化格式不变。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14257。这里刻意不关闭该 issue，因为本 PR 只处理其中边界明确的 D1/D2、T1/T3-T9、I1、P5、S3、S6 和 S7。该 PR 叠在 #14073 之上，这些改动依赖它引入的 QwenCloud provider 入口。

</details>

prs.title: feat(runtime): add resident Workspace file sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the first resident Kubernetes Workspace file runtime as a standalone change on main. An explicitly configured tenant/Workspace retains one original Pod and fixed CSI PVC. The public Read/Write/Edit profile allows one unfinished Session and one active tool context. Closing A settles its work and permanently revokes its context while preserving the READY binding and RESERVED storage; B uses the original runtime and retained files.

Admission, dispatch and cleanup verify the persisted Workspace, generation, actor grant, Session fence and original owner. Distinct-key concurrent creation admits one Session; same-key retries return that admission. Uncertain release, missing original resources or changed identity block handoff. Normal application/Broker reconstruction uses the original saved binding and database, without replacing the worker or transferring storage.

This extracts only the resident first-release dependency closure from cumulative PR #13526: 50 files, including 23 production files (+774/-56 production lines), tests, configuration and synchronized designs. It reuses main's existing CSI provisioner, boot-3 managed-context worker and V1–V3 schema. No Core source, collector/Go package, private-retirement or physical-release increment, new migration, new public route or tool parameter is included. The original cumulative branch is preserved separately.

## Why it's needed

Sequential Sessions should retain a Workspace's files without destroying its runtime after each Session. Keeping the Pod alone does not settle unfinished work or prevent old authority from reopening. This change enforces logical handoff while keeping exclusive ownership of the original runtime and storage, and gives maintainers a focused first-release diff independent of the deferred K2 work.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure an exact tenant/Workspace/CSI registration and immutable worker image with the public files profile. Duplicate volume assignments, unconfigured CSI storage, foreign tenants and incompatible Shell/child/recovery settings must refuse.
2. Create Sessions concurrently for one Workspace. Different keys must produce one admission and a busy response; same-key retries must return the same Session. Unfinished or closing Sessions and unresolved Runtime Sessions must block a new admission.
3. Run Write/Edit/Read in A, close A through the public API, then run Read/Edit/Read in B. B's initial read must exactly equal A's final bytes on the same original runtime. Old context activation and dispatch must refuse, as must a second overlapping context and authorization crossing the durable close fence.
4. Check that completed Runtime Sessions are RELEASED, the binding remains READY and the physical reservation remains RESERVED. Close and replay must not drain the binding, delete the Pod/PVC, unpublish storage or change its owner. Missing/mismatched original owners and unknown release must retain the hold.
5. Normally reconstruct the application/Broker against the retained database while keeping the worker. B must succeed with the original binding generation, seed, lease, handle and reservation. Also verify ordinary local Workspace admission, cwd, child and lifecycle behavior when resident mappings are absent.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, public Workspace execution used Session isolation and close drained/stopped the runtime. After, an explicit resident mapping supports logical handoff on the original runtime and files. There is no TUI change.

The split was independently rebuilt and retested after merging main `17d5f774e`; results from the cumulative branch were not reused as acceptance of this tree. Node build/typecheck/bundle passed. Affected CLI checks, including the new main Hosted static-Skill consumers, passed 1,888 tests in 14 files; focused Maven verification passed 447 tests, followed by 210 ordinary local Workspace/close/child/lifecycle regressions. These groups had zero skips. The inherited CI meta-test passed 12 checks with two Linux-only checks skipped on macOS. The initial PR lint lane stopped at the stale-main gate before lint; the real main merge incorporates that gate update and will be revalidated by CI. Three bounded evidence-capture unit tests, changed TS/MJS ESLint, Java Checkstyle/SpotBugs, formatting and local documentation references passed. The extracted feature passed two consecutive clean full-diff self-audits; the real main merge was additionally reviewed twice against the unchanged feature closure and the three automatic-merge sites.

Independent verification freshly compiled the split's SDK and combined application: all 927 production classes matched the frozen build exactly. Fifteen resident H2 tests and both actual ordinary public handoff/application-reconstruction flows passed without skips. Each flow retained six real tool call/reply pairs and exact final-A/initial-B read bytes, plus four/five original-DataSource snapshots of eight ownership tables. The original worker started once, with zero physical releases. Reconstruction created fresh Spring, Broker, DataSource and repository instances while preserving the original placement. Actual metadata showed 32 application tables plus Flyway history, 59 operation columns and no V4 extension. This is same-JVM H2/ordinary-placement evidence, not a new ACK deployment or crash-recovery qualification.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Latest split build, focused unit/H2 checks and independent ordinary public handoff/reconstruction verified. |
| Windows | Not locally verified. |
| Linux | No new deployment or acceptance of this split; earlier ACK results remain bound to their earlier runtime. |

### Environment

Darwin arm64, Node 22 and Java 21. Independent checks resolve H2 2.4.240 and JUnit 5.14.1/Platform 1.14.1 from the new combined application layout. The ordinary public fixture uses a deterministic model and declared boot-2 directory placement, not an emulated CSI mount. Detailed E2E results are posted in a separate PR comment.

## Risk & Scope

- Resident mappings are opt-in. Only the public files profile is supported; one unfinished Session and one active context are allowed. In-place cwd changes, shared child Sessions, Shell/MCP/Hook profiles and multiple writers are unavailable.
- The original Pod/node/storage continue to incur cost after close. Automatic physical retirement, privileged collectors, physical stop/CSI unpublish proof, qualified historical retirement credentials, cross-Workspace safe volume reuse and automatic lost-Pod recovery remain deferred in #13526. Existing main private CSI guards are preserved.
- There is no schema migration or compatibility-policy change. Main's exact canonical catalog and refusal of legacy, partial or foreign state remain intact. The cumulative branch's V4 extension and unrelated CREATE timestamp fix are not carried into this PR.
- New ACK deployment, MySQL concurrency/recovery, external-model behavior, process-crash and database-HA qualification were not performed. Local same-JVM reconstruction does not establish crash recovery. Previously refused native acceptance groups were not retried. No new paid cloud resources were created.
- This crosses runtime/control-plane infrastructure and requires maintainer architecture review. Maintainer architecture review remains pending; no shipping review verdict is claimed.
- Complete synchronized documents: [design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-workspace-v1/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.md) / [设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-workspace-v1/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.zh-CN.md); [configuration (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-workspace-v1/deploy/k2-resident/README.md) / [配置（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-workspace-v1/deploy/k2-resident/README.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13395. Extracted from #13526; keep the broader K2 proposal open.

连续 Session 应保留 Workspace 文件，无需每次结束都销毁运行环境。单纯保留 Pod 无法结算未完成工作或阻止旧权限重新开启。本改动在保留原运行环境和存储独占归属的同时执行逻辑交接，也使维护者可以独立评审首版差量，无需同时处理延后的 K2 工作。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 配置精确租户/Workspace/CSI 注册、不可变 worker 镜像和公开 files 配置。重复卷分配、未配置的 CSI 存储、其他租户及不兼容的 Shell/子 Session/恢复设置必须拒绝。

4. 核对完成的 Runtime Session 为 RELEASED，binding 保持 READY，物理 reservation 保持 RESERVED。关闭和重放不得排空 binding、删除 Pod/PVC、卸载存储或改变 owner。原 owner 缺失/不匹配或释放未知时必须继续占用。
5. 保留 worker，从原数据库正常重建应用/Broker。B 必须使用原 binding generation、seed、lease、handle 和 reservation 成功运行。同时验证没有常驻映射时，普通本地 Workspace 准入、cwd、子 Session 和生命周期行为保持。

改动前，公开 Workspace 执行采用 Session 隔离，关闭会排空/停止运行环境。改动后，显式常驻映射支持在原运行环境和文件上进行逻辑交接。没有 TUI 改动。

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one-shot system reminders out of the user's own message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One-shot reminders that the interactive terminal UI folds into the front of a prompt are no longer shown back to the user. The transcript line for a prompt, the entry written to the cross-session ↑-recall history, the text refilled into the composer after a cancelled turn, and the same prompt as rebuilt when a session is resumed now all show what the user typed. The request sent to the model still carries the reminder exactly as before, and the machine-readable sidecar mirror of the conversation is deliberately left untouched, because its job is to report what was actually sent.

Removal is leading-only: a reminder tag the user pasted into the middle of their own prompt stays visible, and a tag that is never closed is left in place rather than swallowed. If a prompt were nothing but an envelope, the transcript keeps showing it rather than rendering an empty bubble.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a session that still had paused background agents made the first prompt render as a block of internal instructions — how to list agents, and how to message one by task id — followed by the user's own words. The user never wrote that text and cannot act on it. Cancelling the turn put the same block into the editable input box, so resubmitting sent internal context to the model as literal user text, and resuming that session again replayed it from the recording. This was reported internally during token-consumption governance work.

None of it was needed to keep the user informed. Each of the three notices that can be injected this way already has its own user-facing signal: restored background agents and a restored worktree each add an info line to the transcript, and workflow keyword steering lights an indicator in the footer. The headless and ACP runtimes both attach the notice as a separate part alongside the prompt rather than folding it in, so the interactive terminal path was the only one mixing a model-only payload into the string it also renders, logs and restores. This separates the two roles again at the points where a prompt is read back, instead of restructuring how the notice is delivered — the delivery side is threaded through the submission queue, speculation matching and side-question routing, and rewriting it is a much larger change than the defect warrants.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, launch a background agent, leave it paused/recoverable, exit, then `qwen --resume` that session.
2. Type any first prompt. Before: the transcript shows a `<system-reminder>` block reading "1 background agent was restored from this session. Use list_agents to inspect it and send_message with a task_id to continue one.", a blank line, then the prompt. After: only the prompt, with the separate info line "Restored 1 background agent from this session. Open Background tasks to inspect it." still present above it.
3. Confirm the model still receives the reminder — ask it what it was told about restored agents, or inspect the request payload in an API trace. It should be unchanged.
4. Cancel path: on that first prompt press ESC before any output arrives. The composer should refill with the prompt only, not the envelope. Resubmit and confirm the transcript is still clean.
5. ↑-recall: exit, start a new session in the same directory, press ↑. The recalled entry should be the prompt without the envelope.
6. Resume again: `qwen --resume` the session from step 1 and confirm the earlier prompt now renders without the envelope (this is the recording-replay path, fixed separately from the live path).
7. Paste guard: submit `before <system-reminder>x</system-reminder> after` and confirm the transcript shows it verbatim.
8. The worktree and workflow-steering notices reproduce the same way through their own one-shot latches (`--worktree`, or a prompt containing the workflow keyword with the feature enabled); both should now render only the user's words while keeping their info line and footer indicator.

Automated:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx \
  src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/utils/historyUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx
# 554 passed
npx tsc --noEmit            # clean
npx eslint <changed files>  # clean
npx prettier --check <changed files>  # clean
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

No terminal recording for this one — evidence is at the unit level, and I'm flagging that explicitly rather than implying a TUI capture was done.

- After: two new cases pin the live path (model request keeps the envelope while the transcript and the recall log carry only the user's words; stacked envelopes strip, mid-message and unterminated ones do not) and two pin the resume path (an envelope-only record restores as the bare prompt; a pasted envelope survives).
- Before: three pre-existing cancel-path expectations pinned the old text — they asserted the envelope inside the value that is both compared for identity and written back into the composer. Those three had to be updated, which is the direct before/after evidence for the cancel-restore path.
- Not run locally to completion: the full `packages/cli` suite. Every test file that mentions the reminder tag was run individually and passes, no snapshot contains it, and CI covers the rest.
- Pre-existing and unrelated: `src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts` fails 8 tests with `this.config.setCurrentSessionScheduledTaskCreator is not a function`. Verified identical on the base commit `0ef35351e9` with this branch's changes absent — the test's mocked config lacks a method the ACP session now calls. Not touched here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, lint and format on the changed files. No manual TUI run and no Windows/Linux run — the change is string handling with no platform-specific branch, but the manual steps above are the ones worth walking on a real terminal.

Fixes #11553
