prs.title: feat(artifacts): record files the agent creates or edits
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Implements the session artifact create-and-update lifecycle and updates the bilingual design to match. When the agent creates or modifies a workspace file, the same policy decides whether that file becomes a session artifact or only refreshes one the session already has. The built-in deliverable extensions now also include SQL, Python, Markdown, and JSON. An agent edit of a recorded file keeps the same artifact, syncs its content baseline, and shows the card on the turn that changed it. A host-registered artifact syncs its content when the agent edits the file, and keeps its title, retention, and ownership. An auto-recorded artifact the user deleted is not brought back by a later write. A card whose file drifted after it was recorded says it was modified since it was recorded, and can still be downloaded.

The earlier design sent a hash of the bytes the tool wrote so a change between the write and registration would stay marked as changed. That field is dropped. In daemon mode the write is delegated to the bridge, so the agent never holds the bytes that reach disk, and the store keeps reading the file itself, as it does today.

## Why it's needed

Today only creating a file with the write tool records an artifact. A file the user uploads and then asks the agent to edit never appears, and an agent edit of a recorded file leaves a stale baseline that later looks like an external modification. Creating a file with one tool and changing it with another also leaves the card on the creating turn.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the bilingual design documents still agree, and that they no longer describe an expected content hash from the tool. Then exercise the behaviors below against a daemon built from this branch. List artifacts after each step and watch artifact change events.

1. Copy `orders.csv` into the workspace and ask the agent to add a column by editing the file. A new artifact appears on this turn and can be previewed and downloaded.
2. Change it again on the next turn. The same artifact is updated, stays available, and shows on the new turn.
3. Have the agent create `report.html`, then edit it on a later turn. The same artifact is updated, its title stays the original name, and the card shows on the editing turn.
4. Edit one GBK CSV, one UTF-8 BOM CSV, and one CRLF CSV. After a refresh they stay available.
5. Register `data.xlsx` first with a client id and a custom title, then have the agent modify it. The content syncs, the status stays available, and the title, retention, and ownership stay as registered.
6. Register `notes.md`, then edit it on a later turn. The card shows on both turns.
7. Edit an uploaded `orders.sql`, and the same for `.py`, `.md`, and `.json`. Each is created without a host registration.
8. Edit an unrecorded `src/foo.ts`. No artifact is created.
9. Delete an auto-recorded artifact, then have the agent edit the file again. It is not recreated. An explicit registration of that path creates it again.
10. Change a recorded file from a terminal. After the refresh the card says it was modified since it was recorded and still downloads.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — verified with unit tests, `npm run build`, and `npm run typecheck` on macOS. No interactive session was driven end to end.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22. Unit tests for the file tools, the session artifact store, the bridge ingress, and the web shell turn cards. `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Markdown, JSON, and Python are common in ordinary coding sessions and become artifacts once the agent modifies them, which can push older artifacts past the 200-entry cap. Content-only sync of a host-owned artifact bypasses the cross-client rejection and needs maintainer confirmation. It changes only the content baseline, status, size, and the turn the card follows.
- Not validated / out of scope: an end-to-end daemon session, shell-command attribution, a revision trail, MCP artifact mapping, and showing the same artifact on every earlier turn that touched it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no data migration and no change to existing artifact ids. One behavior changes: rewriting a file no longer resurrects an auto-recorded artifact the user deleted.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/zjgzx1988/qwen-code/blob/docs/artifact-create-update-lifecycle/docs/design/daemon-session-artifacts/artifact-create-update-lifecycle.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/zjgzx1988/qwen-code/blob/docs/artifact-create-update-lifecycle/docs/design/daemon-session-artifacts/artifact-create-update-lifecycle.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #14282.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

实现会话 artifact 的创建与更新，并把中英设计文档改成与实现一致。agent 创建或修改工作区文件时，按同一策略决定是新建会话 artifact，还是只刷新会话里已经有的那一个。内置交付物扩展名追加 SQL、Python、Markdown、JSON。agent 修改已登记文件时保持同一个 artifact，同步内容基线，并把卡片显示在修改它的那一轮。宿主登记的 artifact 在 agent 改文件时只同步内容，标题、保留策略和归属不变。用户删除过的自动登记产物，之后再写入也不会复活。登记之后内容又偏离的卡片会提示「登记后已被修改」，并且仍然可以下载。

早期设计让工具上报写出字节的 hash，以便写入和登记之间的改动保持「已修改」。这个字段已去掉。daemon 模式下写盘委托给 bridge，agent 拿不到最终落盘的字节，store 仍像今天一样自己读文件。

## 为什么需要

目前只有写文件工具新建文件时才会登记 artifact。用户上传后再让 agent 修改的文件不会出现；agent 修改已登记文件后基线不更新，之后看起来像外部修改。一个工具创建、另一个工具再改，卡片也会停在创建它的那一轮。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

确认两份设计文档仍然一致，并且不再描述工具上报的内容 hash。然后用本分支构建的 daemon 验证下面的行为。每步之后列出 artifact，并观察变更事件。

1. 把 `orders.csv` 放进工作区，让 agent 用编辑加一列。本轮出现新 artifact，可预览、可下载。
2. 下一轮再改。同一个 artifact 被更新，状态仍可用，并出现在新的一轮。
3. 让 agent 创建 `report.html`，之后一轮再编辑。同一个 artifact 被更新，标题仍是原来的名字，卡片出现在编辑的那一轮。
4. 分别编辑 GBK、UTF-8 BOM、CRLF 的 CSV。刷新后都保持可用。
5. 先用 client id 和自定义标题登记 `data.xlsx`，再让 agent 修改。内容同步，状态仍可用，标题、保留策略和归属保持登记时的值。
6. 先登记 `notes.md`，之后一轮再编辑。卡片同时出现在两轮。
7. 编辑上传的 `orders.sql`，`.py`、`.md`、`.json` 同理。宿主不登记也会新建。
8. 编辑未登记的 `src/foo.ts`。不产生 artifact。
9. 删除一个自动登记的 artifact，再让 agent 编辑该文件。不会重建。之后显式登记该路径才会再建。
10. 在终端里改一个已登记文件。刷新后卡片提示登记后已被修改，并且仍可下载。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A。在 macOS 上用单测、`npm run build` 和 `npm run typecheck` 验证，没有做交互式端到端会话。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22。覆盖文件工具、会话 artifact store、bridge 入站和 web shell 卡片的单测。`npm run build` 与 `npm run typecheck` 通过。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险：Markdown、JSON、Python 在普通编码会话里很常见，agent 一改就会变成 artifact，可能把较早的 artifact 挤出 200 条上限。宿主归属 artifact 的只同步内容绕过了跨 client 拒绝，需要维护者确认。它只改内容基线、状态、大小，以及卡片跟随的轮次。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：端到端 daemon 会话、shell 命令归因、修订轨迹、MCP artifact 映射，以及在每个曾经改过它的轮次都显示同一张卡片。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移：不迁移数据，不改已有 artifact 的 id。只改变一个行为：再次写入不再复活用户删除过的自动登记产物。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/zjgzx1988/qwen-code/blob/docs/artifact-create-update-lifecycle/docs/design/daemon-session-artifacts/artifact-create-update-lifecycle.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/zjgzx1988/qwen-code/blob/docs/artifact-create-update-lifecycle/docs/design/daemon-session-artifacts/artifact-create-update-lifecycle.zh-CN.md)。

## Linked Issues

Closes #14282。

prs.title: fix(cli): recover Hosted journal-only tool batches after crashes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change adds a durable journal-only wait before a Hosted tool batch can make its first control-plane write. The wait names the protected calls, survives through the completed model-output boundary, and lets a replacement Harness either continue the interrupted round or cancel it from journal facts without acquiring a Runtime lease.

Recovery now covers background Agent and Workflow launches, Session messages, lead-side team/task operations, yolo approval mode, and Hooks Sessions. The Java coordinator client also recognizes the new recovery phase as continuable and cancellable.

## Why it's needed

A Harness crash after one journal-only call committed but before the next checkpoint left the Turn at a model-start phase that takeover refused. The lead Session then stayed blocked, committed work could not be answered, and child results could not reach the lead. The new wait closes that gap before the first domain write and preserves exactly-once answers from the existing journals.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a zero-Runtime control-plane batch and interrupt the Harness after its first durable domain write. Load the same Session through a replacement Hosted process and continue it. The replacement should report `await_journal`, should not acquire a Runtime lease, should answer committed calls from their durable records, should fill unreached calls as never run, and should resume the model. Repeating the scenario through the cancel route should settle the Turn and leave the Session loadable. For a Hooks+yolo team task, verify that the domain journal contains exactly one committed task record after recovery.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the replacement declined the Turn at `model_start`, and the lead remained blocked by `hosted_turn_recovery_required`.

After: replacement-process continue and cancel both settle the interrupted round; the Hooks+yolo task is committed once; final status is idle and unblocked.

![#13847 local acceptance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/issue-13847-acceptance.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS acceptance used the real JSONL managed-session journal and HTTP load/continue/cancel routes with a replacement Hosted Session. Final verification passed 101 Core tests, 6 focused CLI fault scenarios, 71 Java Hosted client tests, the CLI build, all-workspace typecheck, changed-file ESLint, and diff checks.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: takeover now admits one additional durable phase and allows Hooks recovery only for that phase; malformed, mixed-wait, mismatched-Turn, and unknown states remain blocked.
- Not validated / out of scope: a physical Kubernetes/MariaDB process-kill run and Windows/Linux execution; the local fault injection exercises the same durable JSONL journal and HTTP recovery control plane.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing checkpoints remain readable because the new group is optional and omitted when absent. A checkpoint written in the new phase requires a reader containing this change.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13847

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本改动在 Hosted 工具批次第一次写入控制面记录之前，新增一个持久化的 journal-only wait。该 wait 记录受保护调用，在模型输出完成边界之后继续保留，并让替代 Harness 在不获取 Runtime lease 的情况下，根据 journal 事实继续或取消被中断的轮次。

恢复范围覆盖后台 Agent 与 Workflow 启动、Session 消息、lead 侧 team/task 操作、yolo 审批模式和 Hooks Session。Java 协调器客户端也会把新的恢复阶段识别为可继续、可取消。

## 为什么需要

此前 Harness 在某个 journal-only 调用已经提交、但下一个 checkpoint 尚未写入时崩溃，Turn 会停在接管不接受的模型起步阶段。lead Session 因此持续阻塞，已提交工作无法得到回答，child 结果也无法回到 lead。新的 wait 在第一次领域写入前封住这个窗口，并继续由现有 journal 提供只执行一次的回答。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

启动一个零 Runtime 的控制面批次，在第一次持久化领域写入之后中断 Harness。通过替代 Hosted 进程加载同一个 Session 并继续。替代进程应报告 `await_journal`，不获取 Runtime lease，按持久化记录回答已提交调用，把未执行调用补为 never run，然后恢复模型轮次。通过 cancel 路径重复该场景时，Turn 应完成结算并让 Session 恢复可加载。对于 Hooks+yolo 的 team task，恢复后领域 journal 应只有一条已提交的 task 记录。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：替代进程在 `model_start` 拒绝 Turn，lead 持续被 `hosted_turn_recovery_required` 阻塞。

After：替代进程的 continue 与 cancel 都能结算中断轮次；Hooks+yolo task 只提交一次；最终状态为空闲且无阻塞。

![#13847 本地验收](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/issue-13847-acceptance.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 macOS 验收使用真实 JSONL managed-session journal 与 HTTP load/continue/cancel 路径，并启动替代 Hosted Session。最终验证通过 101 项 Core 测试、6 个聚焦 CLI 故障场景、71 项 Java Hosted client 测试、CLI build、全工作区 typecheck、改动文件 ESLint 和 diff 检查。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：接管新增接受一个持久阶段，并且 Hooks 只为该阶段开放恢复；畸形状态、混合 wait、Turn 不匹配和未知状态仍保持阻塞。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：物理 Kubernetes/MariaDB 进程 kill，以及 Windows/Linux 执行；本地故障注入覆盖同一套持久 JSONL journal 和 HTTP 恢复控制面。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：现有 checkpoint 仍可读取，因为新 group 为可选，缺失时不会编码。新阶段写出的 checkpoint 需要包含本改动的 reader。
- 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13847

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add file-tree deletion with confirmation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds **Delete** to regular-file context menus in the Files panel. A second confirmation shows the absolute workspace file path and warns that deletion is permanent. Successful deletion removes the row and its active preview while preserving other expanded folders; failures stay visible for retry.

Deletion is authenticated and restricted to the selected trusted local workspace. Unsupported workspaces do not fall back to the primary workspace.

## Why it's needed

The Files panel already supports browsing, previews, references, path copying, downloads, drag-and-drop uploads, file/folder creation and confirmed folder deletion. Users currently need another tool to remove an unwanted file.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Files in a trusted local workspace and right-click a regular file. Expect **Delete** (中文“删除”) in the menu.
2. Choose Delete. Expect the absolute workspace file path and an irreversible-deletion warning, with Cancel initially focused. Cancel or Escape must leave the file intact and restore focus to the active tree row.
3. Confirm deletion. While pending, cancellation and repeated submission are disabled. On success, the file disappears and its active preview closes; other expanded directories remain expanded and focus returns to an active tree row.
4. Verify that a failed request keeps the file and offers retry. Symlinks, SSH workspaces and daemons without the required capabilities must not offer regular-file deletion. Folder deletion retains its existing separate capability and confirmation; directories must never be sent to the file-delete endpoint. Deleting from a secondary workspace must preserve a same-named file in the primary workspace.

5. After deleting a file, drop a same-named local file onto the tree. Expect it to reappear after upload and remain deletable; other expanded folders stay open.

### Evidence (Before & After)

These are actual browser captures using a **simulated daemon**. They verify the absolute confirmation path and post-delete tree state; actual disk deletion and workspace isolation were verified separately against a real bundled daemon.

| Before deletion: file and preview visible | After: Delete menu action |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/77e0e96cfc21bb25fdba81932c94a5163046bd0b/web-shell-file-delete/before.png) | ![Delete action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/77e0e96cfc21bb25fdba81932c94a5163046bd0b/web-shell-file-delete/menu.png) |

| Irreversible confirmation | Success: row removed, another folder remains expanded |
| --- | --- |
| ![Confirmation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/77e0e96cfc21bb25fdba81932c94a5163046bd0b/web-shell-file-delete/confirmation.png) | ![Completed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/77e0e96cfc21bb25fdba81932c94a5163046bd0b/web-shell-file-delete/completed.png) |

Images are pinned to an immutable commit on a separate fork assets branch and are not part of the implementation branch.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.14.0. Latest main merge: full build, typecheck, bundle, lint/format, 743 focused unit tests, one real bundled-daemon capability integration and the complete 47-case Files browser suite passed. The browser suite covers creation, uploads, folder deletion and regular-file deletion together, including delete → same-name upload → delete. Transcript mutation actions are excluded at build time; JS measures 1,330,713 UTF-16 units below main’s unchanged 1,331,500 ceiling. Four current screenshots were refreshed and visually checked. Browser tests use a simulated daemon; the capability integration verifies advertisement, while real-daemon disk deletion/isolation was verified in earlier rounds and not repeated this round. A separate comment contains the latest E2E report.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: deletion is permanent. Portable path-based unlink cannot make replacement of a parent directory by an external process fully atomic; canonical-parent checks retain the existing filesystem mutation boundary model.
- Not validated / out of scope: symlink and SSH deletion; Windows/Linux execution; the remaining non-atomic race with uncooperative external processes. Deterministic parent-replacement guards, canonical path locking and same-name workspace isolation are covered by committed regression tests.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The action is gated on advertised capabilities and workspace ownership.
- Synchronized design: [English](docs/design/web-shell-file-delete.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell-file-delete.zh-CN.md).

prs.title: feat(mods): support commands in interactive terminals (PR4a)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables the experimental Mod command, lifecycle and logging subset in both Ink and OpenTUI. A trusted, enabled plugin can register slash commands that appear in completion, run without a model request, retain module state across commands and committed conversation switches, and respond to Esc cancellation. Commands receive the active terminal presentation and composer origin; transcript logs stay out of model input.

## Why it's needed

The previous stages support this subset in headless sessions. The same installed Mod currently appears as an unknown command in the terminal UI. PR4a connects the existing isolated runtime to both terminal renderers and keeps unsupported terminal tool interception explicit.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Enable `experimental.mods` and install the documented hello Mod in a trusted workspace. In both renderers, confirm `/hello Qwen` appears in completion, returns its text without a model request, and retains its counter on repeated calls. A name collision must preserve the built-in command and expose the plugin command with its extension prefix.
- Check composer origin, terminal surface, fullscreen state and current width, including after resizing. Transcript logs should be visible, debug-only logs should stay private, and neither should enter the next model prompt. Terminal control sequences must be removed while ordinary newlines/tabs in logs and command results remain readable; completion metadata stays on one line and bidi controls are stripped.
- Cancel a pending Mod command with Esc and run another command. Late results/logs must not leak into the transcript. Clear or resume a conversation without reloading the modules; failed session switches must not send the replacement lifecycle event. The existing Ink branch limitation is recorded below.
- Break Mod startup and confirm the error stays visible, input remains available, and the actual built-in `/help` / `/?` and `/quit` / `/exit` still work. Ordinary prompts, model-calling commands, stacked skills, follow-up suggestions, away summaries and fast-model voice refinement must not invoke the language model; file/plugin commands with recovery names must not bypass this gate.
- Restore a session with a wildcard Mod: the terminal-tool capability diagnostic must remain visible even when Mod startup completes before the first frame. Explicit `tool.call`, `tool.check` or `tool.*` registrations must block initialization before a model request.

Review-repair validation on `21d0c8d0ef`: build, typecheck, bundle, changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff checks pass. The 10 affected CLI test files total 827 passes, and all 47 SDK Java workflow tests pass after the main sync. Independent terminal/headless verification passes 16/16 scenarios, including a positive-control test of resumed-history suggestions. Details and evidence boundaries are recorded in the updated E2E comment. A subsequent main sync to `cebf5719bc` preserves all 44 PR files byte-for-byte; build, typecheck and bundle are rerun on the merged head. Hosted CI is separate from these local checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Renderer | Before: frozen PR3b | After: initial PR4a |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ink / Node | ![Ink before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c1c963335fad3611846b14f4ebb69844a6fbc9bf/ink-before.png) | ![Ink after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c1c963335fad3611846b14f4ebb69844a6fbc9bf/ink-after.png) |
| Strict OpenTUI / Bun | ![OpenTUI before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c1c963335fad3611846b14f4ebb69844a6fbc9bf/opentui-before.png) | ![OpenTUI after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c1c963335fad3611846b14f4ebb69844a6fbc9bf/opentui-after.png) |

[Capture provenance and artifact hashes](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/c1c963335fad3611846b14f4ebb69844a6fbc9bf/README.md).

Actual terminal output rendered through tmux, xterm.js and Playwright; 140 × 45 cells, macOS, isolated self-authored fixture and localhost fake OpenAI provider. Each screenshot scenario makes zero model requests. Before uses the frozen PR3b bundle, not a rebuild of today's main; After uses the initial PR4a bundle (`26cc8ec4`); the subsequent review repairs are covered in the updated E2E comment. These are local contract checks, not live-model or arbitrary-Claude-Mod compatibility acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local unit/build checks and Ink/OpenTUI terminal fixtures |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 25.9.0 for Ink/headless, Bun 1.3.13 for strict OpenTUI; renderer fallback was not accepted. Isolated settings/workspaces, frozen fixtures and a deterministic localhost fake provider. Source base after synchronizing main: `cebf5719bc`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: invalid or explicitly unsupported Mod registrations block language-model requests and non-recovery commands. Input and the actual built-in help/quit commands remain available, with a visible error; fixing the configuration requires restarting. Cancellation and conversation replacement retain the existing bounded, awaited worker lifecycle.
- Not validated / out of scope: terminal tool interception, UI panels, state/store/model/process APIs, ACP, managed/SSH, sandbox and session-agent hosts. Ink `/branch` still hits a previously reproduced busy guard in the old bundle and Mods-disabled controls; it is not counted as an E2E pass. OpenTUI branch and Ink clear/resume are covered.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no setting migration; `experimental.mods` remains disabled by default. A worker terminated for unresponsive cancellation requires restarting the CLI. Existing headless tool interception and identities remain supported.

## Linked Issues

PR4a follow-up to #14027. No tracking issue is closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 中接入实验性的 Mod 命令、生命周期和日志子集。受信任且已启用的插件可以注册斜杠命令，出现在补全中，不调用模型即可执行，并在连续命令和已提交的会话切换之间保留模块状态；运行中的命令支持 Esc 取消。命令收到实际终端展示参数和 composer 来源，界面日志不会进入模型输入。

## Why it's needed

前几个阶段已在 headless 会话实现这部分能力，但同一已安装 Mod 在终端界面中仍会被识别为未知命令。PR4a 将现有隔离运行时接入两种终端，同时明确说明终端暂不支持工具拦截。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- 启用 `experimental.mods`，在受信任工作区安装文档中的 hello Mod。在两种终端确认 `/hello Qwen` 出现在补全中、不请求模型即可返回文本，多次调用保留计数；命名冲突时保留内置命令，并通过扩展前缀暴露插件命令。
- 检查 composer 来源、terminal surface、全屏状态和当前列宽，包括调整窗口大小之后。界面日志可见，debug 日志不进入界面，两者都不进入下一次模型输入；移除终端控制序列，同时保留日志和命令结果中的普通换行、制表符；补全元数据保持单行并移除 bidi 控制字符。
- 用 Esc 取消等待中的 Mod 命令，再执行下一条命令。迟到的结果和日志不能进入界面。清空或恢复会话后模块不重新加载；失败的会话切换不触发替换生命周期事件。Ink 分支的现有限制见下文。
- 让 Mod 初始化失败，确认错误可见、输入仍可用，实际内置的 `/help` / `/?` 和 `/quit` / `/exit` 可以执行。普通请求、调用模型的命令、组合 skill、后续建议、离开摘要和 fast model 语音润色不得调用语言模型；同名文件或插件命令不能绕过此限制。
- 使用订阅通配事件的 Mod 恢复会话：即使 Mod 在首帧前完成初始化，终端不支持工具事件的提示也必须保留。显式注册 `tool.call`、`tool.check` 或 `tool.*` 时，应在请求模型前拒绝初始化。

`21d0c8d0ef` 上的 review 修复构建、类型检查、打包、改动文件 ESLint/Prettier 和 diff 检查通过。10 个受影响 CLI 测试文件合计 827 项通过，同步主干后 SDK Java 工作流测试 47 项通过。独立终端/headless 验证 16/16 个场景通过，包括带健康对照的恢复历史后续建议测试。详细结果及证据边界见更新后的 E2E 评论；后续再次同步主干至 `cebf5719bc`，44 个 PR 文件逐字节保持一致，并在合并后的提交重新执行构建、类型检查和打包；远端 CI 与本地验证分别记录。

### Evidence (Before & After)

上方分别提供 Ink 和 OpenTUI 的前后截图：真实终端输出经 tmux、xterm.js 和 Playwright 渲染；140 × 45 字符，macOS、隔离的自编写测试插件、本地假 OpenAI 服务。每个截图场景的模型请求数为零。Before 使用冻结的 PR3b 包，并非对当前 main 的重新构建；After 使用初始 PR4a 包（`26cc8ec4`）；此后 review 修复的验证记录见更新后的 E2E 评论。这些证据属于本地协议验证，不代表真实模型或任意 Claude Mod 的兼容性验收。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地单测/构建和 Ink/OpenTUI 真实终端测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未做本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未做本地验证 |

### Environment (optional)

Ink/headless 使用 Node 25.9.0，严格 OpenTUI 使用 Bun 1.3.13，不把回退到其他渲染器算作通过。使用隔离配置/工作区、冻结插件和确定性的本地假模型。同步主干后的源码基线为 `cebf5719bc`。

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: 无效或显式不受支持的 Mod 注册会阻止语言模型请求及非恢复命令。错误保持可见，输入及实际内置的帮助、退出命令仍可用；修正配置后需要重启。取消和会话替换沿用有时间上限、按顺序等待的 worker 生命周期。
- Not validated / out of scope: 终端工具拦截、UI 面板、state/store/model/process API，以及 ACP、managed/SSH、sandbox、session-agent 宿主均不在本阶段范围内。Ink `/branch` 仍触发现有 busy guard，已在旧包和关闭 Mods 的对照中复现，未计为 E2E 通过；OpenTUI 分支和 Ink 清空/恢复已覆盖。
- Breaking changes / migration notes: 无配置迁移，`experimental.mods` 默认仍关闭；worker 因无法响应取消而被终止后，需要重启 CLI。已有 headless 工具拦截和身份字段仍受支持。

## Linked Issues

PR4a 是 #14027 的后续阶段，不关闭跟踪 issue。

prs.title: test: skip the chmod-based core, wecom and scripts tests where permission bits do not bind
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ten tests outside `packages/cli` fail every time they run as root, because root with its DAC capabilities bypasses the mode bits their fixtures rely on (a read-only or mode-000 directory or file):

- `core`: `skill-curator` "reports skippedErrors when rename fails transiently"; `git-worktrees` "never lets "cannot look" pass for "nothing is there"" and "says it cannot tell wherever it could not look"; `session-writer-lease` "classifies an unreadable owned lock as unavailable"
- `channels/wecom`: "continues attachment cleanup when one dir removal fails"
- `scripts/tests`: `qwen-pr-review-workflow` "repairs a single unwritable directory instead of failing fast" and "fails fast when repair is impossible"; `qwen-autofix-workflow` "locks the runner file-command backing files against env plants" and the unreadable-counter shape of "refuses an instrument that changed after staging"; `desktop-smoke-teardown` "reports a workspace it cannot delete without failing a passed check"

This PR guards them on whether a mode-000 directory actually refuses the process, as #14162 does for cli, instead of on uid:

- `core` gets its own copy of the cli test helper `arePermissionBitsEnforced()` and its tests, as it already has its own copy of `latency-budget`. The copy is the one #14271 merged (real `node:fs` through `createRequire`, so a test file's `vi.mock` cannot change the answer).
- `wecom` cannot import across packages (`import/no-relative-packages`), so its one case carries a small inline probe with the same semantics, which also names an inconclusive probe on stderr.
- `scripts/tests` imports the cli helper, as other scripts tests already import cli sources.
- "refuses an instrument that changed after staging" checked five tampering shapes and only the unreadable one needs the bits, so that shape moves to its own case, "refuses an instrument made unreadable after staging", which shows as skipped where the bits do not bind; the other four keep running as root.
- The two `git-worktrees` cases also checked a link loop, a linked `.git` and an oversized `.git`, which need no permission bits. Those move to two cases of their own, still skipped on Windows for its symlink privilege, so they now run as root too.
- The autofix self-check that pins every mapfile-crossing case to `it.skipIf(!hasBashMapfile)` now pins each case's exact guard, with `!hasBashMapfile || !arePermissionBitsEnforced()` on the one that needs both.

From review, in a second commit:

- `scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js` pins ci.yml's root branch: the `setpriv` assignment sits uncommented inside the uid-0 branch, nothing resets `test_runner` after it, and both the workspaces and the scripts command run under it. Without that a root lane keeps CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and every gate here skips while CI stays green; until now nothing pinned it.
- Under GitHub Actions an inconclusive probe opens its stderr line with `::warning::` (cli and core helpers, wecom inline probe), so the skips show in the check UI instead of only deep in the log. The answer, and so the skip, is unchanged.
- `permission-bits.mocked-fs.test.ts` first checks that its `node:fs` mock is installed, for the named and the default export; before, it passed whether or not the mock was there.
- The autofix status-0 self-check ("gates every status-0 weakening flow on the host probe") accepts `!hasBashMapfile` ahead of another guard, as the mapfile self-check already does.
- The cli copy of the helper and its tests gets the same changes: the two copies are byte-identical.

## Why it's needed

Run as root, as on many dev containers and test machines, these packages report the same ten failures every time, which buries real failures among known noise. A uid check would also silence them, but `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs unit tests on root lanes through `setpriv`, dropping CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH so that permission tests still exercise their paths there; the probe keeps these tests running on such a lane, and they pass there.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
(cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/test-utils/permission-bits.test.ts src/test-utils/permission-bits.mocked-fs.test.ts src/skills/skill-curator.test.ts src/utils/git-worktrees.test.ts src/services/session-writer-lease.test.ts)
(cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/test-utils/permission-bits.test.ts src/test-utils/permission-bits.mocked-fs.test.ts)
(cd packages/channels/wecom && npx vitest run src/WeComAdapter.test.ts)
npx vitest run --config scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-pr-review-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/desktop-smoke-teardown.test.js
```

Results on Linux x86_64, at the head of this PR:

| Setup | core (5 files) | cli (2 files) | wecom | scripts (4 files) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main, as root | 4 failed | — | 1 failed | 5 failed |
| this PR, as root | 217 passed, 5 skipped | 17 passed | 141 passed, 1 skipped | 653 passed, 8 skipped |
| this PR, as uid 1000 (`unshare --user --map-user=1000`) | 220 passed, 2 skipped | 17 passed | 142 passed | 660 passed, 1 skipped |
| this PR, as root without DAC capabilities (ci.yml's `setpriv` flags) | 221 passed, 1 skipped | 17 passed | 142 passed | 658 passed, 3 skipped |
| the same, with `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` | 221 passed, 1 skipped | 17 passed | 142 passed | 658 passed, 3 skipped |

The skips left as a regular user or without DAC capabilities are pre-existing guards unrelated to this change. On main, the same ten tests pass as uid 1000 and as root without DAC capabilities.

- Mutations of the core helper (a uid check instead of the probe, reading the mockable `node:fs`, accepting any errno, dropping the diagnostic) fail its tests as root and as uid 1000.
- The split `git-worktrees` cases fail when their fixture is taken out (no link loop: `absent`; a readable `.git` directory instead of the link: `present`).
- The autofix self-check ("gates every mapfile-crossing runGate flow on the host probe") fails when `!hasBashMapfile` is removed from the guarded case, and when the probe is added to a case that does not need it; it still passes when Prettier wraps a guard. The split unreadable case fails where the bits bind (uid 1000) when its expected reason is changed.
- Forcing the wecom probe to be inconclusive prints `[permission-bits] probe inconclusive (ENOENT) for WeComAdapter.test.ts; …` and skips the case; with `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` the line starts with `::warning::`. A collection-time line from the core helper also reaches vitest's output at the start of a line, so the runner can read it as an annotation.
- The ci.yml pin fails when the `setpriv` assignment is emptied, commented out, moved out of the root branch or made conditional; when `test_runner` is reset, unset, re-declared or re-read before the commands; when a command loses the prefix or an unwrapped copy is added. A blank line or comment in the branch, and re-indenting it, keep it green.
- The mock control fails when the `vi.mock('node:fs')` factory is deleted, or leaves the default export real.
- The annotation case fails when the prefix is dropped; the plain-line case fails when the prefix is unconditional; both fail when the line loses its newline.
- The status-0 self-check, with a `weaken:` knob added to the combined-guard case, fails under the old literal and passes under the new pattern; it still fails for a case that loses `!hasBashMapfile`, and accepts a Prettier-wrapped single guard.
- `tsc --noEmit` for core and for the cli helper files; ESLint (`--max-warnings 0`) and Prettier on the changed files: clean.
- Review: three rounds, each with an open-ended and an adversarial reviewer. Round 1 found the missed `desktop-smoke-teardown` test and that the `git-worktrees` guards also skipped sub-cases that need no permission bits; round 2 that the unreadable autofix shape dropped out of its loop without showing as skipped, plus hardening for the inline wecom probe and the autofix self-check. All are fixed here. Round 3 found no Critical.
- The review-bot round's four Suggestions got two more rounds of the same. The first found that a substring pin of ci.yml passed with the line commented out or reset, that the mock control checked only the named export, and that nothing pinned the plain line outside Actions; all are fixed. The second found that it still passed with `unset test_runner` or an extra unwrapped run, so the pin now compares the step's code lines; fixed. The third found no Critical.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (tests only; see the table above).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

On macOS (regular user) the probe answers true, so these tests run as before; on Windows it answers false, matching the old `win32` guards (the probe also covers the symlink privilege `git-worktrees` notes there, since it skips the whole case on Windows).

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the core helper duplicates the cli one, so a later change to one must be mirrored in the other, as with `latency-budget`; this PR changes both, and they stay byte-identical. `scripts/tests` imports the cli helper, so it uses the hardened copy #14271 merged.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows locally. Other `process.getuid?.() === 0` skips in core, channels and scripts that guard permission tests (two in `qwen-pr-review-workflow`, for one) could move to the probe too; they skip rather than fail as root, and this PR only fixes the tests that fail. The ci.yml pin covers the one step that runs these tests, and the wecom probe's `::warning::` prefix has no test of its own (the cli and core helpers pin theirs).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test code only.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #14162 and #14271.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`packages/cli` 以外有十个测试，每次以 root 运行都会失败，因为带 DAC 能力的 root 会绕过它们的 fixture 所依赖的权限位（只读或 000 权限的目录或文件）：

- `core`：`skill-curator` 的 "reports skippedErrors when rename fails transiently"；`git-worktrees` 的 "never lets "cannot look" pass for "nothing is there"" 与 "says it cannot tell wherever it could not look"；`session-writer-lease` 的 "classifies an unreadable owned lock as unavailable"
- `channels/wecom`："continues attachment cleanup when one dir removal fails"
- `scripts/tests`：`qwen-pr-review-workflow` 的 "repairs a single unwritable directory instead of failing fast" 与 "fails fast when repair is impossible"；`qwen-autofix-workflow` 的 "locks the runner file-command backing files against env plants"，以及 "refuses an instrument that changed after staging" 中计数器不可读的那一种情形；`desktop-smoke-teardown` 的 "reports a workspace it cannot delete without failing a passed check"

本 PR 与 #14162 在 cli 中的做法一样，按"000 权限的目录是否真的拒绝本进程"来守护它们，而不是按 uid：

- `core` 拥有自己的一份 cli 测试辅助函数 `arePermissionBitsEnforced()` 及其测试，就像它已有自己的一份 `latency-budget`。这份副本取自 #14271 合入的版本（通过 `createRequire` 使用真实的 `node:fs`，测试文件的 `vi.mock` 无法改变它的答案）。
- `wecom` 不能跨包导入（`import/no-relative-packages`），因此它唯一的这个用例带了一个语义相同的小型内联探测，探测无法测量时同样会在 stderr 上说明。
- `scripts/tests` 直接导入 cli 的辅助函数，其他 scripts 测试也已经在导入 cli 的源码。
- "refuses an instrument that changed after staging" 原本检查五种篡改情形，只有不可读的那一种需要权限位，所以这一种被拆成独立用例 "refuses an instrument made unreadable after staging"，在权限位不生效时显示为 skipped；另外四种在 root 下照常运行。
- `git-worktrees` 的两个用例还顺带检查了链接环、作为链接的 `.git` 和超长的 `.git`，这些都不需要权限位。它们被拆成两个独立用例，仍因 Windows 的软链接特权在 Windows 上跳过，因此现在在 root 下也会运行。
- autofix 中那条把所有跨 mapfile 用例固定为 `it.skipIf(!hasBashMapfile)` 的自检，现在为每个用例固定它确切的守卫，需要两个条件的那个用例固定为 `!hasBashMapfile || !arePermissionBitsEnforced()`。

根据评审意见，在第二个提交中：

- `scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js` 固定 ci.yml 的 root 分支：`setpriv` 赋值未被注释、位于 uid 0 分支内，之后没有任何地方重置 `test_runner`，并且 workspaces 与 scripts 两条命令都在它之下运行。否则 root 车道会保留 CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE，这里的所有守卫都会跳过，而 CI 依然是绿的；此前没有任何测试固定它。
- 在 GitHub Actions 下，无法测量的探测会让 stderr 那一行以 `::warning::` 开头（cli 与 core 的辅助函数、wecom 的内联探测），这样跳过会显示在检查界面里，而不只是埋在日志深处。答案以及随之而来的跳过都不变。
- `permission-bits.mocked-fs.test.ts` 先检查它对 `node:fs` 的 mock 确实装上了，具名导出与 default 导出都检查；此前无论 mock 是否存在它都会通过。
- autofix 的 status-0 自检（"gates every status-0 weakening flow on the host probe"）接受 `!hasBashMapfile` 位于另一个守卫之前的写法，与 mapfile 自检一致。
- cli 那份辅助函数及其测试做了同样的修改：两份副本逐字节一致。

## 为什么需要

以 root 运行（很多开发容器和测试机都是如此）时，这几个包每次都报同样的十个失败，真正的失败因此淹没在已知噪声里。按 uid 判断也能让它们安静下来，但 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 在 root 车道上会通过 `setpriv` 去掉 CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE 与 CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH 来运行单元测试，让权限类测试在那里依然走到要测的路径；用探测守护，这些测试会在这类车道上继续运行，并且通过。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```
(cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/test-utils/permission-bits.test.ts src/test-utils/permission-bits.mocked-fs.test.ts src/skills/skill-curator.test.ts src/utils/git-worktrees.test.ts src/services/session-writer-lease.test.ts)
(cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/test-utils/permission-bits.test.ts src/test-utils/permission-bits.mocked-fs.test.ts)
(cd packages/channels/wecom && npx vitest run src/WeComAdapter.test.ts)
npx vitest run --config scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-pr-review-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/desktop-smoke-teardown.test.js
```

在 Linux x86_64 上、本 PR 最新提交的结果：

| 环境 | core（5 个文件） | cli（2 个文件） | wecom | scripts（4 个文件） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main，root | 4 个失败 | — | 1 个失败 | 5 个失败 |
| 本 PR，root | 217 个通过、5 个 skipped | 17 个通过 | 141 个通过、1 个 skipped | 653 个通过、8 个 skipped |
| 本 PR，uid 1000（`unshare --user --map-user=1000`） | 220 个通过、2 个 skipped | 17 个通过 | 142 个通过 | 660 个通过、1 个 skipped |
| 本 PR，去掉 DAC 能力的 root（ci.yml 的 `setpriv` 参数） | 221 个通过、1 个 skipped | 17 个通过 | 142 个通过 | 658 个通过、3 个 skipped |
| 同上，加 `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` | 221 个通过、1 个 skipped | 17 个通过 | 142 个通过 | 658 个通过、3 个 skipped |

以普通用户或去掉 DAC 能力运行时剩下的 skipped，都是与本改动无关的既有守卫。在 main 上，这十个测试以 uid 1000 与去掉 DAC 能力的 root 运行时同样通过。

- 对 core 辅助函数的变异（用 uid 判断代替探测、读取可被 mock 的 `node:fs`、接受任意 errno、去掉诊断）在 root 与 uid 1000 下都会让它的测试失败。
- 拆出来的 `git-worktrees` 用例在去掉各自的 fixture 后会失败（没有链接环时得到 `absent`；用可读的 `.git` 目录代替链接时得到 `present`）。
- 从被守护的 autofix 用例中去掉 `!hasBashMapfile`，或给不需要探测的用例加上探测，autofix 的自检（"gates every mapfile-crossing runGate flow on the host probe"）都会失败；守卫被 Prettier 折行时它仍然通过。拆出来的不可读用例在权限位生效的环境（uid 1000）下，改掉期望的原因后会失败。
- 让 wecom 的探测无法测量时，会输出 `[permission-bits] probe inconclusive (ENOENT) for WeComAdapter.test.ts; …` 并跳过该用例；设置 `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` 时该行以 `::warning::` 开头。core 辅助函数在收集阶段写出的那一行，在 vitest 的输出里同样位于行首，runner 能把它识别为注解。
- 把 `setpriv` 赋值改空、注释掉、移出 root 分支或改成有条件的；在命令之前重置、unset、重新 declare 或 read `test_runner`；某条命令丢掉前缀或多出一份不带前缀的副本：ci.yml 的固定断言都会失败。分支内加空行或注释、重新缩进，它仍然通过。
- 删除 `vi.mock('node:fs')` 工厂函数，或让 default 导出保持真实，mock 对照都会失败。
- 去掉前缀时注解用例失败；前缀变成无条件时普通行用例失败；行尾换行丢失时两者都失败。
- 给组合守卫的用例加上 `weaken:` 旋钮后，status-0 自检在旧字面量下失败、在新写法下通过；用例丢掉 `!hasBashMapfile` 时它仍然失败，Prettier 折行的单个守卫也能接受。
- core 与 cli 辅助函数文件的 `tsc --noEmit`；变更文件的 ESLint（`--max-warnings 0`）与 Prettier：干净。
- 评审：共三轮，每轮一个无方向审计与一个对抗审计。第 1 轮发现漏掉的 `desktop-smoke-teardown` 测试，以及 `git-worktrees` 的守卫连带跳过了不需要权限位的子用例；第 2 轮发现 autofix 中不可读的那种情形从循环里被去掉、却不会显示为 skipped，另有对 wecom 内联探测与 autofix 自检的加固建议。以上都已在本 PR 修复。第 3 轮没有 Critical。
- 针对 review bot 那一轮的四条建议，又做了两轮同样的审计。第一轮发现：对 ci.yml 的子串式固定断言在该行被注释或被重置时依然通过、mock 对照只检查了具名导出、Actions 之外的普通行没有被固定；以上都已修复。第二轮发现该固定断言在 `unset test_runner` 或多出一份不带前缀的调用时依然通过，于是改为比较该 step 的代码行；已修复。第三轮没有 Critical。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（只改测试，见上表）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

在 macOS（普通用户）上探测返回 true，这些测试与以前一样运行；在 Windows 上返回 false，与原来的 `win32` 守卫一致（`git-worktrees` 提到的 Windows 上的软链接特权也被覆盖，因为探测在 Windows 上会跳过整个用例）。

### 环境（可选）

只有单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：core 的辅助函数与 cli 的那份重复，之后修改其中一份时需要同步另一份，与 `latency-budget` 相同；本 PR 同时修改了两份，它们保持逐字节一致。`scripts/tests` 导入 cli 的辅助函数，用的就是 #14271 合入的加固版本。
- 未验证或不在范围内：本地未在 macOS 与 Windows 上验证。core、channels 与 scripts 中其他守护权限测试的 `process.getuid?.() === 0` 跳过条件（例如 `qwen-pr-review-workflow` 中的两个）也可以改用探测；它们在 root 下是跳过而不是失败，本 PR 只修复会失败的测试。ci.yml 的固定断言只覆盖运行这些测试的那一个 step；wecom 探测的 `::warning::` 前缀没有单独的测试（cli 与 core 的辅助函数各自固定了它们的格式）。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；只改测试代码。

## 关联 Issue

#14162 与 #14271 的后续。

prs.title: refactor(core): separate CLI launcher from JS interpreter (MYWO-8)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Separates the executable used to launch Qwen Code from the interpreter used to run JavaScript children. Hook supervision, sandbox file writes and code-mode execution now resolve an interpreter from the caller's standalone installation; source and npm installations keep the current interpreter. This prepares those features for a launcher that cannot itself execute arbitrary JavaScript, without switching the CLI's default runtime.

## Why it's needed

When a packaged application's executable is reused to start a JavaScript worker, the worker can relaunch the application instead of executing its script. Previously these callers used the application's executable directly. The new resolver accepts a recognized runtime manifest beside the installation's entry marker, validates the declared interpreter as an executable file, and falls back to the current interpreter for invalid or missing declarations. Users should retain working hooks, sandbox writes and code-mode children when packaging separates the launcher and interpreter.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use this PR's exact head, `fed48b85c8d67172968c51b62cf0c1493dc60665`. Exercise source/npm layouts and valid Node/Bun standalone layouts. Source/npm children should use the current interpreter; standalone children should use the installation's declared executable, not an unrelated ancestor manifest.
2. Try missing binaries, non-executable files, directories, malformed manifests and unknown runtimes. Each should use the documented fallback. Verify the hook, sandbox and code-mode callers still execute JavaScript rather than relaunching the application.
3. Run the same child fixture with Node 24.19.0 and Bun 1.3.14. Check JSON framing, exit status, SIGTERM handling, IPC, GC flags and CommonJS evaluation. Record actual versions, process exit codes and skips; a missing Bun binary or a Windows signal skip is not a passed Bun/signal test.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no TUI change. The diff replaces direct executable selection at the three core child-launching areas and adds layout and cross-runtime regressions; the Bun PTY gate remains disabled here. Earlier macOS arm64 validation of predecessor `6e9c2c5a` covered the fixed Node/Bun pair and invalid-layout controls. Those results predate the main-branch merges in this head and are historical evidence, not a fresh full-head/preflight pass. The current GitHub review still requests changes; this description update does not resolve those findings.

Reproduce the focused checks after the repository's normal dependency setup, then run the required preflight separately:

```sh
cd packages/core
BUN_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/bun-1.3.14 NODE_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node-24.19.0 corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/utils/runtime-info.test.ts src/utils/runtime-boundary.node-bun.test.ts
cd ../..
npm run preflight
```

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Historical arm64 focused validation; current merged head not rerun in this metadata update |
| 🪟 Windows | No local validation claimed for this head; signal coverage has a platform skip |
| 🐧 Linux | No local full-head validation claimed in this update |

### Environment (optional)

Historical independent comparison: Node 24.19.0 and Bun 1.3.14 on macOS arm64. Earlier author testing also used Bun 1.4.0; it does not substitute for the pinned 1.3.14 leg. No tests were executed for this description-only edit.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: selecting the wrong installation or cached interpreter would affect JavaScript children. The resolver is anchored to the caller's bundle root and entry marker; invalid declarations fall back rather than selecting another binary.
- Not validated / out of scope: a compiled application artifact, remaining CLI-side launch sites, real Bun PTY behavior, standalone release acceptance and a fresh full-head preflight. This PR does not implement the later compatibility/packaging fixes or a new supervisor architecture.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public command/API removal, dependency change or default-runtime switch. Existing source/npm users need no migration. A packaging integration that separates the launcher must provide a valid interpreter declaration/layout; malformed declarations use the fallback rather than making a compiled launcher a supported interpreter.

Design pair: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fed48b85c8d67172968c51b62cf0c1493dc60665/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fed48b85c8d67172968c51b62cf0c1493dc60665/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md). Both are included in the diff; remaining compatibility and acceptance work must stay visible in both languages.

## Linked Issues

Related: #11607. Prerequisite for #14046; this boundary refactor does not complete the runtime migration or auto-close its tracking issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

分离启动 Qwen Code 的可执行文件与运行 JavaScript 子进程的解释器。hook 监督、sandbox 文件写入和 code-mode 执行现在从调用方的 standalone 安装中解析解释器；源码和 npm 安装继续使用当前解释器。这为启动器本身不能执行任意 JavaScript 的布局准备边界，不切换 CLI 默认运行时。

## 为什么需要

打包应用的可执行文件若被用于启动 JavaScript worker，可能重新启动应用而非执行脚本。此前这些调用方直接使用应用可执行路径。新解析器要求受支持的运行时清单与安装入口标记共存，验证声明的解释器确为可执行文件；声明缺失或无效时回退当前解释器。这样，当打包分离启动器和解释器时，用户的 hook、sandbox 写入与 code-mode 子进程仍应正常工作。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用精确 head `fed48b85c8d67172968c51b62cf0c1493dc60665`，覆盖源码/npm及有效 Node/Bun standalone 布局。源码/npm 子进程应使用当前解释器；standalone 应使用安装内声明的解释器，不读取无关祖先清单。
2. 覆盖缺失二进制、不可执行文件、目录、非法清单与未知运行时，均应按约定回退。确认 hook、sandbox、code-mode 调用方执行 JavaScript，而不是重新启动应用。
3. 在 Node24.19.0 与 Bun1.3.14 下运行同一夹具，检查 JSON 帧、退出状态、SIGTERM、IPC、GC 参数及 CommonJS 求值。记录真实版本、进程退出码与 skip；缺少 Bun 或 Windows 信号跳过不算通过。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A — 无 TUI 变化。diff 替换 core 内三个子进程启动领域的直接路径选择，增加布局与跨运行时回归；此 PR 仍禁用 Bun PTY。此前 macOS arm64 对前序 `6e9c2c5a` 的验证覆盖固定 Node/Bun 及非法布局对照，但早于当前 head 的 main 合入，只算历史证据，不是当前完整 head/preflight 新通过。GitHub 当前仍为请求修改，本次描述更新不关闭审查发现。

按仓库正常安装流程准备依赖后，可复现定向检查，再单独运行必需的 preflight：

```sh
cd packages/core
BUN_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/bun-1.3.14 NODE_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node-24.19.0 corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/utils/runtime-info.test.ts src/utils/runtime-boundary.node-bun.test.ts
cd ../..
npm run preflight
```

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | 历史 arm64 定向验证；本次元信息更新未重跑当前合入 head |
| 🪟 Windows | 不声称当前 head 本机验证；信号用例存在平台 skip |
| 🐧 Linux | 本次不声称本机当前完整 head 验证 |

### 环境（可选）

历史独立对照为 macOS arm64、Node24.19.0/Bun1.3.14；早期作者也测试 Bun1.4.0，但不替代固定1.3.14。本次只改描述，未执行测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：错误安装根或缓存解释器会影响 JavaScript 子进程。解析锚定调用方 bundle 根及入口标记；非法声明回退，不另猜二进制。
- 未验证/范围外：编译应用产物、其余 CLI 启动点、真实 Bun PTY、standalone 发布验收及当前完整 head 的新 preflight。本 PR 未实现后续兼容/打包修复或新 supervisor 架构。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：不删除公开命令/API，不改变依赖或默认运行时。源码/npm用户无需迁移；分离启动器的打包集成须提供有效解释器声明/布局。非法声明会回退，不代表编译启动器已成为受支持解释器。

auto_merge.commit_title: refactor(core): separate CLI launcher from JS interpreter (MYWO-8) (#14036)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(core): separate app launcher and JS interpreter runtime boundary

Establishes the runtime boundary the Bun migration (MYWO-8 S1) needs
before workers, hooks, sandbox helpers and the code-mode host spawn
JavaScript children under a future compiled-app flavor: arbitrary-JS
child processes resolve their interpreter through one accessor (package
manifest first, process.execPath fallback) instead of reading
process.execPath directly, Bun detection has a single seam, and the
app-launcher contract is documented alongside the full call-site
inventory in a bilingual design doc. Adds the same-fixture Node/Bun
regression matrix (stdio framing, exit codes, SIGTERM, IPC channel,
--expose-gc, --input-type=commonjs --eval).

* fix(core): anchor interpreter resolution to the trusted install root

Arbitrary-JS child resolution no longer walks upward looking for a
manifest: the only trusted location is the standalone package root —
the parent of the caller's bundle directory, which must hold both a
manifest.json and the standalone entry marker lib/cli-entry.js — so an
unrelated ancestor manifest in npm, source or SDK layouts can never be
read. Declarations are validated before use: runtime must be exactly
'bun' or 'node', and the interpreter must be an existing executable
regular file; any invalid or missing declaration falls back to
process.execPath without throwing (non-string interpreter, directory,
non-executable file, unknown runtime, absent binary, missing marker).

Adds the regression matrix for unrelated ancestor manifests (npm
bundle and deep SDK layouts), object/number/directory interpreters,
unknown runtime, missing and non-executable interpreters, and the
trust anchor; syncs both design-doc language versions with the
validated contract.

* docs(design): complete the migration inventory handoff

Adds the three interpreter-identity call sites the re-review found
missing from the call-site inventory (hook-command-cgroup launcher,
bwrap-execution and landlock-execution allowlist staging), marks the
unwired rows as owned by the S3 migration sweep, and notes platform
applicability: the cgroup/bwrap/landlock rows are Linux-only
mechanisms validated against the Linux targets of the platform
matrix, while the mem0 and pem rows apply on every platform. Both
design-doc language versions are updated; no product or test code
changes.

* style: apply prettier to the bun boundary docs and runtime tests

Fixes the failing Lint & Static lane: `prettier --experimental-cli
--check .` (prettier@3.6.1, the lockfile resolution) rejects the two
bun-runtime-boundary design docs and the two runtime-info test files
introduced by the runtime boundary change. Formatting only — markdown
table alignment, emphasis markers and code line wrapping; no content
or behavior changes.

* test(core): harden runtime boundary fixtures and document validation scope

* test(core): reject stderr errors while awaiting fixture identity

* test(core): expose Bun version and complete runtime call-site inventory

---------

prs.title: feat(cli): report interactive program status with OSC 7501
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds OSC 7501 status reports to the interactive Ink CLI with the stable identifier `qwen-code`: idle, working, blocked (permission/question/auth), done, and error. Completed and failed turns remain latched until the next turn; cancellation returns to idle. Reports are TTY-only, use existing OSC/multiplexer framing, clear unfinished states on unmount/exit, preserve completed results, and clear before inherited-terminal editor handoff. Terminal diff editing is bracketed before the confirmation callback runs; Configured GUI editors retain CLI terminal ownership. Untyped commands use core editor commands plus recognized terminal-only names; unknown or mode-dependent executables receive no handoff reports. Returning from an editor or resuming the process restores the current report only while the CLI owns the terminal. Per-turn failures are independent of retained error banners and telemetry settings, including delayed finalization failures. Concurrent side-query failures and their detached tool continuations do not fail the foreground turn; visible dialogs keep their blocked kind while a cancelled turn winds down.

## Why it's needed

Terminals can show which agent tabs are working, awaiting input, or finished without parsing screen text. This follows the maintainer's requested hook-based scope, TTY gate, no new setting, and deliberate omission of focus-based completion resets. The small additional lifecycle wiring handles the handoff concern raised in triage and distinguishes cancellation from successful completion.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In a supporting terminal, start an interactive session and submit a prompt. Expect idle → working → done, with done retained until the next turn. Trigger a permission, question, or authentication dialog and expect the corresponding blocked kind. A failed API turn should latch error; cancelling or declining every tool approval should return to idle. Exit while unfinished and confirm the record clears; exit after done/error and confirm the result remains. Opening an inherited-terminal editor should clear the record and returning should restore it. Headless text, JSON, stream-JSON and ACP output must contain no OSC 7501 bytes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the baseline source has no OSC 7501 reports. A global CLI baseline could not be run because `qwen` and tmux are unavailable.

After: isolated raw-PTY tests with a deterministic local model server observed idle → working → done (retained on exit), idle → working → error (retained on exit), idle → working → idle → clear on cancellation, and blocked/auth → clear. Headless text, JSON and stream-JSON completed successfully without OSC 7501; JSON/NDJSON parsed. ACP initialization returned valid JSON-RPC without OSC 7501. See the separate E2E report comment for exact evidence.

Focused tests: 1,747 passing and one existing skipped test across AppContainer wiring, program status, stream lifecycle, editor handoffs, headless output, and ACP. Thirteen new targeted mutation checks detect the prior GUI denylist, cancellation-dialog omission, missing foreground failure ownership, generic thrown-error latch removal, stale-owner protection before/after refactoring, permission-subset drift, preferred-editor identity removal, and classification moved after Windows quoting. Full build, typecheck, bundle, changed-file ESLint, Prettier, and diff checks passed; validation results are recorded in the E2E comment.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS ARM64, Node 26.10.0, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, local bundle and isolated PTY/mock-model harness. The final build uses an 8 GB Node heap because the default 4 GB limit was exhausted.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: turn results are inferred from existing UI state and error history; terminals choose how to display the protocol.
- Not validated / out of scope: presentation in a supporting terminal, live-provider auth, OpenTUI, focus resets, and pre-suspend clearing. SIGCONT restores status, but no SIGTSTP handler is added because it would change Node's default suspension semantics.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no settings or dependencies added.

Design: [English](https://github.com/maxffarrell/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/program-status.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/maxffarrell/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/program-status.zh-CN.md). Both versions cover the same decisions, constraints, validation and follow-ups.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13870

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

为交互式 Ink CLI 增加 OSC 7501 状态报告，使用稳定标识 `qwen-code`：idle、working、blocked（permission/question/auth）、done 和 error。完成或失败的轮次保持锁存，直到下一轮开始；取消时返回 idle。仅在 TTY 输出报告，复用现有 OSC/多路复用帧格式，卸载或退出时清除未完成状态并保留完成结果；继承终端的编辑器交接前清除。终端差异编辑在确认回调执行前后进行交接；已配置的 GUI 编辑器保留 CLI 的终端所有权；未带类型的命令通过 core 编辑器命令表及可识别的纯终端命令判断，未知或模式不确定的可执行文件不报告交接。编辑器返回或进程恢复时，仅在 CLI 拥有终端的情况下重新发送当前报告。轮次失败独立于保留的错误提示及遥测设置，包括延迟的收尾失败。并发侧查询及其独立工具续接失败不会将前台轮次标记为失败；取消期间可见对话框仍报告其 blocked 类型。

## 为什么需要

终端无需解析屏幕文本即可显示哪些代理标签页正在工作、等待输入或已经完成。本改动遵循维护者要求的 hook 范围、TTY 门控、不新增设置，以及明确不实现焦点完成重置。少量额外生命周期连接处理分诊提出的终端交接问题，并区分取消与成功完成。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

在支持的终端中启动交互式会话并提交提示词。应观察到 idle → working → done，done 保持到下一轮。触发权限、提问或认证对话框，应观察到相应 blocked 类型。API 失败应锁存 error；取消或拒绝全部工具审批应返回 idle。未完成时退出应清除记录；done/error 后退出应保留结果。打开继承终端的编辑器时清除记录，编辑器返回后恢复。headless text、JSON、stream-JSON 和 ACP 输出不得包含 OSC 7501 字节。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：基线源码没有 OSC 7501 报告。由于环境没有全局 `qwen` 和 tmux，无法执行全局 CLI 基线。

之后：使用确定性本地模型服务器的隔离原始 PTY 测试观察到 idle → working → done（退出后保留）、idle → working → error（退出后保留）、取消时 idle → working → idle → clear，以及 blocked/auth → clear。headless text、JSON 和 stream-JSON 成功完成且不包含 OSC 7501，JSON/NDJSON 可解析。ACP 初始化返回有效 JSON-RPC 且不包含 OSC 7501。精确证据见单独的 E2E 报告评论。

聚焦测试：AppContainer 连接、程序状态、流生命周期、编辑器交接、headless 输出及 ACP 等九组共 1,747 项通过，另有一项现有测试跳过。本轮新增 13 项定向变异检查检测到旧 GUI 排除表、取消对话框遗漏、前台失败所有权丢失、普通抛错标志删除、重构前后旧所有者保护、权限集合漂移、首选编辑器类型丢失及 Windows 引号顺序回归。完整构建、类型检查、bundle、改动文件 ESLint、Prettier 和 diff 检查均通过；验证结果记录在 E2E 评论中。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS ARM64、Node 26.10.0、固定 pnpm 11.24.0、本地 bundle 及隔离 PTY/模拟模型测试。默认 4 GB 堆限制耗尽，因此最终构建使用 8 GB Node 堆。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：轮次结果由现有 UI 状态和错误历史推断；终端决定如何显示协议。
- 未验证或范围之外：支持终端的显示效果、真实服务商认证、OpenTUI、焦点重置及挂起前清理。SIGCONT 恢复状态，但不添加 SIGTSTP 处理器，以免改变 Node 的默认挂起语义。
- 破坏性改动或迁移：无；不新增设置或依赖。

设计：[English](https://github.com/maxffarrell/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/program-status.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/maxffarrell/qwen-code/blob/feat/osc-7501-program-status/docs/design/program-status.zh-CN.md)。两个版本包含一致的决策、约束、验证及后续工作。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #13870

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add side task archive controls
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds per-task Archive, Archive completed, and restore controls to the Web Shell side-task menu. Archive requests carry an additive idle requirement; the owning runtime checks that state atomically before closing, so active or uncertain work stays in the active catalog.

Successful archive results remove the task from the active menu, open panel tabs, saved session buckets, deferred restore state, and browser persistence. Archived tasks stay recoverable from an Archived submenu scoped to the same parent session.

## Why it's needed

Completed side tasks remain in the active session catalog after their live child is reaped, so long-running coordinator sessions accumulate stale entries. The daemon already has reversible archive storage, but Web Shell had no safe way to use it for side tasks.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a Web Shell parent session and create one completed side task and one side task with work still running.
2. Open the side-task menu. Confirm the completed task offers Open and Archive, while Archive is disabled for the running task.
3. Archive the completed task individually, then use Archive completed with multiple eligible tasks. Confirm only eligible tasks leave the active list and any open tabs for them close.
4. Open the Archived submenu and restore a task. Confirm it returns to the active side-task list and can be opened again.
5. Confirm a daemon without the idle-guard capability does not expose archive actions; restore remains available when the existing archive capability is present.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Archive controls for a completed side task:

![Completed side-task archive controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/qwen-code-14289-archive-controls-before.jpg)

Archived tasks remain recoverable from the same menu:

![Archived side-task restore menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/qwen-code-14289-archived-restore-menu.jpg)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local qwen serve --web on loopback, using the repository development runtime. Focused archive/restore tests, CLI and Web Shell typechecks, Web Shell production build, ESLint, and diff checks passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: archive decisions depend on live runtime state; the additive capability and atomic idle check fail closed when work is active, unknown, unsupported, or already closing.
- Not validated / out of scope: automatic TTL retention remains a follow-up for the broader managed child-session lifecycle; Windows and Linux UI flows were not exercised locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Older daemons keep the existing archive contract, and clients gate the new archive controls on the new capability.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-14289-archive-side-task/docs/design/2026-10-15-side-task-archive-controls.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-14289-archive-side-task/docs/design/2026-10-15-side-task-archive-controls.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Refs #14289

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 在 Web Shell 的侧边任务菜单中增加单项“归档”、“归档已完成任务”和恢复入口。归档请求会携带新增的空闲要求；所属运行时会在关闭前原子检查状态，因此运行中或状态不确定的工作会继续保留在活跃目录中。

归档成功后，任务会从活跃菜单、已打开的面板标签、按 Session 保存的状态、延迟恢复状态和浏览器持久化状态中移除。已归档任务仍可从同一父 Session 范围内的“已归档”子菜单恢复。

## 为什么需要

侧边任务的实时子进程被回收后，已完成任务仍留在活跃 Session 目录中，导致长期运行的协调 Session 不断积累旧条目。Daemon 已经具备可逆的归档存储，但 Web Shell 之前没有安全使用它的侧边任务入口。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 打开一个 Web Shell 父 Session，创建一个已完成侧边任务和一个仍在运行的侧边任务。
2. 打开侧边任务菜单。确认已完成任务提供“打开”和“归档”，运行中的任务则禁用“归档”。
3. 先单独归档一个已完成任务，再对多个符合条件的任务使用“归档已完成任务”。确认只有符合条件的任务离开活跃列表，并关闭其已打开标签。
4. 打开“已归档”子菜单并恢复一个任务。确认它重新回到活跃侧边任务列表并可再次打开。
5. 确认没有空闲保护能力的 daemon 不显示归档操作；只要存在原有归档能力，恢复入口仍然可用。

### 证据（前后对比）

已完成侧边任务的归档操作：

![已完成侧边任务归档入口](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/qwen-code-14289-archive-controls-before.jpg)

已归档任务可从同一菜单恢复：

![已归档侧边任务恢复菜单](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/qwen-code-14289-archived-restore-menu.jpg)

### 验证平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

在本地 loopback 上通过仓库开发运行时启动 qwen serve --web。侧边任务归档/恢复定向测试、CLI 与 Web Shell typecheck、Web Shell 生产构建、ESLint 和 diff 检查均通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：归档判断依赖实时运行状态；新增能力标签与原子空闲校验会在工作运行中、状态未知、不支持判断或已进入关闭流程时失败并保留原状态。
- 未验证 / 范围外：自动 TTL 保留仍是 managed child-session 生命周期的后续工作；未在本地执行 Windows 和 Linux UI 流程。
- Breaking change / 迁移说明：无。旧 daemon 继续沿用现有归档契约，客户端只在新能力存在时显示新增归档操作。
- 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-14289-archive-side-task/docs/design/2026-10-15-side-task-archive-controls.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-14289-archive-side-task/docs/design/2026-10-15-side-task-archive-controls.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14289

</details>

prs.title: feat(extensions): add bounded generated HTML and JavaScript views
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an optional Generated UI extension for complete HTML/CSS views with local JavaScript calculations. A model can produce a parameter simulator or weighted comparison in one tool call; users can then change inputs without another model turn. It reuses the existing MCP Apps display, history and readable-text fallback.

Each call creates an immutable card. Generated JavaScript runs in a bounded QuickJS Worker through a small UI API, and sanitized markup is displayed in a frame with scripts disabled. The extension bundles its runtime and includes two complete examples plus a writer skill.

## Why it's needed

The existing Test Failure Explorer provides a fixed interface for one task. Exploratory questions also need layouts and calculations generated for the current data. This PR adds that second task category while keeping the first increment independently installable and scoped to local computation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Install the packed extension in a trusted test workspace and ask for a complete parameter simulation or weighted option comparison. The card should show its assumptions, initial result and interactive controls; a terminal or host without MCP Apps should retain a useful standalone answer.
2. Use the supplied comparison with Plan A scores 9/4, Plan B scores 6/9 and initial weights 60%/40%. Confirm scores 7.00/7.20, then change the responsiveness weight to 100% and confirm 9.00/6.00 without another model/tool call. In the capacity example, changing four workers to eight should change estimated capacity from 100 to 200 requests/s.
3. Open independent cards and switch between two workspaces. Changing one view should not alter another. Refresh should restore the saved initial parameters, including when the originating MCP process has exited.
4. Stop a card and confirm that it remains stopped for that activation. Invalid or oversized source and runtime failures should show a bounded error/readable fallback. Generated code should not gain browser DOM, network, file, MCP-tool or message capabilities.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Both pairs use the same freshly built daemon/Web Shell, synthetic scores, English UI and dark theme. Before has no Generated UI extension and uses the existing Markdown table renderer, which already supports sorting; after installs the packed extension and adds task-specific local calculations. A deterministic loopback model supplies the responses so the comparison isolates the real tool-to-Web-Shell path; these captures are not an evaluation of model generation quality.

| Viewport | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Desktop, 1440 × 900 | ![Before: readable comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/before-desktop.png) | ![After: interactive comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/after-desktop.png) |
| Narrow, 390 × 844 | ![Before: readable comparison on narrow screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/before-narrow.png) | ![After: interactive comparison on narrow screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/after-narrow.png) |

[Acceptance report, artifact identities and limitations](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/acceptance.md). Current head `d50c7df1255d07ba9d5dee0287561ce3016733fd` incorporates main `17d5f774ea5e5c49c6461078efc53a2d91e59d1a`. Full workspace build/bundle/typecheck/lint and all 72 extension tests passed. The new-host real daemon checks passed for fresh packed installation, both examples, refresh, queued-input/legal-ID regressions and text fallback, with all owned processes and ports cleaned up. The 29 PR files remain identical to the reviewed implementation, and a bounded independent compatibility review found no actionable issue. Freshness tests passed 9/9 and the live check found no stale gate files. Supplemental workflow tests had 868 passed, 17 skipped and one unchanged upstream 600ms timeout-test failure; one focused rerun reproduced it, and the diagnostic found the budget expired before its stub wrote a handoff. This failure is preserved in the report; it does not exercise Generated UI. Earlier broader daemon/workspace checks retain their original bases. Hosted CI is separate from this local acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local unit, build and real daemon/browser acceptance |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js 25.9.0, pnpm 11.24.0, locally bundled CLI/Web Shell and packed extension 0.25.2. Daemon checks use isolated configuration and trusted synthetic workspaces. The App is 789,985 bytes, below the existing 1 MiB host limit. Hosted CI is reported separately from local acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: generated calculations and explanatory text still require semantic review. The restricted synchronous UI API deliberately supports local calculations rather than the full browser JavaScript environment; VM and document limits do not claim to bound every possible CSS/rendering workload.
- Not validated / out of scope: persistent interaction state, streaming/partial views, editing previous cards across turns, external libraries/network access, broad model-quality evaluation, and local Windows/Linux verification. Refresh starts from the saved initial snapshot. No new core protocol or daemon route is introduced.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. This private extension is opt-in and does not change existing cards or default installations.

## Linked Issues

Continues the Intelligent UI sequence after #14269 (PR4); this is PR7a, the complete generated-interface increment. No issue is automatically closed.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

新增可选的 Generated UI 扩展，用完整 HTML/CSS 界面承载本地 JavaScript 计算。模型一次工具调用即可生成参数模拟器或加权方案比较，用户随后修改输入无需再调用模型。复用现有 MCP Apps 的显示、历史保存和可独立阅读的文本降级能力。

每次调用创建独立的不可变卡片。生成的 JavaScript 通过小型 UI API 在有资源限制的 QuickJS Worker 中执行，清理后的 HTML 在禁用脚本的 frame 中显示。扩展自带运行时、两个完整示例和生成技能。

## 为什么需要

现有测试失败探索器为单一任务提供固定界面。探索性问题还需要根据当次数据生成布局与计算逻辑。本 PR 补齐第二类任务，首个增量可独立安装，范围限定为本地计算。

## Reviewer 验收计划

### 验证方法

1. 在受信任的测试工作区安装打包扩展，请求完整参数模拟器或加权方案比较。卡片应显示假设、初始结果和交互控件；终端或不支持 MCP Apps 的宿主仍应保留有用的独立答案。
2. 使用示例中的方案 A 评分 9/4、方案 B 评分 6/9，以及初始 60%/40% 权重，确认结果为 7.00/7.20。将响应性权重改为 100%，应得到 9.00/6.00，且不新增模型或工具调用。容量示例将 worker 从 4 改为 8 后，估算容量应由 100 变为 200 请求/秒。
3. 打开独立卡片并在两个工作区间切换，修改一个界面不应影响另一个。刷新应恢复已保存的初始参数，生成该卡片的 MCP 进程退出后也应能够回放。
4. 停止卡片后，本次激活应保持停止。无效或过大的源码、运行时失败应显示有限错误或可读降级结果。生成代码不能获得浏览器 DOM、网络、文件、MCP 工具或消息能力。

### 前后证据

两组截图使用同一份新构建的 daemon/Web Shell、相同合成评分、英文界面和暗色主题。Before 未安装 Generated UI 扩展，使用现有已支持排序的 Markdown 表格渲染；After 安装打包扩展，新增任务专属的本地计算交互。确定性 loopback 模型提供响应，用于验证真实工具到 Web Shell 的链路；截图不代表模型生成质量评测。

| 视口 | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 桌面，1440 × 900 | ![Before：可读比较结果](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/before-desktop.png) | ![After：可交互比较](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/after-desktop.png) |
| 窄屏，390 × 844 | ![Before：窄屏可读结果](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/before-narrow.png) | ![After：窄屏交互界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/after-narrow.png) |

[验收报告、产物身份与限制](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/9c7bf95b637319b53ce2f9e38a13c3253cf1c468/acceptance.md)。当前 head `d50c7df1255d07ba9d5dee0287561ce3016733fd` 已合入 main `17d5f774ea5e5c49c6461078efc53a2d91e59d1a`。整仓 build/bundle/typecheck/lint 和全部72项扩展测试通过。新宿主上的全新打包安装、两示例、刷新、排队输入/合法 ID 回归与文本降级均通过，自有测试进程和端口已清理。29个 PR 文件与已审查实现一致，有界独立兼容性复审无可行动问题。Freshness 测试9/9通过，实时检查无过期门禁文件。附加 workflow 测试868通过、17跳过，1个未改动的上游600毫秒超时用例失败；单跑复现，诊断确认预算耗尽时 stub 尚未写出 handoff。报告保留该失败，该用例不执行 Generated UI。此前更完整的 daemon/workspace 验收保留原基线。本地验收与远端 CI 分别报告。

### 已测试环境

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地单元测试、构建及真实 daemon/浏览器验收 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未本地验证 |

### 运行环境

macOS、Node.js 25.9.0、pnpm 11.24.0、本地打包 CLI/Web Shell 及 0.25.2 扩展。daemon 使用隔离配置和受信任的合成测试工作区。App 大小为 789,985 字节，低于现有 1 MiB 宿主上限。远端 CI 与本地验收分别报告。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：生成的计算和解释文字仍需语义核验。受限的同步 UI API 用于本地计算，不等同完整浏览器 JavaScript；VM 和文档限制也不宣称覆盖所有 CSS/渲染负载。
- 未验证或不在范围内：持久化交互状态、流式/部分界面、跨轮次修改旧卡片、外部库/网络访问、广泛模型质量评测，以及本地 Windows/Linux 验证。刷新从已保存的初始快照开始。本次没有新增 core 协议或 daemon 路由。
- 兼容性和迁移：无破坏性变更。此私有扩展需主动启用，不改变现有卡片或默认安装。

## 关联

承接 #14269（PR4）之后的 Intelligent UI 阶梯，本次为完整生成界面增量 PR7a。不自动关闭 issue。
