prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add Shell Full Access and session approval switching
prs.body:
## What this PR does Built-in Workspace-bound qwen-code Sessions can explicitly select Shell Full Access and change default/auto-edit/yolo while idle without losing history, Workspace, or draft. Only the recorded Session owner with current OPERATOR access can change policy. Each admitted Turn freezes its policy; durable receipts, revision checks, and browser confirmation make concurrent changes and lost responses recoverable. Stored AgentDefinitions remain fixed. The initial Session policy stays immutable. Positive revisions travel through negotiated approval-selection/1 and committed admission snapshots; revision-zero and legacy requests consistently retain their original absent wire field across capability upgrades. Ordinary yolo tools skip approval while explicit Hook ask/deny decisions retain their existing meaning. Deployment defaults, the Shell switch, Runtime permissions, cancellation, and unknown-effect refusal remain in force. OpenAPI, generated consumers, and the [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-shell-full-access/docs/design/managed-approval-selection.md) / [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-shell-full-access/docs/design/managed-approval-selection.zh-CN.md) are synchronized. ## Why it's needed The creation selector could not enable Shell Full Access, and an existing Managed Session had to be replaced to choose another approval policy. Updating the menu alone would still be rejected by execution admission. This change connects the owner-authorized choice through SQL, SDK, Harness execution and WebShell, preserving both the original definition identity and each Turn's accepted policy. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify Use a built-in Workspace Session on a configured stack with approval-selection/1. Complete default → yolo → auto-edit in one Session using a file write and a foreground Shell command in each phase. Expect ordinary approval counts 2 / 0 / 1, exact effects once, persisted output/history, and the selected policy after refresh and a Harness restart. Confirm custom AgentDefinitions remain fixed and deployment defaults are unchanged. Try a non-owner operator, owner demotion, an active/cancelling Turn, pending approval, and unsettled recovery; changes must be refused. Race send/change and two expected-revision changes, retry the same key, reuse it with different content, and replay original creation after switching. Drop a committed change response, refresh, and confirm the original request: sending/model/cwd/policy changes stay locked until readback, the draft survives, and no extra revision or command is produced. Verify revision-zero retries omit the private field before and after a capability upgrade, positive revisions remain strict, missing snapshots after a switch refuse execution, and old Harness execution is refused while cancellation stays possible. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: the source and supplied UI behavior restricted built-in Shell creation to default/auto-edit and displayed existing policy as fixed. The isolated installed qwen 0.25.1 Harness did not advertise approval-selection/1. The original Java/UI baseline was not run before the implementation build. After: independent Chrome and real Java/Broker/Harness/worker/MySQL checks produced the following effects in one Session. A gateway deliberately dropped a successful policy response; refresh preserved the pending request and draft, and original-key confirmation unlocked the page without another revision. All three menu items fit a 390px viewport. Harness-only cold loads succeeded with both a selected revision and a revision-zero control. At merge head `a290d433fa`, an official consolidated executable-jar plus CLI smoke passed 18/18 assertions in a fresh Session: the same 2/0/1 approval matrix, exact effects once, SQL snapshots default/0 → yolo/1 → auto-edit/2, an absent private policy field at revision zero, and explicit frozen snapshots at positive revisions. | Policy | File approval | Shell approval | Physical effects | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | default | 1 | 1 | Exact file and Shell append once | | yolo | 0 | 0 | Exact file and Shell append once | | auto-edit | 0 | 1 | Exact file and Shell append once | At merge head `a290d433fa`, local verification passed: root build/typecheck/bundle, API generation and changed-file ESLint/Prettier; 446 affected WebShell tests; 316 CLI policy/durable-tool/model/prompt-surface tests plus two resident-and-cold replay cases; full SDK Maven verification (252 tests, 9 skipped) and consolidated Managed Agent Server/Broker Maven verification (3967 tests, 9 skipped, including Checkstyle and SpotBugs); 237 workflow checks and 8 reference-packaging checks; 18 actual MySQL 8.4 policy transaction cases and a separate fresh-catalog schema-upgrade gate. An independent test engineer passed 18/18 assertions against this exact merge head using its official consolidated executable jar and CLI. The earlier Chrome/permission/recovery matrix and independent V6 probes remain historical evidence from their recorded heads; the broader browser and recovery matrix was not rerun on this merge head. Two clean self-audit passes completed for the merge, and its commit hooks left the reviewed tree unchanged. CI is tracked separately from these local results. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested within the stated storage fixture | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) macOS arm64, Node 22.22.3, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, MySQL 8.4.11, Chrome, and a deterministic local OpenAI-compatible model. SQL, HTTP services, mounts, tools, rendering and browser interaction were real. The macOS process run used the repository's explicit physical-alias SQL fixture with native/durable Runtime recovery disabled. The final executable jar's Connector and Broker projection classes, embedded SDK Builder class, and V6 resource were byte-compared with current outputs. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: this is a cross-package execution-policy and persistence change requiring maintainer review. Immutable initial identity, admitted Turn snapshots, ownership and protocol gates are the key invariants. The PR remains draft until deployment acceptance is complete. - Not validated / out of scope: Linux native registration, durable full-JVM recovery, unknown-effect process fault acceptance, live two-tab transport races, and real upstream-model calls were not established. Full Java restart in the non-durable macOS fixture read the right policy but timed out warming an old Runtime binding, including a revision-zero control; the unmodified Hosted MySQL profile also failed its first tool Turn with Broker 409 on this host. These are not passing gates or classified regressions. Lease/Runtime recovery repair is outside this change. - Breaking changes / migration notes: shared additive schema V6 follows prerequisite V4/V5. Deploy the capable Harness first, then migrate and update all Java/Broker readers and writers in a maintenance window, and publish WebShell last. Preserve existing initial policies and data. Rollback binaries must understand overrides and Turn snapshots; old readers must not silently execute a switched Session. ## Linked Issues Depends on #14316; this stacked PR targets its branch. No issue is auto-closed.

保留既有含义。部署默认值、Shell 开关、Runtime 权限、取消和不确定副作用拒绝继续生效。OpenAPI、生成的消费端以及[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-shell-full-access/docs/design/managed-approval-selection.md) / auto-edit，每阶段执行一次文件写入和一条前台 Shell 命令。普通审批次数应为 2 / 0 / 1，真实副作用各一次，输出和历史持久保留，刷新及重启 Harness 后策略正确。确认自定义 AgentDefinition 仍固定，部署默认值未变。 尝试非 owner 的 operator、owner 降权、活动或取消中的回合、待审批和未收尾恢复，切换必须被拒绝。让发送与切换竞争、两次预期修订相同的变更竞争，重试同键、同键换内容，以及切换后重放原创建请求。丢弃已提交变更的响应，刷新并确认原请求：读回前发送、模型、cwd 和策略切换保持锁定，草稿保留，不新增修订或命令。核对修订零在能力升级前后重试都省略私有字段，正修订仍严格比较，发生切换后缺少快照会拒绝执行，旧 Harness 不得执行，而取消仍然可用。 ### 证据（前后对比） 之前：源码及提供的页面行为将内置 Shell 创建限制为 default/auto-edit，已有会话策略显示为固定。隔离启动的已安装 qwen 0.25.1 Harness 不宣告 approval-selection/1。实现构建前未运行完整 Java/页面基线。 之后：独立 Chrome 及真实 Java/Broker/Harness/worker/MySQL 检查在同一会话产生下列副作用。网关故意丢弃成功变更的响应，刷新后保留原待确认请求和草稿，用原键确认后解锁且修订不再增加。390px 视口可以完整显示三种菜单选项。有覆盖修订及修订零对照都通过了仅 Harness 重启的冷加载。在合并 head `a290d433fa`，使用正式统一可执行 jar 和 CLI 的新会话烟测通过 yolo | 0 | 0 | 精确文件与 Shell 追加各一次 | | auto-edit | 0 | 1 | 精确文件与 Shell 追加各一次 | 在合并 head `a290d433fa`，本地验证通过：根目录 build/typecheck/bundle、API 生成及变更文件 ESLint/Prettier；446 项相关 WebShell 测试；316 项 CLI 策略/持久工具/模型/提示面测试和两项驻留及冷重放用例；SDK 完整 Maven 验证（252 项、跳过 9）以及合并后的 Managed Agent Server/Broker 完整 Maven 验证（3967 项、跳过 9，包含 Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs）；237 项 workflow 检查和 8 项参考发行打包检查；18 项真实 MySQL 8.4 策略事务及使用独立新库的 prs.title: fix(cli): hold pre-runtime /acp WebSocket upgrades instead of falling through to a 406 (#13995)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A fast-path `qwen serve` boot (any invocation without `--open`) listens with a deferred runtime: the HTTP server accepts connections before the runtime app — and therefore the ACP WebSocket transport — exists, and the `upgrade` listener is only registered once the deferred runtime finishes. An `/acp` WebSocket upgrade that arrives in that boot window finds no `upgrade` listener, so Node routes it to Express as a plain GET; the delegating app holds it until the runtime is ready and then forwards it to the SSE `GET /acp` handler, which answers a misleading `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`. The first WebSocket connection to a freshly booted daemon therefore always failed.

This PR installs a pre-listen `upgrade` guard on the primary server. While the ACP transport is not yet attached, the guard holds the upgrade — mirroring the hold the delegating app already gives REST requests during the same window — lets it trigger the deferred runtime start (the same start-on-request behavior a REST request gets), and replays queued upgrades once the transport attaches. Replayed upgrades go through the real listener, so authentication, origin checks, and path routing are unchanged. Once no transport can still arrive (runtime settled without one, startup failed, or the daemon is shutting down), the gate closes and late upgrades get a retryable `503` with `Retry-After: 1`, matching the not-ready postures elsewhere on this surface.

## Why it's needed

Main CI run 38267397252 (commit `14cc19b4bdc8`) failed the `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker` shard on `qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts > discovers a client-hosted tool end-to-end via the ACP child` and `qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts > controls a real mock-plugin worker after a channel-less boot` (#13995). The client-MCP failure reproduces deterministically outside CI: with vitest retries disabled it failed 8/8 with `Unexpected server response: 406`, because the test connects to `/acp` immediately after the daemon prints `listening on`. Vitest's `retry: 2` usually masked the window (a retry lands after the transport attaches), until a loaded docker-leg shard widened it past the retry spacing. Beyond the tests, any real client that opens a socket right after daemon boot — desktop app, web shell, SDK — hit the same bogus 406 instead of simply connecting.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts` — the full serve suite passes (501 tests), including the two new witnesses: an `/acp` upgrade arriving in the deferred boot window is held and completes with wire status `101` (and itself forces the deferred runtime up), and a failed runtime start answers a held upgrade with a retryable `503`.
2. `cd integration-tests && npx cross-env QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts cli/qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts --retry=0` — with retries disabled, both previously failing suites pass; before this change the discovery test failed every first attempt with `Unexpected server response: 406`.
3. Sanity-check the window by hand: `node dist/cli.js serve --port 0 --token t` and immediately open a WebSocket to `/acp` — the socket connects after the brief runtime start instead of erroring with 406.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (daemon transport change; no UI). Wire-level behavior for a boot-window `/acp` upgrade: before — `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`; after — `101 Switching Protocols` once the runtime attaches, or a retryable `503` if the runtime can no longer start.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux container; E2E run with `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` (Docker unavailable here, so the exact `sandbox:docker` CI leg was not reproducible locally and remains the CI-side gate).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guard holds early upgrades until the deferred runtime attaches, so a client that connects during the boot window sees a short connect delay (bounded by the runtime startup timeout) instead of an immediate error — this matches the existing REST behavior during the same window.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact `sandbox:docker` CI leg (no Docker in the authoring environment); the channel-workers test did not reproduce locally, but its flow is REST-first and the fix removes the boot-window WS failure class for every path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A boot-window `/acp` upgrade that previously failed with 406 now upgrades (101) once the runtime attaches, or receives `503` + `Retry-After` if the runtime cannot start.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13995

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

fast-path `qwen serve` 启动(任何不带 `--open` 的调用)会推迟运行时的构建:HTTP server 在 runtime app —— 也就是 ACP WebSocket 传输层 —— 存在之前就开始接受连接,`upgrade` 监听器直到被推迟的 runtime 完成时才注册。在这个启动窗口内到达的 `/acp` WebSocket upgrade 找不到 `upgrade` 监听器,于是 Node 把它当作普通 GET 交给 Express;delegating app 会把这个 GET 挂起直到 runtime 就绪,再转发给 SSE 的 `GET /acp` 处理器,后者返回误导性的 `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`。因此,新建的 daemon 上的第一个 WebSocket 连接总是失败。

本 PR 在主 server 上、listen 之前安装了一个 `upgrade` 守卫。在 ACP 传输层注册之前,守卫会挂起 upgrade —— 与 delegating app 在同一窗口期对 REST 请求的挂起行为一致 —— 并让它触发被推迟的 runtime 启动(与 REST 请求获得的按需启动行为一致),然后在传输层注册后重放队列中的 upgrade。重放的 upgrade 会经过真正的监听器,因此认证、Origin 检查和路径路由完全不变。一旦不可能再有传输层到来(runtime 已就绪但未注册、启动失败、或 daemon 正在关闭),门闩关闭,后来的 upgrade 会收到可重试的 `503` 并带 `Retry-After: 1`,与该接口其他未就绪场景的处理姿态一致。

## 为什么需要

Main CI 运行 38267397252(提交 `14cc19b4bdc8`)在 `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker` 分片上失败,涉及 `qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts > discovers a client-hosted tool end-to-end via the ACP child` 和 `qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts > controls a real mock-plugin worker after a channel-less boot`(#13995)。client-MCP 的失败在 CI 之外可以确定性复现:禁用 vitest 重试时 8 次运行 8 次失败,报错 `Unexpected server response: 406`,因为该测试在 daemon 打印 `listening on` 后立即连接 `/acp`。Vitest 的 `retry: 2` 通常掩盖了这个窗口(重试到来时传输层已注册),直到某个高负载的 docker 分片把窗口拉得比重试间隔还长。除测试外,任何在 daemon 启动后立即建立连接的真实客户端 —— 桌面应用、web shell、SDK —— 都会遇到同样的错误 406,而不是正常连接。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts` —— 整个 serve 套件通过(501 个测试),包括两个新见证测试:在 deferred 启动窗口期到达的 `/acp` upgrade 会被挂起并以 `101` 完成升级(且该 upgrade 本身会触发 deferred runtime 启动);runtime 启动失败时,被挂起的 upgrade 会收到可重试的 `503`。
2. `cd integration-tests && npx cross-env QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts cli/qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts --retry=0` —— 禁用重试时,两个此前失败的套件都能通过;修复前,discovery 测试的首次尝试每次都因 `Unexpected server response: 406` 失败。
3. 手工验证窗口行为:`node dist/cli.js serve --port 0 --token t`,然后立即建立到 `/acp` 的 WebSocket —— 连接会在短暂的 runtime 启动后成功,而不是报 406。

### 前后对比证据

N/A(daemon 传输层变更,无 UI)。启动窗口内 `/acp` upgrade 的线上行为:修复前 —— `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`;修复后 —— runtime 注册后 `101 Switching Protocols`,若 runtime 无法启动则可重试的 `503`。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

本地 Linux 容器;E2E 以 `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` 运行(本环境无 Docker,无法在本地复现与 CI 完全一致的 `sandbox:docker` 分支,该分支仍由 CI 把关)。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:守卫会把早期 upgrade 挂起到 deferred runtime 注册为止,因此在启动窗口内连接的客户端会看到短暂的连接延迟(上限为 runtime 启动超时),而不是立即报错 —— 这与同一窗口期内 REST 请求的既有行为一致。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内:与 CI 完全一致的 `sandbox:docker` 分支(编写环境无 Docker);channel-workers 测试未在本地复现,但其流程以 REST 为先,且本次修复为所有路径消除了启动窗口期的 WS 失败类别。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。此前在启动窗口内到达的 `/acp` upgrade 会以 406 失败,现在会在 runtime 注册后完成升级(101),或在 runtime 无法启动时收到 `503` + `Retry-After`。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13995

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): add the FG9a/FG9f session_message and session_command relay fault gates (#14164)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds slice 1 of the Stage F FG9 round (#14164): multi-process fault-injected integration gates proving the two cross-Session relay domains — `session_message` and `session_command` — keep their replay-stability guarantees on a real control plane, the embedded Runtime Broker, the packaged Hosted Harness, and a disposable MySQL schema. Two letters / six cases land in one new Java IT class with in-JVM Spring and scripted models, no production code moved. The FG9a letter drops a committed reply at three distinct store-boundary points — alice's outbound admission commit, the lead's inbound receipt commit, and one fan-out mint commit — and proves the bounded uncertain-error retry re-drives each by the original transaction identity: one command record at revision 1, one inbound receipt at revision 1, each sender's view byte-identical to the committed reply. The FG9f letter makes a fan-out's answer ambiguous the three ways the issue names: a held mint past the relay's request timeout forces a retry, not a duplicate; a finished roster position is honestly reported `not reached: it has finished; the leader may give it more work, a peer cannot.`; and a stopped-before-send position is honestly reported `not reached: it is being stopped.` — each time with exactly one `msgc_` row per position and one consumed command chain. A new in-JVM lose-once/hold forwarding proxy fronts only the Session Store; the Harness connection stays direct because the probe history here shows a proxied warm/createOrLoad chain breeds resident-vs-attach conflicts. CI wiring rides along in one diff: a dedicated failsafe profile for the letter class, the per-case evidence directory in the Hosted report upload paths, and fork-budget ceiling pins for the new class in the CI meta-tests.

## Why it's needed

The relay's replay-stable contracts are user-visible: a duplicated member message cannot be un-sent, and a receipt claiming "reached" for an untouched member is a lie the journal cannot later correct. Today those semantics are covered only by functional tests; Stage F needs the same fault-gate coverage here that the FG6/FG7/FG8 rounds delivered for channels, monitor runs, and background shells. The tracker (#14164) slices this round three ways; this PR is slice 1, with slice 2 (cancellation and SSE-gap letters on this same fixture) and slice 3 (store failures and restart letters, gated on #13918 and #13986) both documented for follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Check out the branch, install the two sibling Java artifacts per the module README, then run the new dedicated failsafe profile against a throw-away MySQL/MariaDB schema (`DROP SCHEMA; CREATE SCHEMA`) from a clean worktree. The expected final report for the letter class is two letters, zero failures and zero errors, with the fault-fired witnesses visible in each letter's proxy evidence log: three dropped-reply lines on the FG9a side plus one held-then-released line on the FG9f partial-timeout side. The full choreography, the seven extra gotchas learned while landing, and the exact commands live in the bilingual design document referenced below.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change; report and log paths above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  | CI lanes |

### Environment (optional)

Local acceptance ran on JDK 21 + Maven 3.9 + Node 22 + MariaDB 10.11 (throw-away datadir), no docker.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: letters share one fork per letter — a wedged letter pays up to its @Timeout ceiling before the sibling starts; the healthy runtime is deliberately longer than the CI fork budget's pinned allowance.
- Not validated / out of scope: slice 2 and slice 3 of the tracker (the cancellation/SSE letters FG9d-e and the store-failure/restart letters FG9b-c waiting on #13918 and #13986); the fourth draft case for the harness boundary was dropped at landing because it required the proxied wiring axis probes ruled out.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test-only diff plus CI wiring.

Design document (bilingual and synchronized): docs/design/2026-10-15-session-relay-fault-gates.md and docs/design/2026-10-15-session-relay-fault-gates.zh-CN.md.

## Linked Issues

Ref #14164 — this PR lands slice 1 of the three slices pieced for that tracker; do not close the issue when this merges.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 内容

落地 Stage F 的 FG9 切片 1(#14164)：为两个跨 Session 的 relay 域（`session_message` 与 `session_command`）补一套多进程故障注入集成门，在真实控制面、嵌入式 Runtime Broker、打包 Hosted Harness 与一次性 MySQL schema 上证明其重放稳定语义。两个字母共六案，落在一个新的 Java IT 类中,使用 in-JVM Spring 与脚本化模型，不改动任何生产代码。FG9a 一侧在三个 store 边界点上各丢一次已落库的应答 —— alice 的 admission 出站提交、lead 的入站回执提交、扇出 mint 提交 —— 并证明有限不确定错误重试都按原事务身份重驱：命令记录恰于 revision 1 一条、回执恰于 revision 1 一份、发方视图与已落库 reply 逐字节一致。FG9f 一侧按 issue 点名的三种方式让扇出的答案不确定：把一次 mint 扣过 relay 的请求超时会逼出重试而不是重发；已完结的 roster 位置被诚实应答为 `not reached: it has finished; the leader may give it more work, a peer cannot.`；在开火前就被停入 stopping 的位置被诚实应答为 `not reached: it is being stopped.` —— 每次仍保证每个位置恰好一行 `msgc_`、命令链恰好被消费一次。一个新的 in-JVM lose-once/hold 转发 proxy 只挡 Session Store 一侧；Harness 连接保持直连，因为此前的探针已证明走 proxy 的 warm/createOrLoad 链会引来 resident-vs-attach 冲突。CI 挂载是同一个 diff：为该字母类新开的 failsafe profile、上传路径中的按案证据目录，以及该新类在 CI 元测试里的 fork 预算钉源。

## 必要性

relay 的重放稳定契约对用户直接可见：成员消息一旦重发就无法收回，声明「已送达」而实际未达的 receipt 是 journal 日后洗不掉的谎言。当前这些语义只靠功能测试覆盖，Stage F 需要与 FG6/FG7/FG8 对渠道、monitor_run、background shell 提供的同类故障门覆盖。该轮在 #14164 平台上切为三片，本 PR 为 slice 1;slice 2（取消与 SSE 断流，在同一份夹具上）与 slice 3（存储故障与进程重启，依赖 #13918 与 #13986）作为后续工作已记录于设计文档。

## 评审验证方案

检出分支后，按模块 README 安装两个兄弟 Java 工件，再在干净工作树上对一次性 MySQL/MariaDB schema(`DROP SCHEMA; CREATE SCHEMA`)运行新开包的 failsafe profile。预期字母类最终报告为两个字母、零失败零错误，且各字母的 proxy 证据日志中可见故障点火痕迹：FG9a 侧三条 dropped 应答、FG9f partial-timeout 侧一条 held-then-released 行。全部编排过程、落地时学到的七条雷区，以及完整命令写入下面引用的双语设计文档。

## 验证情况

N/A — 非 UI 变更，报告与日志路径见上。

## 测试平台

macOS ✅ 本地过；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux 走 CI 车道。

## 环境（可选）

JDK 21 + Maven 3.9 + Node 22 + MariaDB 10.11（一次性 datadir，无 docker）本地验收。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：字母共享一个 fork —— 卡死的字母最多耗尽自身 @Timeout 上限，健康运行久于 CI fork 预算中被钉的配额。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：该跟踪的切片 2 与 3(FG9d-e 取消/SSE 断流，FG9b-c 存储故障与重启；后者挂于 #13918、#13986);Harness 边界上的第四草稿案因需要被探针淘汰的代理接入路径而在落地时删除。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移注记：无，只有测试与 CI 接线。

设计文档（双语已同步）：docs/design/2026-10-15-session-relay-fault-gates.md 与 docs/design/2026-10-15-session-relay-fault-gates.zh-CN.md。

## 关联问题

Ref #14164 — 本 PR 落地该追踪所分三片中的第 1 片；合并时不要关闭该 issue。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(runtime-broker): key Harness ownership on shared Workspace bindings by Runtime Session
prs.body:
## What this PR does

PR2 of #14211. It prepares the Runtime Broker for Workspace-resident Tool Runtimes, where several Hosted Sessions share one worker per storage. Today the Broker works out which Harness Session owns a Runtime Session, execution or fence from the binding's isolation key. A shared binding has no isolation key, so those checks would either skip fencing or refuse every Session.

- **One predicate.** `HarnessOwnership.sharesRuntimeSessions` is true only for a Workspace-isolated, managed-context, local-process binding of the Workspace execution profile.
- **Additive branches.** Every site that derived ownership from the isolation key gains a branch: on a shared binding it answers each Runtime Session or execution for its own Harness Session; every other binding runs the unchanged expression. The sites covered are:
  - Session and execution admission and the closing-Session fence;
  - Session tombstones;
  - original-owner recovery and release for Hooks, MCP and background runs;
  - release of saved Sessions and Workspace activation;
  - the server's Workspace transport context check and operator recovery.
- **Unchanged for now.** Lifecycle authority over a shared binding stays refused. An unknown Runtime Session id on a shared binding is never tombstoned, because nothing proves the caller owns it.
- **Design revision 3.** This records the maintainer's decisions:
  - the Workspace-isolated close evidence (worker-acknowledged activation release plus holder release) is accepted;
  - idle retirement and the generation budget are deferred;
  - the slices are reordered: this PR re-keys ownership, PR3 enables Workspace residency, PR4 adds Session-create warm.

  The revision also lists the paths PR3 must still change, and the gaps this investigation found that PR3 must close: unbound Sessions, the child relay, and a missing Session-by-Harness index.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-workspace-resident-runtime.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-workspace-resident-runtime.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

Workspace residency (PR3) shares one worker generation between Sessions on a storage, which bounds live workers by storage count instead of Session count. Before that policy can be widened, every ownership and fence decision has to stop assuming one Harness Session per binding. Otherwise a closing Session's fence would not apply on a shared binding, and original-owner recovery could not tell Sessions apart. Doing this first as a behaviour-neutral change keeps PR3 reviewable.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- For each changed site, confirm the non-shared branch is the original expression. Confirm the predicate cannot be true for any binding placeable today:
  - the Workspace resolver builds Session-isolated scopes;
  - the isolation policy admits only Session isolation;
  - legacy and static requests cannot be managed-context;
  - private Kubernetes Workspace bindings are excluded by kind.
- Check the shared-binding semantics:
  - a closing Session is refused new Runtime Sessions and executions, while other Sessions on the same binding are admitted;
  - lifecycle authority is refused;
  - recovery and release by another Harness Session are refused.
- Check the design revision in both languages for matching structure, decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible change). Local results on Linux, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.11, after rebasing onto the consolidated `packages/managed-agent-server` layout (#14277):

- **New tests.**
  - `HarnessOwnershipTest` pins the predicate's truth table.
  - `SharedHarnessOwnershipTest` (JDBC and in-memory) covers per-Harness admission, execution admission, tombstones under a drain, refusal of lifecycle authority, unchanged legacy and private Kubernetes Workspace bindings, and original-owner recovery and release.
  - Two server tests cover the transport context check and operator recovery on a shared binding.
- **Mutation check.** Forcing the predicate to false makes every new test fail, Broker and server alike.
- **Existing suites.** Before the rebase, the full Runtime Broker suite ran 963 tests with 0 failures. The server suite failed only `WorkspaceCsiNativeActivationGateTest` (16 tests), which needs built `packages/core/dist`, absent in this worktree.
- **Checks.** SpotBugs and checkstyle pass. A full `mvn verify` on the consolidated module is summarized in a comment below.
- **`SDK Java` workflow.** Dispatched on this head: run link in a comment below.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Maven builds of `packages/sdk-java/qwencode` and `packages/managed-agent-server`.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** low. The new branches are unreachable until PR3 widens the isolation policy. The main reviewer burden is confirming each non-shared branch is the original expression. One extra binding read was added on the persisted-Session release path, to decide the shared flag there.
- **Not validated / out of scope:** Workspace residency itself, Session close splitting, provisioning, retention, recovery fences, and lifecycle evidence for shared bindings (PR3). Idle retirement and the generation budget are deferred.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. Three repository overloads were added with defaults that delegate to the existing scope-only methods.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14211. Follows #14214 and #14254.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**本 PR 做了什么**：#14211 的 PR2。为"按 Workspace 常驻的 Tool Runtime"（同一 storage 上多个 Hosted Session 共享一个 worker）做准备。今天 Broker 通过 binding 的 isolation key 判断 Runtime Session、执行或封锁属于哪个 Harness Session。共享 binding 没有 isolation key，这些判断要么会跳过封锁，要么会拒绝所有 Session。

- **一个判定**：`HarnessOwnership.sharesRuntimeSessions` 只在 workspace 隔离、managed-context、local-process、Workspace 执行 profile 的 binding 上为真。
- **只加分支**：每处从 isolation key 推导归属的代码都加了一个分支：共享 binding 上按每个 Runtime Session 或执行自己的 Harness Session 判断；其他 binding 原样执行旧表达式。覆盖的位置有：
  - Session 与执行的准入，以及关闭中 Session 的封锁；
  - Session tombstone；
  - Hook、MCP、后台任务原 owner 的恢复与释放；
  - 已保存 Session 的释放和 Workspace 激活；
  - server 侧 Workspace transport 的 context 校验和人工恢复。
- **暂不改变**：共享 binding 上的生命周期 authority 仍被拒绝。共享 binding 上未知的 Runtime Session id 不会被写 tombstone，因为没有任何东西能证明调用方拥有它。
- **设计修订 3**：记录维护者的决定：
  - 接受 workspace 隔离下的 close 证据（worker 确认的 activation release 加 holder 释放）；
  - 推后空闲回收和 generation 预算；
  - 切片重新排序：本 PR 重建归属，PR3 开启 Workspace 常驻，PR4 增加 Session 创建时 warm。

  修订 3 还列出了 PR3 仍需修改的路径，以及本次调研发现、需要 PR3 补上的缺口：unbound Session、child relay、缺少按 Harness 查询 Session 的索引。

**为什么需要**：Workspace 常驻（PR3）让同一 storage 上的 Session 共享一个 worker generation，把存活 worker 数从 Session 数降到 storage 数。在放开隔离策略之前，所有归属和封锁判断都必须不再假设"一个 binding 只属于一个 Harness Session"。否则关闭中 Session 的封锁在共享 binding 上不生效，原 owner 恢复也无法区分各个 Session。先把这部分做成行为不变的改动，PR3 才便于审查。

**验证**（Linux、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.11，已 rebase 到 #14277 整合后的 `packages/managed-agent-server`）：
- **新测试**：判定真值表；JDBC 与内存仓库的按 Harness 准入、执行准入、drain 期间的 tombstone、生命周期 authority 被拒绝、legacy 与私有 Kubernetes Workspace binding 行为不变、原 owner 恢复与释放；server 侧 transport context 校验与人工恢复各一个。
- **变异检查**：把判定强制为 false 后，Broker 和 server 两侧的每个新测试都会失败。
- **现有测试**：rebase 前 Runtime Broker 全量 963 个用例 0 失败；server 全量测试只有 `WorkspaceCsiNativeActivationGateTest` 的 16 个失败，原因是本 worktree 没有构建 `packages/core/dist`。
- **检查**：SpotBugs 与 checkstyle 通过。整合后模块的完整 `mvn verify` 结果与 `SDK Java` workflow 链接见下方评论。

</details>

prs.title: feat(runtime): develop cumulative K2 CSI runtime and retirement
prs.body:
> The resident Workspace first release is extracted into #14340 for separate review. This PR remains the cumulative K2 development branch, including deferred retirement and node-evidence candidates; the code/history and existing evidence are preserved. Review the focused first release in #14340.

## What this PR does

Adds the first resident Kubernetes Workspace file runtime. An explicitly configured tenant/Workspace owns one original Pod and one fixed CSI PVC. The public Read/Write/Edit profile admits one unfinished Session and one active tool context. Closing A settles its work and revokes its context while retaining the binding and physical reservation; B uses the same runtime and files.

Admission and dispatch check the persisted Workspace, generation, storage, Session fence and original runtime identity. Concurrent distinct-key creation admits only one Session, and same-key retries return that admission. Closed contexts cannot reactivate. Uncertain release, missing resources or changed original identity keep the Workspace unavailable without a local fallback or replacement Pod. A normal application/Broker restart recovers the original saved binding against the preserved database.

The implementation follows main's consolidated Server/Broker application layout and canonical millisecond schema. Configuration, deployment guidance and linked English/Chinese designs are included. This is the resident first-release delivery of the cumulative K2 branch; the broader code scope and deferred capabilities are stated below.

## Why it's needed

Sequential Sessions should retain a Workspace's files without destroying its runtime after every Session. Keeping the Pod alone does not safely settle unfinished work or revoke old tool authority. The resident path enforces logical handoff while keeping exclusive ownership of the original runtime and storage.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure an exact tenant/Workspace/CSI registration with the public files profile. Unconfigured storage, duplicate volume assignments, foreign tenants, child sharing and unsupported profiles must refuse.
2. Create Sessions concurrently for the same Workspace. Different keys must produce one admission and a busy response; same-key retries must return the same Session. Closing Sessions and unresolved old Runtime Sessions must block a new admission.
3. Run Write/Edit/Read in A, close A through the public API, then run Read/Edit/Read in B. B's initial read must exactly match A's final bytes on the same original worker/PV/PVC. Old A input, activation and dispatch must stay refused.
4. Inspect ownership across handoff. The binding must remain READY, storage must remain RESERVED, and completed Runtime Sessions must be RELEASED. Close/retry must not drain the binding, delete the Pod/PVC, unpublish the volume or transfer its owner. Binding health and operation fields may advance when B uses it.
5. Normally restart the application/Broker against the original database while preserving the worker. B must still succeed with the original binding generation, seed, lease, handle and storage owner. Unknown release or a changed/missing original runtime must block handoff.
6. Verify ordinary local Workspace behavior and existing private CSI guards retain their checks. Authorization after the durable close fence and a second overlapping context must refuse before creating new authority.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, public Workspace execution used Session isolation and close required runtime drain/stop. After, an explicit resident mapping supports logical Session handoff on the original runtime and files. This is an API/runtime change; there is no TUI change. Detailed results, evidence digests and qualification boundaries are in the separate [E2E report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13526#issuecomment-6186801847).

| Source | Verified behavior and limits |
| --- | --- |
| Latest code `5630a2f35d3c`, including main `28415ddff367` | Node build/typecheck/bundle; 927 affected CLI tests; 246 focused combined-module Java tests; 11 Node packaging/evidence tests; Checkstyle, SpotBugs, source ESLint and changed-file formatting passed. Script/workflow checks passed 483 cases, with 10 GNU-realpath-dependent cases skipped on macOS. |
| Independent local verification of the latest code | All 1010 recompiled production classes matched the frozen build. Sixteen resident H2 tests and two actual ordinary public handoff/application-reconstruction tests passed without skips. Each public flow retained six actual tool call/reply pairs, exact final-A/initial-B read bytes and four/five ownership snapshots from the original DataSource. The original worker started once, with zero physical releases. Reconstruction used fresh application/Broker/DataSource/repository instances in the same JVM with declared ordinary placement. Immutable input comparison maps the executed candidate to the final commit; these are local H2 results, not a new ACK run. |
| Earlier ACK deployment: runtime `53f24ba09`, capture/reconstruction helpers `a4a51655c` | A Write/Edit/Read, a normal new application JVM restart, then B Read/Edit/Read passed. Six actual tool replies, six same-DataSource ownership snapshots, distinct-key concurrent 202 + 409, same-key replay and old-A rejection were captured. Independent checks passed 52 original and 26 additional data checks over 62 contiguous responses. Original Pod/container/PV/PVC/disk identities and storage ownership were retained. These results remain bound to that earlier deployed revision; they do not qualify the subsequent schema/layout integration as a fresh cloud deployment. |

Both ACK Sessions closed normally. The new trial resources were normally cleaned and checked absent by `2026-10-15T17:52:16Z`; the original two system nodes remained Ready. Cleanup checks passed 29/29, temporary credentials/keys were removed and expiry automation was paused. Maintenance cleanup is not physical-retirement or safe-reuse evidence. The final bill had not settled, so no zero-cost claim is made.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Latest build, focused checks and independent ordinary H2 public handoff/reconstruction passed. |
| Windows | Not locally verified. |
| Linux | Earlier ACK revision passed actual CSI file handoff, concurrent admission and normal application JVM restart; latest schema/layout integration was verified locally. |

### Environment

Local Darwin arm64, Node 22 and Java 21; independent combined-module tests used H2 2.4.240 and JUnit 5.14.1. The earlier cloud acceptance used an isolated Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 ACK node, actual CSI Pod/PVC placement, a deterministic model and file-backed H2. Current CI status is available in this PR's Checks tab.

## Risk & Scope

- **Cumulative code scope:** this branch still contains the earlier K2 native-file foundation, private retirement and node-evidence candidate code, tests and designs. They remain part of the diff requiring review; this is not a resident-only extraction. The first-release acceptance above does not certify the deferred candidates. The change crosses core infrastructure and needs maintainer architecture review.
- **First-release boundary:** resident mappings are opt-in. Session close retains Pod/node/storage costs. Automatic physical retirement, privileged collector deployment, physical stop/CSI unpublish proof, qualified historical retirement credentials, cross-Workspace volume reuse, multiwriter Sessions, in-place cwd changes, Shell/MCP/Hook profiles and automatic lost-Pod recovery are deferred.
- **Database compatibility:** deploy this revision with a fresh canonical database. Earlier DATETIME/legacy catalogs and saved retirement images are refused rather than silently converted; retain the corresponding old binary/database for historical access. The cumulative branch includes the additive K2 V4 extension; the resident delta introduces no additional migration.
- **Validation limits:** the latest integration has no new ACK deployment, MySQL, external-model, process-crash or database-HA qualification. Local reconstruction is not process-crash recovery. Previously refused native acceptance groups were not rerun through this change. Two clean merge/adaptation audit passes do not establish a complete historical branch review.
- **Review status:** PR remains Draft for maintainer review. Native review previously returned quota HTTP403 without a verdict, and the repository's `/review` skill is unavailable; no shipping review approval is claimed.
- **Synchronized documentation:** [resident design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.md) / [常驻设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.zh-CN.md); [configuration guide (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/deploy/k2-resident/README.md) / [配置指南（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/deploy/k2-resident/README.zh-CN.md); [deferred physical design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-11-k2-physical-completion.md) / [延后物理设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-11-k2-physical-completion.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13395. Keep the proposal open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

> 常驻 Workspace 第一版已单独拆到 #14340 评审。本 PR 保留为累计 K2 开发分支，包含延后的退役和节点证据候选；代码/历史及既有证据保留。常驻首版请评审 #14340。

## 本 PR 的改动

增加第一版常驻 Kubernetes Workspace 文件运行环境。显式配置的租户/Workspace 独占一个原始 Pod 和固定 CSI PVC。公开 Read/Write/Edit 配置只允许一个未完成 Session 和一个活动工具上下文。关闭 A 时结算其工作并撤销上下文，保留 binding 和物理 reservation；B 使用同一运行环境和文件。

准入与派发检查持久化的 Workspace、generation、存储、Session 屏障和原运行环境身份。不同键并发创建只允许一个 Session，同键重试返回原准入。已关闭上下文不能重新激活。释放结果不确定、原资源缺失或身份改变时，Workspace 保持不可用，不回退本地或替换 Pod。正常应用/Broker 重启从保留的数据库恢复原有持久 binding。

实现跟随主干合并后的 Server/Broker 应用布局和 canonical 毫秒 schema，包含配置、部署说明及相互链接的完整英中设计。这是累计 K2 分支的常驻首版交付；更广的代码范围和延后能力在下方明确列出。

## 动机

连续的 Session 应保留 Workspace 文件，无需每次结束都销毁其运行环境。单纯保留 Pod 无法安全结算未完成工作或撤销旧工具权限。常驻路径在保持原运行环境和存储独占归属的同时，执行逻辑交接。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 配置精确的租户/Workspace/CSI 注册和公开 files 配置。未配置存储、重复卷分配、其他租户、子 Session 共享及不支持的配置必须拒绝。
2. 对同一 Workspace 并发创建 Session。不同键必须产生一个准入和一个 busy 响应；同键重试必须返回同一 Session。正在关闭的 Session 及未结算的旧 Runtime Session 必须阻止新准入。
3. A 执行 Write/Edit/Read，通过公开 API 关闭 A，再由 B 执行 Read/Edit/Read。B 首读必须逐字节等于 A 末读，且使用同一原 worker/PV/PVC。旧 A 输入、激活及派发必须持续拒绝。
4. 检查交接前后的归属。binding 必须保持 READY，存储保持 RESERVED，已完成的 Runtime Session 必须为 RELEASED。关闭/重试不得排空 binding、删除 Pod/PVC、卸载卷或转移 owner。B 使用时，binding 的健康及操作字段可以正常推进。
5. 保留 worker，从原数据库正常重启应用/Broker。B 仍须使用原 binding generation、seed、lease、handle 和存储 owner 成功运行。释放未知或原运行环境改变/缺失必须阻止交接。
6. 核对普通本地 Workspace 行为和已有私有 CSI guard 保留原检查。持久关闭屏障后的授权，以及第二个重叠上下文，必须在创建新权限前被拒绝。

### 证据（前后对比）

改动前，公开 Workspace 执行使用 Session 隔离，关闭要求排空/停止运行环境。改动后，显式常驻映射支持在原运行环境和文件上进行逻辑 Session 交接。这是 API/运行环境变更，没有 TUI 改动。详细结果、证据摘要和资格边界见独立 [E2E 报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13526#issuecomment-6186801847)。

| 来源 | 已验证行为及边界 |
| --- | --- |
| 最新代码 `5630a2f35d3c`，包含主干 `28415ddff367` | Node build/typecheck/bundle、927 项受影响 CLI 测试、246 项合并模块 Java 聚焦测试、11 项 Node 打包/采集测试，以及 Checkstyle、SpotBugs、源码 ESLint 和修改文件格式检查通过。脚本/工作流检查 483 项通过，10 项依赖 GNU realpath 的用例在 macOS 条件跳过。 |
| 最新代码的独立本地复验 | 重新编译的全部 1010 个生产类与冻结构建相同。16 项常驻 H2 测试及两个真实普通公开交接/应用重建用例通过，零跳过。每条公开流程保留六对真实工具调用/回复、A 末读/B 首读精确字节，以及四/五份原 DataSource 归属快照。原 worker 仅启动一次，物理释放为零。重建在同一 JVM 中创建全新应用/Broker/DataSource/repository 实例，使用明示的普通放置。不可变输入比较将实际执行候选对应到最终提交；这是本地 H2 结果，不是新一轮 ACK 验收。 |
| 较早 ACK 部署：runtime `53f24ba09`，采集/重建辅助 `a4a51655c` | A Write/Edit/Read、正常启动新的应用 JVM、再由 B Read/Edit/Read 通过。保留六条真实工具回复、六份同 DataSource 归属快照、不同键并发 202 + 409、同键重放和旧 A 拒绝。对 62 条连续响应的独立核对通过原 52 项及额外 26 项数据检查。原 Pod/容器/PV/PVC/盘身份及存储归属保持。结果仍绑定该较早部署版本，不授予后续 schema/布局集成新的云端验收资格。 |

两个 ACK Session 均正常关闭。新增实验资源已于 `2026-10-15T17:52:16Z` 前正常清理并核实不存在，原两个 system 节点保持 Ready。清理检查 29/29 通过，临时凭据/keys 已删除，到期自动化暂停。维护清理不作为物理退役或安全复用证据。最终账单尚未结算，因此不宣称零费用。

### 验证平台

| OS | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 最新构建、聚焦检查及独立普通 H2 公开交接/重建通过。 |
| Windows | 未本地验证。 |
| Linux | 较早 ACK 版本通过真实 CSI 文件交接、并发准入及正常应用 JVM 重启；最新 schema/布局集成通过本地验证。 |

### 环境

本地 Darwin arm64、Node 22 和 Java 21；独立合并模块测试使用 H2 2.4.240 和 JUnit 5.14.1。较早云端验收使用隔离的 Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 ACK 节点、真实 CSI Pod/PVC 放置、确定性模型和文件 H2。最新 CI 状态见本 PR 的 Checks 页。

## 风险和范围

- **累计代码范围：** 此分支仍包含较早 K2 原生文件基础、私有退役与节点证据候选代码、测试和设计。它们仍在待评审差量中；本次没有抽取为仅常驻代码的独立分支。上述首版验收不授予延后候选资格。改动跨核心基础设施，需要维护者架构评审。
- **首版边界：** 常驻映射显式启用。Session 关闭后仍产生 Pod/节点/存储费用。自动物理退役、特权 collector 部署、物理停止/CSI 卸载证明、合格历史退役凭据、跨 Workspace 卷复用、多写 Session、原地 cwd 变更、Shell/MCP/Hook 配置及丢失 Pod 自动恢复延后。
- **数据库兼容性：** 此修订须使用全新 canonical 数据库。早期 DATETIME/legacy 目录和保存的退役像被拒绝，不静默转换；保留对应旧二进制/数据库供历史访问。累计分支包含 additive K2 V4 扩展，常驻差量没有新增迁移。
- **验证边界：** 最新集成没有新增 ACK 部署、MySQL、外部模型、进程崩溃或数据库 HA 验收。本地重建不等于进程崩溃恢复。此前被拒的原生验收组未借本改动重跑。两轮干净的合并/适配自审不等于完整历史分支评审。
- **评审状态：** PR 保持 Draft 等待维护者评审。Native review 此前因额度返回 HTTP403，没有结论，仓库 `/review` skill 不可用；不宣称 shipping review 已批准。
- **同步文档：** [常驻设计（英文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.md) / [常驻设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-14-k2-resident-workspace.zh-CN.md)；[配置指南（英文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/deploy/k2-resident/README.md) / [配置指南（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/deploy/k2-resident/README.zh-CN.md)；[延后物理设计（英文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-11-k2-physical-completion.md) / [延后物理设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5630a2f35d3c6594b5b04998e136be22eafba70a/docs/design/2026-10-11-k2-physical-completion.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13395，保留 proposal 开放。

</details>

prs.title: fix(runtime): deliver bounded provider images and PDFs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables bounded image and PDF delivery through the existing managed runtime provider protocol. Each prepared file read uses its own image/PDF capability snapshot for both the tool description and actual content delivery. Supported images use the existing safe image handling; PDFs can return native bytes, extracted text, or rendered pages as appropriate. Execution workers remain independent of model initialization and do not inherit Omni media uploads. Audio and video remain disabled for this provider profile.

Media reads enforce an aggregate 768 KiB base64 ceiling and a 896 KiB complete tool-result ceiling within the existing 1 MiB response envelope. Oversized reads settle as explicit `FILE_TOO_LARGE` tool errors. Accepted media-bearing results retain their content, captions, and display across execution and settled status/cancel observations; response fitting may remove progress or auxiliary Hook details while preserving Hook stop decisions. PDF cancellation propagates through page counting, extraction, and rendering, and waits for child-process exit and renderer cleanup.

Adds regression coverage and integration fixtures for capability isolation, byte boundaries, media validation, chunked Java transport, lost replies, and Broker restart recovery. Updates the provider-control design and dependency notices. The public Hosted raw file loop remains outside this change.

## Why it's needed

The provider worker has no content generator. Previously, its declared media capabilities influenced the tool description, but actual file reads consulted content-generator modalities, so supported images and native PDF bytes could remain unavailable. Oversized responses could also replace inline media with a generic text stub after the Runtime had already retained the original result, producing inconsistent observations of the same invocation.

Using the prepared capability snapshot for delivery and applying media limits before settlement allows provider integrations to receive actual workspace media or an explicit bounded error while retaining consistent execution evidence.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Prepare reads of real PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF files with image support enabled, disabled, and omitted, including concurrent invocations and Sessions. Enabled reads should return decodable image content with the expected MIME and dimensions; disabled or omitted support should return the existing unsupported-image response without inline bytes. An inherited Omni opt-in must not cause uploads.
2. Read a small PDF with native PDF support enabled and no page range: its decoded bytes should match the workspace document. With a page range or native PDF support disabled, confirm text-first behavior and image rendering when extraction fails and image support is enabled. Explicit ranges must not silently lose pages; an implicit rendered prefix must announce omitted pages.
3. Exercise exact media boundaries and one-byte-over cases. A native PDF of 576 KiB can meet the 768 KiB base64 ceiling if the complete result also fits; one decoded byte over must return a settled `FILE_TOO_LARGE` error. Include escaped and multibyte metadata in the 896 KiB result calculation. Text, SVG, notebook content, and text-only PDF results should retain their existing handling.
4. Compare accepted tool results across execution and settled status/cancel responses, including large progress and Hook payloads. Media, captions, and display must remain identical, Hook stop decisions must survive fitting, and malformed MIME/base64 or unadmitted media must fail explicitly. Change the source file after settlement and confirm observations do not reread it.
5. With functioning Poppler tools, cancel page counting, text extraction, and rendering after the child starts. Cancellation must propagate without starting another fallback, and the owned child and rendering directory must be cleaned up.
6. After obtaining a successful build and bundle, run the added Java/MySQL provider-media integration scenario with an isolated MySQL instance. Verify the original seven-field provider reference, correct outbound media bytes and tool-call correlation at the deterministic Chat Completions fixture, exactly one physical execution after lost start/execute replies, unchanged persisted results after Broker restart, and released ownership. Treat native PDF handling through Responses as the documented unsupported case. These are proposed checks; the Java/MySQL scenario has not been run in this session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No before/after screenshots, recordings, or end-to-end media-delivery logs were provided. The implementation and added assertions describe the expected behavior; they do not establish deployment acceptance. The following local validation ran during the immediately preceding commit workflow on 2026-10-07; no tests were rerun while drafting this description:

- From `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/tools/managed-tool-runtime.test.ts src/tools/read-file.test.ts src/utils/fileUtils.test.ts src/utils/inline-media.test.ts src/utils/pdf.test.ts src/utils/pdf.poppler.test.ts` — 6 test files passed, with 455 tests passed and 4 real-Poppler tests skipped.
- From `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-protocol.test.ts src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-worker.test.ts` — 2 test files passed, with 141 tests passed.
- From the repository root: `node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='cleanup|promisify|image fixtures' integration-tests/helpers/provider-media-fixtures.node-test.ts` — the selected 4 fixture tests passed. The PDF fixture case was not selected.
- The commit's Prettier/ESLint hook passed. `npm run build` failed in the unchanged email channel with missing `imapflow`, `mailparser`, `nodemailer`, and `html-to-text` dependencies and related type errors. `npm run typecheck` failed with workspace errors, including `TS2540` for assigning to the readonly `text` property in the newly added protocol test at line 942.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested — targeted tests only; build/typecheck failed and real-Poppler tests skipped |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS with Node.js v22.18.0 and Vitest v3.2.7; direct package tests against the local workspace. No packaged deployment or Java/MySQL integration environment was exercised in the observed validation. Reviewed source: commit `205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407`, compared with its single parent `9a02f40567237ea3003becac4e6fb3b64c893d45`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the shared effective-modality read path also affects local CLI and local managed tools. Provider media is intentionally a smaller bounded subset of local CLI media; PDF rendering and retained invocations can consume more memory and disk than the response size, and this change introduces no global quota.
- Not validated / out of scope: build and typecheck are not green; the new protocol-test readonly assignment needs attention. Real-Poppler tests were skipped, and no Java transport/Checkstyle, MySQL recovery, packaged worker-to-model, real-model, or production deployment result is available from this session. Public Hosted raw-file media delivery, its separate 64 KiB persistence limits, audio/video, object-storage transport, zoom, and native PDF support through Responses are outside scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no protocol-version, public API, or database-schema migration is introduced by this diff. Invalid or over-budget provider media now produces an explicit protocol fault instead of a successful stub; normal oversized reads are settled tool errors. Existing [English provider-control design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-09-27-broker-provider-control.md) and [Chinese provider-control design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-09-27-broker-provider-control.zh-CN.md) are updated. The new [Chinese media design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-runtime-provider-media.zh-CN.md) links to `docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-runtime-provider-media.md`, but that English counterpart is absent from the reviewed commit, so bilingual completeness cannot be claimed.

## Linked Issues

Related to [#13039](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13039) and its [root-cause comment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13039#issuecomment-5895577269). No closing keyword is asserted because the documented end-to-end acceptance has not been established by the available validation.

---

## Linked Issues

Closes: #13039

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

通过现有 managed runtime provider 协议提供有界的图片和 PDF 交付。每次准备的文件读取使用独立的图片/PDF 能力快照，同时决定工具描述和实际内容交付。支持的图片复用既有安全处理；PDF 按条件返回原生字节、提取的文本或渲染页面。执行 worker 保持独立于模型初始化，也不会继承 Omni 媒体上传行为。该 provider profile 仍禁用音频和视频。

媒体读取在既有 1 MiB 响应包装内，限制聚合 base64 为 768 KiB、完整工具结果为 896 KiB。超限读取以明确的 `FILE_TOO_LARGE` 工具错误结算。已接受的含媒体结果在执行和已结算的 status/cancel 观察中保持内容、说明文本和展示不变；响应适配可以删除进度或 Hook 辅助内容，但保留 Hook 停止决定。PDF 取消会传递到页数查询、文本提取和渲染，并等待子进程退出及渲染清理完成。

增加回归覆盖和集成 fixture，覆盖能力隔离、字节边界、媒体校验、Java 分块传输、应答丢失和 Broker 重启恢复。更新 provider-control 设计及依赖声明。公开 Hosted raw 文件循环不属于本次改动范围。

## Why it's needed

provider worker 没有 content generator。此前，声明的媒体能力影响工具描述，但实际读取依赖 content-generator 模态，导致支持的图片和原生 PDF 字节仍可能无法交付。超限响应还可能在 Runtime 已保留原始结果后，把内联媒体替换为通用文本占位，从而让同一 invocation 的观察结果不一致。

使用准备时的能力快照决定交付，并在结算前应用媒体上限，使 provider 集成能够获得真实 Workspace 媒体或明确的有界错误，同时保留一致的执行证据。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. 使用真实 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 文件，分别在图片能力开启、关闭和省略时准备读取，包括并发 invocation 和 Session。开启时应返回可解码、MIME 和尺寸正确的图片内容；关闭或省略时应返回既有的不支持图片提示，不含内联字节。继承的 Omni 开关不能触发上传。
2. 开启原生 PDF 能力、不指定页范围，读取小型 PDF：解码字节应与 Workspace 文档一致。指定页范围或关闭原生 PDF 能力时，确认文本优先行为，以及提取失败且图片能力开启时的页面渲染。显式范围不能静默丢页；隐式渲染前缀必须说明省略的页面。
3. 检查精确媒体边界和超出一字节的情况。576 KiB 原生 PDF 在完整结果也可容纳时，可以满足 768 KiB base64 上限；多一个解码字节必须返回已结算的 `FILE_TOO_LARGE` 错误。896 KiB 结果大小计算应包含转义和多字节元数据。文本、SVG、notebook 内容和纯文本 PDF 结果应保留既有处理方式。
4. 比较执行和已结算 status/cancel 响应中的已接受工具结果，包括较大的进度及 Hook 负载。媒体、说明文本和展示必须相同，Hook 停止决定必须保留，畸形 MIME/base64 或未经准入的媒体必须明确失败。结算后修改源文件，确认观察不会重新读取文件。
5. 在 Poppler 工具可用时，等待子进程启动后取消页数查询、文本提取和渲染。取消必须向上传递，不能启动另一条回退，所属子进程及渲染目录必须完成清理。
6. 构建和打包成功后，使用隔离的 MySQL 实例运行新增的 Java/MySQL provider-media 集成场景。验证原始七字段 provider 引用、确定性 Chat Completions fixture 收到的媒体字节及工具调用关联、start/execute 应答丢失后只发生一次物理执行、Broker 重启后持久结果不变，以及所有权已释放。Responses 的原生 PDF 处理应被视为文档说明的不支持情形。这些是建议检查，本会话尚未运行 Java/MySQL 场景。

### Evidence (Before & After)

未提供前后对比截图、录屏或端到端媒体交付日志。实现与新增断言描述了预期行为，不能据此认定部署验收完成。以下本地验证在紧接此前的提交流程中于 2026-10-07 执行；撰写本说明时未重新运行测试：

- 在 `packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/tools/managed-tool-runtime.test.ts src/tools/read-file.test.ts src/utils/fileUtils.test.ts src/utils/inline-media.test.ts src/utils/pdf.test.ts src/utils/pdf.poppler.test.ts` — 6 个测试文件通过，455 项测试通过，4 项真实 Poppler 测试跳过。
- 在 `packages/cli`：`npx vitest run src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-protocol.test.ts src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-worker.test.ts` — 2 个测试文件通过，141 项测试通过。
- 在仓库根目录：`node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='cleanup|promisify|image fixtures' integration-tests/helpers/provider-media-fixtures.node-test.ts` — 选中的 4 项 fixture 测试通过。未选择 PDF fixture 用例。
- 提交的 Prettier/ESLint 钩子通过。`npm run build` 在未修改的 email channel 中失败，包含缺少 `imapflow`、`mailparser`、`nodemailer`、`html-to-text` 依赖及相关类型错误。`npm run typecheck` 因 Workspace 错误失败，其中新增 protocol 测试第 942 行给只读 `text` 属性赋值，报 `TS2540`。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested — 仅相关测试；构建/类型检查失败，真实 Poppler 测试跳过 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS，Node.js v22.18.0，Vitest v3.2.7；直接在本地 Workspace 中运行按包测试。已观察到的验证未使用打包部署或 Java/MySQL 集成环境。审阅来源：commit `205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407`，与唯一父提交 `9a02f40567237ea3003becac4e6fb3b64c893d45` 比较。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：共享的有效模态读取路径也影响本地 CLI 和本地 managed 工具。provider 媒体有意只支持本地 CLI 媒体的较小有界子集；PDF 渲染和保留的 invocation 可能消耗比响应大小更多的内存及磁盘，本次改动不增加全局配额。
- 未验证或不在范围内：构建和类型检查未通过，新增 protocol 测试的只读属性赋值需要处理。真实 Poppler 测试已跳过；本会话没有 Java transport/Checkstyle、MySQL 恢复、打包 worker 到模型、真实模型或生产部署的验证结果。公开 Hosted raw 文件媒体交付及其独立的 64 KiB 持久化限制、音视频、对象存储传输、zoom 和 Responses 原生 PDF 支持均不在范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：此 diff 不引入协议版本、公开 API 或数据库 schema 迁移。畸形或超预算的 provider 媒体现在会明确触发协议故障，而非成功占位；普通超限读取以工具错误结算。既有 [English provider-control design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-09-27-broker-provider-control.md) 和 [Chinese provider-control design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-09-27-broker-provider-control.zh-CN.md) 已更新。新增的 [Chinese media design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-runtime-provider-media.zh-CN.md) 链接到 `docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-runtime-provider-media.md`，但审阅的 commit 中缺少该英文对应文档，因此不能宣称双语文档完整。

## Linked Issues

关联 [#13039](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13039) 及其[根因评论](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13039#issuecomment-5895577269)。现有验证尚未证明文档要求的端到端验收已完成，因此未使用关闭 Issue 的关键词。

---


</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): Wire static Skills and extension configuration
prs.body:
## What this PR does Managed Sessions created from a published AgentDefinition can now load static Skills on demand and pass pinned MCP server and Hook catalog selections to the existing Hosted Runtime implementations. Skill instructions are published as immutable, Session-scoped resources; detach, Harness replacement and recovery retain the original definition revision and content. The public configuration accepts static Skill instructions and administrator-provisioned MCP/Hook identities. Execution admission validates supported shapes, byte limits, profile compatibility and duplicates, while definition storage retains its existing open-content compatibility. Credentials, execution recipes and Workspace file access remain owned by the selected Runtime, and Hosted does not discover Skills installed on its host. ## Why it's needed Public definitions could store Skills and MCP configuration, but Session admission rejected nonempty values and there was no public Hook catalog selector. Connecting explicitly published configuration closes that gap without importing local CLI settings or weakening existing approval, recovery and lifecycle boundaries. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Publish a static Skill with a compatible Workspace tool profile and create a Session. Confirm that the model sees its name and description, loads its body only through the Skill tool, and receives a base directory relative to the Session working directory. Publish a newer definition, then reload the original Session and confirm that its original revision and body remain unchanged. 2. Select administrator-provisioned MCP server pins with the explicitly allowlisted MCP profile, and select a Hook catalog for a Workspace-bound profile. Confirm that create, load and lifecycle attachment preserve the original pins. Confirm that incompatible profiles and missing lifecycle capabilities remain explicit failures. 3. Confirm that unknown Skills, unsupported arguments, duplicate names, oversized content and invalid directories are refused. A mixed Skill/Workspace tool batch must be refused before PermissionRequest Hooks, approval Actions or Workspace tool dispatch; load Skills in a separate batch before executing other tools. 4. Interrupt a pure Skill call after its assistant record commits and before its result commits. Confirm that replacement recovers the original body once, without replaying Runtime work, while saved Hook denials/effective inputs remain authoritative. If no PreToolUse execution marker committed, replacement must journal a never-ran error without exposing the body. An existing marker without a committed result must still block recovery. Oversized Hook inputs must replay the committed byte-limit refusal after verifying the original semantic input digest, including the pinned approval mode. Corrupt or missing content and conflicting identities must block loading. Confirm that non-MCP Sessions without extension configuration retain their existing behavior; an MCP profile with empty server pins must fail explicitly on create and attach/load. 5. Recover a settled Workspace Session whose pinned definition includes a Skill catalog. Confirm that both recovery readers retain the original bytes and resource reference; missing, corrupt, oversized or invalid catalog content must block recovery. 6. Create a Session with pinned instructions, Skills or both, then start a later model transaction after the definition leaves staging. Confirm that its resource census includes the nested pins and the Java Store accepts the original published resources, retaining scope and digest checks. Current validation after rebasing onto main `28415ddff3`: root build, typecheck and bundle; changed-file ESLint/Prettier; 285 focused TypeScript tests (86 HTTP Store and 199 Hook/Skill/runtime-recovery cases); full Java verification (3,895 cases, zero failures/errors, nine skipped), including Checkstyle and SpotBugs. The first root build exhausted the default Node heap; the 8 GiB retry passed, followed by a successful build/typecheck of the final Core test assertion. Mutation checks prove both the Core and Java census regressions fail when definition expansion is removed, and the real publisher path fails when the narrow published-resource exception is removed. Independent verification: the final 18-request packaged process fixture, 15 built Hook recovery arms, real SIGKILL/HTTP cold-load cuts for the missing marker and legal 61,440-byte catalog, and four publisher/census combinations on H2 and real MySQL all passed; all three Critical defects and the related publisher-state blocker are VERIFIED_FIXED. Selected Failsafe verification passed ten Workspace recovery and both Hosted Harness/MySQL cases; the initial Workspace run encountered a refused connection after the private database process exited, and the foreground-managed retry passed. The Hook crash cuts verify one durable error fold and successful load, not a subsequent model inference or a completed Turn. The SQL probes exercise actual Store transactions with cross-language fixture generation, separately from the packaged CLI HTTP fixture. Details and the explicit test boundaries are posted separately. An earlier full MySQL 8.4 profile passed 548/549 cases. An existing asynchronous publication recovery timing case expected FAILED but observed PENDING; its isolated new-JVM rerun passed. The original full run is not reported as green. ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A — no UI or TUI changes. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) macOS 26.7.1 arm64; Node.js 22.22.3 for builds, the final headless process fixture and Hosted/MySQL verification; JDK 21.0.8; Maven 3.9.14; disposable MySQL 8.4.11. The headless fixture uses a synthetic loopback model, a file-backed HTTP Session Store and a stub Broker; the separate Hosted/MySQL profile uses the real disposable database. Temporary processes and database resources were cleaned up. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: this crosses public definition admission, the Java Hosted client and durable Hosted recovery. Static instruction loading deliberately uses the existing assistant/tool-result journal. A PreToolUse request for approval is refused for this instruction-only operation. A missing execution marker yields a durable never-ran refusal; an existing marker without a committed result still blocks recovery. Mixed Skill/Workspace calls require separate batches. - Not validated / out of scope: filesystem or dynamic Skill discovery, slash commands, Skill permission grants, Skill-registered Hooks, model overrides, Runtime sharing and idle reclamation. Physical Linux Runtime/fault coverage, real MCP/Hook side effects and production acceptance are not established. Mixed-batch crash HTTP loads remain blocked with 409; the same-journal recovery-helper fallback verifies refusal/idempotency, not HTTP continuation, and leaves the Workspace call unanswered. - Breaking changes / migration notes: no SQL schema migration; existing definitions and Sessions without extensions keep their prior behavior for non-MCP profiles. The MCP profile now requires nonempty server pins on create and attach/load. Earlier storage admission could retain empty-pin MCP revisions even though Hosted attachment already refused them. Audit stored definitions and Sessions before rollout rather than assuming none exist; retain historical access separately and handle affected Sessions on the previous deployment before replacement. A corrected definition revision applies only to new Sessions. Deploy compatible Harness/Runtime components before admitting configured Sessions. MCP still requires explicit deployment allowlisting and its existing lifecycle capability gates; stored future configuration shapes remain distinct from executable, admitted configuration. The complete, synchronized design is available in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/26f09d061d7fd2426eb846febc79c8a725cd974a/docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-agent-extension-config.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/26f09d061d7fd2426eb846febc79c8a725cd974a/docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-agent-extension-config.zh-CN.md). ## Linked Issues N/A.
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 通过已发布 AgentDefinition 创建的 Managed Session 现在可以按需加载静态 Skill，并把固定的 MCP server 和 Hook catalog 选择传给已有 Hosted Runtime 实现。Skill 指令发布为不可变、Session 作用域的资源；detach、Harness 替换和恢复均保留原定义版本与内容。 公开配置支持静态 Skill 指令和管理员预置的 MCP/Hook 身份。执行准入校验已支持的形状、字节限制、profile 兼容性和重复项，同时定义存储保留已有开放内容兼容性。凭据、执行 recipe 和 Workspace 文件访问仍属于选定的 Runtime，Hosted 不发现自身宿主机安装的 Skill。 ## 为什么需要 公开定义原本可以保存 Skill 和 MCP 配置，但 Session 准入会拒绝非空值，也没有公开的 Hook catalog 选择入口。本次接通显式发布的配置，补齐这一缺口，同时不引入本地 CLI settings，也不削弱既有审批、恢复和生命周期边界。 ## 审查者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 使用兼容的 Workspace 工具 profile 发布静态 Skill 并创建 Session。确认模型能看到名称和描述，仅通过 Skill 工具加载正文，并收到相对 Session 工作目录的基目录。发布更新的定义后重新加载原 Session，确认其原版本和正文保持不变。 2. 使用显式部署白名单中的 MCP profile 选择管理员预置的 MCP server pin，并为绑定 Workspace 的 profile 选择 Hook catalog。确认 create、load 和生命周期 attachment 保留原 pin。确认 profile 不兼容或缺少生命周期能力时仍明确失败。 3. 确认未知 Skill、不支持的参数、重复名称、超限内容和非法目录均被拒绝。混合 Skill/Workspace 工具批次必须在 PermissionRequest Hook、审批 Action 或 Workspace 工具派发前被拒绝；应先在独立批次加载 Skill，再执行其他工具。 4. 在纯 Skill 调用的 assistant 记录提交后、结果提交前中断。确认替代 Harness 只恢复一次原正文，不重放 Runtime 工作，并继续以已保存的 Hook 拒绝或有效输入为准。如果 PreToolUse 执行标记没有提交，替代 Harness 必须写入未执行错误，不暴露正文。标记已存在但结果未提交时，仍须阻塞恢复。Hook 输入过大时，必须先校验包含原审批模式的语义输入摘要，再重放已提交的字节上限拒绝。内容损坏、缺失或身份冲突必须阻塞加载。确认未配置扩展的非 MCP Session 保留已有行为；没有 server pin 的 MCP profile 必须在 create 和 attach/load 时明确失败。 5. 恢复定义中固定了 Skill catalog 的已结束执行 Workspace Session。确认两条恢复通道均保留原字节和资源引用；catalog 内容缺失、损坏、超限或非法时必须阻塞恢复。 6. 使用固定的指令、Skill 或两者创建 Session，待定义离开暂存状态后发起后续模型事务。确认资源清单包含嵌套 pin，Java Store 接受原先已发布的资源，并保留作用域与摘要检查。 基于主干 `28415ddff3` rebase 后的当前验证：根目录 build、typecheck、bundle；改动文件 ESLint/Prettier；285 项 TypeScript 定向测试（86 项 HTTP Store、199 项 Hook/Skill/Runtime 恢复）；完整 Java 验证（3,895 项，零失败、零错误，跳过九项），包含 Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs。首次根目录构建耗尽 Node 默认堆内存，8 GiB 重试通过，随后最终 Core 测试断言的 build/typecheck 也通过。反向验证证明，移除定义展开项后 Core 和 Java 清单回归都会失败，移除狭窄的已发布资源例外后，真实 publisher 路径会失败。独立验证：18 次确定性模型请求的最终进程 fixture、15 个 built Hook 恢复分支、缺标记与合法 61,440 字节 catalog 两个真实 SIGKILL/HTTP 冷加载分支，以及 H2/真实 MySQL 上四种 publisher/清单组合均通过；三条 Critical 和同路径发布状态问题均为 VERIFIED_FIXED。选定的 Failsafe 验证通过十项 Workspace 恢复与两项 Hosted Harness/MySQL 测试；首次 Workspace 运行因私有临时数据库进程退出而连接被拒绝，改用前台托管实例后重跑通过。Hook 崩溃分支验证的是一次持久错误折叠与成功冷加载，没有声称后续模型推理或整个 Turn 完成。SQL 探针通过跨语言 fixture 生成来执行真实 Store 事务，与最终 CLI HTTP 进程 fixture 分开验证。详细结果及明确的测试边界单独发布。 此前 MySQL 8.4 全量 profile 通过 548/549 项。一个既有异步发布恢复时序用例期望 FAILED、实际观察到 PENDING；隔离的新 JVM 重跑通过。原始全量运行仍不能报告为全绿。 ### 前后证据 N/A — 没有 UI 或 TUI 变更。 ### 已测试平台 | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 | ### 环境（可选） macOS 26.7.1 arm64；构建、最终 headless 进程 fixture 及 Hosted/MySQL 验证使用 Node.js 22.22.3；JDK 21.0.8；Maven 3.9.14；临时 MySQL 8.4.11。Headless fixture 使用合成的 loopback 模型、基于文件的 HTTP Session Store 和 stub Broker；独立的 Hosted/MySQL profile 使用真实临时数据库。临时进程和数据库资源均已清理。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：变更贯穿公开定义准入、Java Hosted client 和持久 Hosted 恢复。静态指令加载有意使用已有 assistant/tool-result 日志。对于这个仅加载指令的操作，PreToolUse 的审批请求会被拒绝。执行标记缺失时持久记录未执行拒绝；标记已存在但结果未提交时，仍阻塞恢复。混合 Skill/Workspace 调用需要拆成独立批次。 - 未验证或范围之外：文件系统或动态 Skill 发现、slash 命令、Skill 权限授予、Skill 注册 Hook、模型覆盖、Runtime 共享和空闲回收。未建立物理 Linux Runtime/故障覆盖、真实 MCP/Hook 副作用和生产验收结论。混批崩溃后的 HTTP load 仍返回 409 阻塞；同一日志上的恢复 helper fallback 验证的是拒绝与幂等性，不是 HTTP 续行，Workspace 调用仍未答复。 - 破坏性变更或迁移说明：没有 SQL schema 迁移；对于非 MCP profile，未配置扩展的既有定义和 Session 保留原行为。MCP profile 现在在 create 和 attach/load 时都要求非空 server pin。之前的存储准入可能保留没有 pin 的 MCP revision，虽然 Hosted attachment 当时已拒绝它。发布前应审计已保存的定义和 Session，不能假定这类数据不存在；单独保留历史访问能力，并在替换前通过旧部署处理受影响 Session。修正后的定义版本只用于新 Session。准入带配置的 Session 前，应部署兼容的 Harness/Runtime 组件。MCP 仍要求显式部署白名单及已有生命周期能力门禁；已保存的未来配置形状仍与可执行、已准入的配置分开。 完整同步的设计提供[英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/26f09d061d7fd2426eb846febc79c8a725cd974a/docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-agent-extension-config.md)和[简体中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/26f09d061d7fd2426eb846febc79c8a725cd974a/docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-agent-extension-config.zh-CN.md)。 ## 关联 Issue N/A。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): polish files and trim preview resources
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes workspace file names safe to display while preserving the original paths for file operations, and adds a close-preview action that returns to the full-width tree without losing expansion or filtering. Limits Pierre syntax highlighting to common languages and two GitHub themes, and keeps the layout dependency external in the published library.

File labels preserve legal whitespace, and filtering accepts both displayed names and original paths. Development, unit tests and production builds use the same curated resources. Resource budgets reject missing adapters, modified dependency notices survive publishing, and published declarations reject undeclared dependencies.

Existing child-agent Hook tests now observe their execution and settlement promises together and allow ten seconds for asynchronous admission. Each helper captures its own child session to prevent delayed settlement from affecting a later test. This prevents a slow first attempt from leaving an unhandled rejection after a successful retry, without weakening the assertions or changing production behavior.

## Why it's needed

The Files browser currently exposes control characters in tree labels and has no direct way to close only the inline preview. Its highlighter also ships the complete language/theme collection. The original same-baseline measurement at `23f9e986c4` reduced published library JavaScript from 21,531,077 to 14,392,773 uncompressed bytes (33.15% less, excluding the standalone transcript entry).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Files, expand a folder, and select a source file. Check that source highlighting works in light and dark themes; an unsupported language should remain readable as plain text.
2. Close the preview with the tree visible, then repeat with the tree hidden. Expect a full-width tree, preserved expansion/filtering, focus in the filter, and successful reopening of the same file.
3. Browse names containing control/ANSI/Unicode format characters and names with repeated spaces. Visible and accessible labels should remove invisible controls while preserving legal spaces. Filtering by the displayed label should find all matching files; reads and clipboard paths retain their original names. Files whose cleaned labels coincide must remain distinct.
4. Check the published library and app builds. Both should use the curated highlighter; existing conversation code blocks should retain their highlighting.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual Chromium UI with a **simulated daemon**, captured after the main merge at `fdb4e0d927`. These screenshots show the inline-preview state before closing and the full-width tree afterward; they do not establish real filesystem or Git backend behavior. Screenshots are stored on a separate assets branch and pinned to a fixed commit.

| Inline preview before closing | Full-width tree after closing |
| --- | --- |
| ![Inline source and tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c06a474590463349bf1e15f27237130cfbad76a0/web-shell-files-followups/fixed-preview.png) | ![Expanded tree and restored filter focus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c06a474590463349bf1e15f27237130cfbad76a0/web-shell-files-followups/fixed-closed-tree.png) |

Validation at `1d10aae114`: complete repository build, typecheck and bundle passed; 73 CLI child-agent tests passed with retries disabled, 45 targeted Web Shell artifact/preview/resource/tree/build tests passed, 22 publish-verifier fixture tests passed, and all 22 Files Chromium browser cases passed. Patch reapplication from pristine pinned files, changed-file lint/formatting and the actual published-package verifier passed. A fresh browser capture confirmed highlighted source, closing/reopening with preserved tree and filter focus, one document request and no forced reload. Two clean full-diff audit passes found no remaining actionable issue. Pierre resource code is 3,820,878 bytes in the app and 3,816,024 bytes in the library, including redirected Shiki subpaths; both are below the 4 MiB budget.

After the review fixes, CI detected a newer main-side lint gate. Merged main without conflicts in `fdb4e0d927`; the entire PR diff against that main is byte-identical to the reviewed diff, and the new CI freshness step passed. On this merged head, full repository lint/build/typecheck/bundle, 73 CLI tests with retries disabled, 45 Web Shell tests and the published-package verifier all passed again; a fresh browser capture also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local Vite development server, Chromium Playwright, simulated daemon. Library size measurements use production builds from the same main baseline and this branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: unsupported syntax languages intentionally fall back to plain text. A pinned Pierre Trees patch supplies the display-only formatting hook; remove it when an equivalent upstream API exists.
- Not validated / out of scope: actual filesystem/Git backend operations, Git integration, file editing, and clipboard shell escaping.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API migration. Existing Shiki 1 consumers keep their highlighter; Pierre uses a separate bundled Shiki 4 entry.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.zh-CN.md). Both versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #13878. Fixes #13935, including both remaining review items and the optional close-preview action, and corrects layout-dependency license attribution.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这次 PR 做了什么

清洗工作区文件树中名称的显示内容，同时保留文件操作使用的原始路径；增加关闭预览操作，返回全宽文件树并保留展开和筛选状态。将 Pierre 语法高亮限定为常用语言和两套 GitHub 主题，并在发布库中将布局依赖设为 external。

文件标签保留合法空格，筛选同时支持显示名称和原始路径。开发、单元测试和生产构建使用同一套裁剪资源；资源预算会拒绝缺少适配层的构建，依赖修改声明随发布保留，发布声明检查会拒绝未声明的依赖。

现有子代理 Hook 测试现在同时等待执行和结算 Promise，并为异步准入留出十秒等待窗口，避免首次执行较慢时在重试成功后遗留未处理的拒绝。每个 helper 捕获自己的 child session，避免延迟结算污染后续测试。原有断言和生产行为保持不变。

## 为什么需要

当前文件浏览器会在树行中暴露控制字符，也没有仅关闭内联预览的直接操作。高亮器还携带完整的语言和主题集合。原始实现 `23f9e986c4` 相对于同一 main 基线的测量中，发布库的 JavaScript 从 21,531,077 字节降至 14,392,773 字节，未压缩体积减少 33.15%（不包含独立的 transcript 入口）。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开“文件”，展开目录并选择源码文件。检查浅色和深色主题下的语法高亮；不支持的语言应回退为可读原文。
2. 在文件树可见时关闭预览，再隐藏文件树后重复。预期恢复全宽文件树、保留展开和筛选状态、焦点回到筛选框，并能重新打开同一文件。
3. 浏览名称含控制字符、ANSI、Unicode 格式字符或连续空格的文件。可见名称及可访问名称应移除不可见控制字符、保留合法空格；按显示名称筛选应找到所有匹配文件，读取和剪贴板路径仍保留原始名称，清洗后同名的文件仍保持不同身份。
4. 检查发布库和应用构建。两者均应使用裁剪后的高亮资源，现有对话代码块的高亮应正常。

### 证据（操作前后）

以上为基于合并 main 后提交 `fdb4e0d927` 捕获的真实 Chromium UI，使用 **模拟 daemon**。左图为关闭前的内联预览，右图为关闭后的全宽文件树；截图不证明真实文件系统或 Git 后端行为。截图保存于独立素材分支，并使用固定 commit 链接。

最新提交 `1d10aae114` 的验证：完整仓库构建、类型检查和 bundle 通过；禁用重试后的 73 项 CLI 子代理测试、45 项相关 Web Shell 产物/预览/资源/目录树/构建测试、22 项发布校验夹具测试，以及全部 22 项 Chromium 文件浏览器测试通过。固定版本依赖从原始文件重新应用补丁、修改文件的 lint/格式检查及真实发布包检查均通过。重新捕获截图的浏览器用例确认源码高亮、关闭/重新打开时保留树状态和筛选焦点，仅一个文档请求且无强制重载。两轮完整 diff 自审未发现遗留的可操作问题。包含重定向 Shiki 子路径后，应用和库的 Pierre 资源代码分别为 3,820,878 和 3,816,024 字节，均低于 4 MiB 预算。

review 修复后，CI 检测到 main 更新了 lint 门禁。已在 `fdb4e0d927` 无冲突合入 main；PR 相对该 main 的完整 diff 与已审阅版本逐字节一致，新一轮 CI 的 freshness 检查已通过。合并后的全仓 lint、构建、类型检查和 bundle、禁用重试的 73 项 CLI 测试、45 项 Web Shell 测试、发布包检查及新截图浏览器用例均再次通过。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

本地 Vite 开发服务器、Chromium Playwright、模拟 daemon。库体积使用同一 main 基线和本分支的生产构建对比。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：未支持的语法语言有意回退为原文。通过固定版本的 Pierre Trees 补丁提供仅用于显示的格式化接口，待上游具备等价 API 后移除。
- 未验证或范围外：真实文件系统和 Git 后端操作、Git 集成、文件编辑以及剪贴板 shell 转义。
- 兼容性与迁移：无需迁移公共 API。现有 Shiki 1 使用方保持原高亮器，Pierre 使用单独打包的 Shiki 4 入口。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.zh-CN.md)，两种语言内容已同步。

#13878 的后续修复，解决 #13935 中两项剩余 review 工作及可选的关闭预览操作，同时修正布局依赖的许可证归属。
